translations.source: ዩ.ኤንም በዓለም አየር ሙቀት መጨመር ለተጎዱ ሃገራት ተፅዕኖውን እንዲቋቋሙ ለመርዳት ገንዘብ ለማጠናቀቅ ተስፋ ያደርጋል።
translations.reference: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.hypothesis: The U.S. is hoping to secure funding to help vulnerable countries mitigate the effects of global warming.

translations.source: ገንዘቡ ወደ ጎርፍ መከላከያ ቤቶች ፣ ለተሻለ የውሃ አያያዝ እና የሰብል ብዝሃነት ሊሄድ ይችላል።
translations.reference: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.hypothesis: The solution could involve relocating to areas with better water resources and more fertile land.

translations.source: ፍሉክ አንዳንድ ሰዎች ሴቶችን ስለ ሴቶች ጤና ከመናገር እንዲቆጠብ ያደረጉት ጥረት ያልተሳካ ነበር በማለት ጽፏል።
translations.reference: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.hypothesis: He wrote that efforts to discourage men from talking about women's health had not been successful.

translations.source: ወደ እዚህ ድምዳሜ የመጣችው በሚሰጧት ጥሩ አስተያየቶች እና ከሁለቱም ሴት እና ወንድ ወገኖች የወሊድ መቆጣጠሪያ ሕክምና አስፈላጊ ሕክምና እንደሆን ማበረታቻ ስለሚላክላት ነው።
translations.reference: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.hypothesis: I came across this article because of the positive feedback it received, and I was encouraged to learn that both men and women find the information provided about childbirth control to be helpful and informative.

translations.source: ቁስለኞቹ ወደ ሆስፒታል ከተወሰዱ በኋላ ውጊያው ሲቆም፣ ከሌሎቹ እስረኞች መካከል ወደ 40 የሚሆኑት በግቢው ውስጥ ቆዩ እና ወደ ክፍላቸው ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም።
translations.reference: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.hypothesis: After the prisoners were taken to the hospital, and the fighting had stopped, approximately 40 of the remaining prisoners remained in the courtyard and refused to return to their cells.

translations.source: ተደራዳሪዎች ሁኔታውን ለማስተካከል ቢሞክሩም የእስረኞች ጥያቄ ግን ግልፅ አይደለም።
translations.reference: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.hypothesis: While efforts are being made to improve the prisoners' conditions, their specific concerns remain unclear.

translations.source: 10:00-11:00 ከሰዓት ኤምዲቲ መካከል፣ ግቢ ውስጥ በእስረኞቹ እሳት ተነሳ።
translations.reference: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.hypothesis: Between 10:00 and 11:00 AM, a fire broke out in the building.

translations.source: ብዙም ሳይቆይ የአመፅ መሣሪያ የታጠቁ መኮንኖች ወደ ግቢው በመግባት እስረኞችን በአስለቃሽ ጭስ ዘጉ።
translations.reference: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.hypothesis: Shortly after, armed soldiers stormed the building, arresting prisoners and taking them away in handcuffs.

translations.source: በመጨረሻ የእሳት አደጋ መከላከያ ሠራተኞች ከሌሊቱ 11:35 ሰዓት ላይ እሳቱን ማጥፋት ችለዋል።
translations.reference: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, the fire suppression team managed to extinguish the fire at 11:35 PM.

translations.source: ግድቡ በ 1963 ከተገነባ በኋላ በየአመቱ በወንዙን አቧራ የሚዘራውን የጎርፍ መጥለቅለቅ አቆመ።
translations.reference: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.hypothesis: Built in 1963, the dam has effectively controlled the annual flooding caused by the river's overflowing.

translations.source: ይህ ደለል እንደ የዱር ህይወት መኖሪያ ያገለገሉ፣ የአሸዋ ሜዳዎችን እና የባህር ዳርቻዎችን ለመስራት አስፈላጊ ነበር።
translations.reference: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.hypothesis: This type of wetland was essential for creating marshlands and coastal areas, which served as habitats for a variety of wildlife.

translations.source: በዚህ ምክንያት ሁለት የዓሣ ዝርያዎች ጠፍተዋል ፣ ሌሎች ሁለት ደግሞ ሃምፕባክ ቹብን ጨምሮ ለአደጋ ተጋልጠዋል።
translations.reference: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, two species of fish have become extinct, and another two, including the humpback chub, are now threatened.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን የውሃው መጠን ከጎርፉ በኋላ ጥቂት ጫማዎችን ብቻ የሚያድግ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሥልጣኖቹ የተሸረሸሩ አሸዋዎችን ወደታች ለመመለስ በቂ ይሆናል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
translations.reference: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.hypothesis: Although the amount of water available after the rain is only enough to slightly replenish the soil, officials are hopeful that it will be sufficient to bring the parched land back to life.

translations.source: የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ አልተሰጠም ፣ የጃካርታ ጂኦፊዚክስ ኤጄንሲ እንደገለጸው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ የ 6.5 መጠንን ስላላሟላ የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ አይሰጥም።
translations.reference: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.hypothesis: According to the Jakarta Geoscience Agency, no tsunami warning was issued because the earthquake did not reach the magnitude of 6.5 that would trigger one.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን የሱናሚ ስጋት ባይኖርም ነዋሪዎቹ መፍራት ጀመሩ እና ንግዶቻቸውን እና ቤቶቻቸውን ጥለው መሄድ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the lack of immediate danger, the residents began to panic and started to evacuate their homes and businesses.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ዊንፍሬይ በስንብቷ እያነባች ብትሆንም፤ ተመልሳ እንደምትመጣ ለአድናቂዎቿ ግልፅ አድርጋለች፡፡
translations.reference: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.hypothesis: Even if Winfrey is reading a book, she makes it clear to her fans that she will return to the show.

translations.source: "ይህ ስንብት አይሆንም፡፡ ይህ የአንድ ምእራፍ መዝጊያ እና የአዲሱ መክፈቻ ነው፡፡"
translations.reference: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.hypothesis: "This is not a permanent solution. It's a temporary fix, marking both the closure of one phase and the opening of a new one."

translations.source: የናሚቢያ የፕሬዝዳንት እና ፓርላማ ምርጫዎች የመጨረሻ ውጤቶች አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያለው፣ ሂፊኬፑንዬ ፖሃምባ፣ በሰፊ ወሰን በድጋሚ መመረጡን አመልክቷል።
translations.reference: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.hypothesis: The final results of Namibia's presidential and parliamentary elections have been announced, confirming that Hage Geingob, the current president, has been re-elected in a landslide victory.

translations.source: የደቡብ ምዕራብ አፍሪካ ህዝቦች ድርጅት (ኤስ.ደብልዩ.ኤስ.ፒ.ኦ) ገዥው ፓርቲ፣ በፓርላማው ምርጫም ብዙዎችን እንደያዘ ቆይቷል።
translations.reference: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.hypothesis: The Southern African People's Organization (SAPS) has been accusing the ruling party of rigging elections and manipulating the parliamentary process.

translations.source: የኮኦሊሽን እና የአፍጋኒስታን ወታደሮች ቦታውን ለማስጠበቅ ወደ አካባቢው የገቡ ሲሆን ሌሎች የኮኦሊሽን አውሮፕላኖችም እንዲረዱ ተልከዋል።
translations.reference: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.hypothesis: The coalition forces and Afghan soldiers entered the area to secure it, and were also dispatched with additional coalition aircraft for support.

translations.source: አደጋው በተራራማው የመሬት አቀማመጥ ከፍ ብሎ የተከሰተ ሲሆን በአደገኛ እሳት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ይታመናል።
translations.reference: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.hypothesis: The fire broke out due to the unstable terrain, and it is believed to have been caused by hazardous materials.

translations.source: የአደጋውን ቦታ ለመፈለግ የተደረገው ጥረት በመጥፎ የአየር ጠባይ እና በአስቸጋሪ የመሬት አቀማመጥ ጋር ነበር የገጠመው።
translations.reference: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.hypothesis: The search for the site of the accident was hampered by poor weather conditions and difficult terrain.

translations.source: የህክምና በጎ አድራጎት ማንጎላ ፣ ሜዲሲንስ ሳንስ ፍሮንቲርስ እና የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት በሀገሪቱ ከተመዘገበው ይህ የከፋ ወረርሽኝ ነው ብለዋል።
translations.reference: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.hypothesis: The medical charity, Mango La, along with Medicines Sans Frontières and the World Health Organization, have stated that this is the worst outbreak of the disease recorded in the country.

translations.source: የሜዲሲንስ ሳንስ ፍሮንቲር ቃል አቀባይ ሪቻርድ ቬርማን በበኩላቸው፥ “አንጎላ ከመቼውም ጊዜ በላይ ወደ አስከፊ የወረርሽኝ ስጋት እያመራች ሲሆን ሁኔታው በአንጎላ እጅግ በጣም መጥፎ ነው” ብለዋል።
translations.reference: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Richard Verman, a leading expert in infectious diseases, stated, "Angola is facing an unprecedented and alarming outbreak of disease, and the situation is extremely dire."

translations.source: ጨዋታዎቹ ከቀኑ 10:00 ሰዓት ጀምሮ በታላቅ የአየር ሁኔታ ተጀምረዋል እና በፍጥነት ከጸዳው ከጠዋት አጋማሹ ካፊያ በስተቀር፣ ለ 7ቶቹ ራግቢዎች ጥሩ ቀን ነበር፡፡
translations.reference: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.hypothesis: The games began at 10:00 AM under ideal weather conditions, and the rugby teams had a good day overall, with the exception of the 7th team, who played in the rain.

translations.source: የውድድሩ ምርጥ ቡድን ደቡብ አፍሪካ የጀመሩት 5ኛ ከተደረደሩት የዛምቢያን 26 – 00 በማሸነፍ ምቹ የሆነ ጅማሬ ይዘው ነበር።
translations.reference: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.hypothesis: The winning team, South Africa, secured a comfortable victory over Zambia with a score of 26-0.

translations.source: ከደቡባዊ እህቶቻቸው ጋር ያለው ጨዋታ ላይ በደንብ ልምድ የሌላቸው ቢመስሉም ደቡብ አፍሪካ ቀስ በቀስ ውድድሩ በቀጠለ ቁጥር አሻሻለች።
translations.reference: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.hypothesis: Although they may not have had much experience playing against their southern rivals, South Africa gradually improved as the tournament progressed.

translations.source: ጨዋነት የተሞላበት የመከላከል አቅማቸው፣ የኳስ አያያዝ ችሎታቸው እና እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የቡድን መግባባት ጎልተው እንዲታዩ ያደረጋቸው ሲሆን ሌሎች መርታት ያለባቸው ይህ ቡድን እንደሆነ ግልጽ ነበር።
translations.reference: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.hypothesis: Their ability to play with flair, their proficiency in ball control, and their exceptional teamwork were evident, and it was clear that this was a team that could compete with the best.

translations.source: የአምስተርዳም ከተማ እና የአና ፍራንክ ሙዚየም ባለሥልጣናት ዛፉ በፈንገስ ተይዞ የመውደቅ አደጋ ስለተጋረጠበት የህዝብ ጤናን አደጋ ላይ ይጥላሉ ብለው ይከራከራሉ።
translations.reference: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.hypothesis: Officials from Amsterdam city and the Anne Frank House are warning the public about the potential health risks posed by the tree, which they say is at risk of falling due to fungal infection.

translations.source: ማክሰኞ እንዲቋረጥ ቀጠሮ ተይዞ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከአስቸኳይ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በኋላ ድኗል።
translations.reference: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.hypothesis: Although a court date had been set for Tuesday, it was cancelled due to an urgent court order.

translations.source: “ሰባቱ እህቶች” ተብለው የተጠሩ የዋሻ መግቢያዎች ሁሉ ቢያንስ ከ 100 እስከ 250 ሜትር (ከ 328 እስከ 820 ጫማ) ዲያሜትር አላቸው።
translations.reference: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.hypothesis: The "seven sisters," as they are known, are all burrows with a diameter of at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet).

translations.source: ታህተቀይ ምስሎች ከማታ እና ቀን የሙቀት ልዩነቶቹ ዋሻዎች እንደሚሆኑ ያሳያሉ።
translations.reference: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.hypothesis: The contrasting images of sunrise and sunset illustrate the differences in temperature between day and night.

translations.source: "በቀን ከከባቢው ገፅታ አንፃር ቀዝቃዛ እና ማታ ላይ ደሞ ሞቃት ናቸው።
translations.reference: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.hypothesis: "The weather is cool during the day, but becomes warmer in the evening."

translations.source: የሙቀት ባህሪያቸው ዓለም ላይ እንዳሉ ቋሚ ሙቀት እንደሚጠብቁ ትላልቅ ዋሻዎች የማይንቀሳቀስ አይደለም፣ ግን እነዚህ በመሬት ውስጥ ጥልቅ ጉድጓዶች ከመሆናቸው ጋር ተስማሚ ነው፣” አለ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ስነምድራዊ ጥናት (ዩኤስጂኤስ) አስትሮጂኦሎጂ ቡድን እና በፍላግስታፍ፣ አሪዞና የሚገኘው ሰሜን አሪዞና ዩኒቨርሲቲ ግሌን ከሺንግ።
translations.reference: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: "Large, stable cavities in the ground, which maintain a constant temperature, are ideal for these organisms, as they allow them to remain in one place," said Dr. Ashton, a member of the U.S. Geological Survey's astrobiology team, and Glen Shing, a professor at Northern Arizona University in Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: በፈረንሳይ ድምጽ መስጠት በተለምዶ ዝቅተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ተሞክሮ ነበረው፥ መራጮች እራሳቸውን በዳስ ውስጥ ያገለሉ ፣ የመረጡትን እጩ የሚያመለክት ቀድሞ-የታተመ ወረቀት ወደ ፖስታ ውስጥ ያስገባሉ።
translations.reference: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, voting in France involved a relatively low-tech process. Voters would mark their chosen candidate on a pre-printed ballot and then mail it in.

translations.source: ባለሥልጣናት የመራጩን ማንነት ካረጋገጡ በኋላ መራጩ ፖስታውን ወደ መስጫ ሳጥኑ ውስጥ ይጥልና የምርጫውን ዝርዝር ይፈርማል።
translations.reference: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.hypothesis: Once the authorities have verified the identity of the voter, the voter will cast their ballot in a ballot box and then sign the official election record.

translations.source: የፈረንሣይ የምርጫ ሕግ ክርክሮችን በጥብቅ ይደግፋል።
translations.reference: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.hypothesis: The French electoral law is strongly supported by the French government.

translations.source: ከ1988 ጀምሮ፣ የምርጫ ኮሮጆዎች በምርጫው መጀመሪያ ላይ ምንም ፖስታዎች እንደሌሏቸው እና በምርጫው መጨረሻ ላይ ደግሞ ከተቆጠሩት እና ፍቃድ ከተሰጣቸው መራጮች ውጪ ሌሎች ፖስታዎች እንዳልገቡ መራጮች እና ታዛቢዎች እንዲያረጋግጡ ወደ ውስጥ የሚያሳዩ መሆን አለባቸው።
translations.reference: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.hypothesis: Since 1988, election observers have been instructed to note whether there were any unsolicited mailings at the beginning of the election and whether any mailings arrived after the election that were not addressed to registered voters and for which no authorization had been obtained.

translations.source: እጩዎች እያንዳንዱን የሂደቱን ክፍል እንዲታዘቡ ተወካዮችን መላክ ይችላሉ። ምሽት ላይ ድምፆች የተወሰኑ አሰራሮችን በመከተል በከባድ ቁጥጥር በበጎ ፈቃደኞች ይቆጠራሉ።
translations.reference: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.hypothesis: Applicants can send representatives to oversee each stage of the process. At the end of the process, the results will be tallied according to a strict set of procedures.

translations.source: ወጪን ለመቆጠብ እና ለአሠራር ሁኔታዎች በዓለም ዙሪያ ቀደም ብሎ የተለቀቀው ኤሰስ ኢኢኢ ኮምፒውተር፣ በ 2007 ታይፔ አይቲ ወር ላይ ትኩስ ርዕሰ ጉዳይ ሆነ።
translations.reference: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.hypothesis: The SS-1100 computer, which was developed to reduce costs and provide better operational capabilities, became a major focus at the 2007 Taipei IT Expo.

translations.source: ግን ኤሰስ የ2007 የታይዋን ብርቱ ሽልማት ውስጥ በየቻይና ሪፐብሊክ አስፈፃሚ ዩዋን ከተሸለመ በኋላ በላፕቶፕ ኮምፒውተር ላይ የሸማቹ ገበያ በፍጥነት ይለያያል እንዲሁም ይለወጣል።
translations.reference: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.hypothesis: However, since Acer won the prestigious Taiwan Information and Communication Technology Excellence Awards in 2007, the laptop market in the Republic of China has seen a rapid and significant shift in consumer preferences.

translations.source: የጣቢያው ዌብሳይት ትርዒቱን እንዲህ ሲል ይገልጸዋል “የድሮ ትምህርት ቤት የሬዲዮ ቲያትር በአዲስ እና በሚያስደነግጥ የጌጣጌጥ ሽክርክሪት!
translations.reference: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.hypothesis: The website describes the old school radio theatre as "a revamped and exciting theatrical experience!"

translations.source: በቀደምት ጊዜያት ዝግጅቱ በበይነመረብ በሚሰራጨው በሬዲዮ ወሬ ላይ በሚያተኩረው የቶጊኔት የሬዲዮ ድረገጽ ላይ ብቻ ይተላለፍ ነበር።
translations.reference: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.hypothesis: In the past, the program was only broadcast on the Togene Radio station, which operated exclusively on the internet.

translations.source: በ 2015 መገባደጃ ላይ ቶጊኔት አስትሮኔት ሬዲዮን እንደ አንድ ንዑስ ጣቢያ አቋቋመ።
translations.reference: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.hypothesis: In late 2015, Togiynet Astronomy Radio was established as a subsidiary station.

translations.source: ትዕይንቱ በመጀመሪያ የምሥራቅ ቴክሳስ አካባቢ የሆኑ አማተር የድምፅ ተዋንያንን አሳይቷል።
translations.reference: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: The scene initially featured amateur voice actors from the eastern part of Texas.

translations.source: በቢሽኬክ ጎዳናዎች ላይ የህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ባለመገኘታቸው ሌሊቱን ሙሉ ሰፊ ዝርፊያ እንደቀጠለ ይነገራል።
translations.reference: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.hypothesis: Reports suggest that the looting continued throughout the night, as law enforcement officials were not present on the streets.

translations.source: ቢሽኬክ በአንድ ታዛቢ ወደ “ስርዓት አልበኝነት” ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደገባች የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ የዱርዬዎች ስብስብ በጎዳናዎች ላይ እየተዘዋወረ የሸማቾች የዕቃዎች መደብሮችን እየዘረፈ ነበር።
translations.reference: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.hypothesis: Bishkek had reportedly fallen into a state of "disorder," with piles of garbage scattered throughout the streets and overflowing marketplaces.

translations.source: በርካታ የቢሽከክ ነዋሪዎች የደቡብ ሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞችን ህግ ባለማክበራቸው ወቅሰዋቸዋል።
translations.reference: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.hypothesis: Many residents of Bishkek criticized the government for not enforcing laws regarding peaceful protests.

translations.source: ሩስተንበርግ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ባለው በንጉሳዊው ባፎከንግ ስቴዲየም በራግቢ ህብረት የሶስት ሀገሮች ግጥሚያ ላይ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ኦል ብላክስ (ኒውዚላንድ)ን አሸነፈቻቸው።
translations.reference: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The South African national rugby team, the Springboks, defeated New Zealand in the Tri-Nations rugby match held at the Nelson Mandela Bay Stadium in Port Elizabeth, South Africa.

translations.source: የኦል ብላክ የ15 ጨዋታ በማሸነፍ የሚያጠናቅቅበት የመጨረሻ ውጤት አንድ ነጥብ ነበር ፤ 21 ለ 20 ፡፡
translations.reference: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.hypothesis: The final score for the O'Black team was one point, with a score of 21 to 20, after winning 15 games.

translations.source: ለ ስፕሪንግቦክስ የአምስት ግጥሚያዎችን የመሸነፍ ጎዙ አጠናቋል።
translations.reference: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.hypothesis: Springbooks has completed its five-game winning streak.

translations.source: ከሁለት ሳምንት በፊት ዋንጫ ለበሉት ኦል ብላክስ ይሄ የመጨረሻ ውድድር ነበር።
translations.reference: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.hypothesis: Two weeks ago, this was the final match of the season for the Black Stars, who won the championship.

translations.source: የስፕሪንግቦክስ አውስትራሊያ በሚገጥምበት ጊዜ፣ የተከታታይ የመጨረሻ ግጥሚያ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ጆሃንስበርግ ውስጥ በሚገኘው ኤሊስ ፓርክ ውስጥ ይካሄዳል።
translations.reference: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.hypothesis: When the Springboks face Australia, the highly anticipated final match will take place next week at Ellis Park in Johannesburg.

translations.source: ሰኞ 10:08 ፒ.ኤም መጠነኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምዕራብ ሞንታናን አንቀጠቀጣት።
translations.reference: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.hypothesis: Monday, 10:08 PM – Moderate earthquake shakes western Montana.

translations.source: ለዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ስነምድራዊ ጥናት (USGS) ሆነም ለብሄራዊ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ መረጃ ማዕከሉ ምንም አይነት አስቸኳይ የአደጋ ዘገባዎች አልደረሱም።
translations.reference: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.hypothesis: Neither the United States Geological Survey (USGS) nor the National Earthquake Information Center (NEIC) received any emergency reports regarding the earthquake.

translations.source: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ማእከል የነበረው፣ ከሰሜናዊ-ሰሜንምስራቅ ዲሎን 20 ኪ.ሜ (15 ማይል) አካባቢ ሲሆን ከቡቴ በስተደቡብ ደግሞ 65 ኪ.ሜ (40 ማይል) ያህል ነበር።
translations.reference: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.hypothesis: The epicenter of the earthquake was located approximately 20 kilometers (15 miles) north-northwest of Dilo, and about 65 kilometers (40 miles) south of Buta.

translations.source: የሰው ልጆችን ሊገድል የሚችል የወፍ ጉንፋን ዘለላ፣ ኤች5ኤን1፣ በምስራቅ ፈረንሳይ ከሊዮን አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ ረግረጋማ መሬት ውስጥ፣ ሰኞ የተገኘ የሞተ የዱር ዳክዬን ማጥቃቱ ተረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.hypothesis: A deadly African forest ant, Hymenopus coronatus, capable of killing humans, has been found in a swampy area near Lyon, in southeastern France. The discovery of a dead duck killed by the ant was confirmed on Monday.

translations.source: በአውሮፓ ህብረት ውስጥ በዚህ ቫይረስ ከተጎዱት ሰባተኛ ሀገር ፈረንሳይ ናት፤ ኦስትሪያን፣ ጀርመንን፣ ስሎቬንያን፣ ቡልጋሪያን፣ ግሪክን እና ከጣሊያንን ተከትላ።
translations.reference: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.hypothesis: France is the seventh European country affected by this virus, following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece, and Italy.

translations.source: ክሮኤሺያ እና ዴንማርክ ውስጥ የ ኤች5ኤን1 የተጠረጠሩ ኬዞች እንዳልተረጋገጡ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.hypothesis: H5N1 influenza viruses have not been detected in Croatia or Denmark.

translations.source: ቻምበርዎች “በተስፋፋ ሞት ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ የምድር ነዋሪዎችን ጥፋት እና ሽብርተኝነት” አምላክን ከሰው ነበር።
translations.reference: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.hypothesis: The chambers were filled with the sounds of "death, the destruction of millions of people, and widespread terror."

translations.source: "አዳራሾች፣ ተጠራጣሪ የሆነ ሰው፣ ክሱ "የማይረባ" ነው እናም "ማንም ማንንም ሊከስ ይችላል" ሲል ይከራከራል።
translations.reference: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.hypothesis: "The defendant claims that the charges are baseless, that the "crime" is nonexistent, and that "anyone can be accused of anything"."

translations.source: በፈረንሳይ ኦፔራ በካሚል ሴንት-ሳን የቀረበው የታሪክ ትእይንት “ሕይወቱ ለአደንዛዥ ዕፅ እና ለጃፓን ፍቅር ባለው ሰው ነው የሚተነተነው”።
translations.reference: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.hypothesis: The historical drama presented in the French opera, "La vie d'un homme amoureux de la drogue et du Japon," is based on the life of a man who was deeply involved in both drug use and Japanese culture.

translations.source: ስለዚህም አቅራቢዎቹ የሐሺሽ ጥቅሎችን በመድረክ ላይ ያጨሳሉ፣ ቲያትሩ እራሱ ሰዎች እንዲቀላቀሉ እያበረታታ ነው።
translations.reference: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the vendors place the popcorn on tables in the theater, encouraging people to come and enjoy it together.

translations.source: የቀድሞው የምክር ቤት አፈ ጉባኤ ኒውት ጊንግሪች ፣ የቴክሳስ ገዥ ሪክ ፔሪ እና የምክርቤት አባል ሚሼል ባችማን በቅደም ተከተል በአራተኛ ፣ አምስተኛ እና ስድስተኛ ደረጃን ይዘው አጠናቀዋል።
translations.reference: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.hypothesis: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas Governor Rick Perry, and House member Michele Bachmann graduated from the fourth, fifth, and sixth grades in that order.

translations.source: ውጤቱ ከመጣ በኋላ ጊንሪች ሳንቶረምን አድንቀዋል ፣ በአዮዋ ውስጥ አሉታዊ የዘመቻ ማስታወቂያዎች በተላለፉበት በሮምኒ ላይ ግን ከባድ ቃላት ወርውረዋል።
translations.reference: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: After the results were announced, the Republican campaign in Iowa focused on criticizing Romney, while the Democratic campaign in New Hampshire focused on highlighting his strengths.

translations.source: ፔሪ “የዛሬ ምሽት የምክክር ጉባኤ ውጤቶችን ለመገምገም ፣ በዚህ ውድድር ውስጥ ለራሴ ወደፊት የሚሄድበት መንገድ ይኑር አይኑር ለመለየት ወደ ቴክሳስ እመለሳለው” በማለት ገልፀው በኋላ ግን በውድድሩ ውስጥ እንደሚቆዩ እና በጥር 21 የደቡብ ካሮላይና የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ እንደሚወዳደሩ ገልፀዋል።
translations.reference: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: "I'm returning to Texas to review the results of last night's meeting and to determine the best path forward for myself in this race," Perry stated. However, he later clarified that he would continue to participate in the race and that he would be running in the Democratic primary in South Carolina on January 21.

translations.source: በኦገስት የአሜስ ስትሮው ምርጫን ያሸነፈችው ባችማን ዘመቻዋን ለማቆም ወሰነች።
translations.reference: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann decided to end her campaign after losing the August Ames straw poll.

translations.source: ፎቶግራፍ አንሺው ወደ ሮናልድ ሬገን UCLA የሕክምና ማዕከል ተጓጉዞ ከዚያ በኋላ ሞተ።
translations.reference: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.hypothesis: The photographer traveled to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center and then died.

translations.source: በዘገባው መሰረት ዕድሜው 20ዎቹ ውስጥ ነበር። አንድ መግለጫ ውስጥ፣ ቢበር “በዚህ አደጋ ላይ ያልተገኘሁ ወይም ከዚህ ጋር በቀጥታ ያልተገናኘሁ ሲሆን፣ ሃሳቤ እና ፀሎቴ ከሟች ቤትሰቦች አይለይም።” ብሏል።
translations.reference: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.hypothesis: According to the statement, he was in his twenties at the time. In one statement, he said, "I was not involved in the accident, nor was I directly connected to it. My thoughts and prayers are with the families of the deceased."

translations.source: ፎቶግራፍ አንሺው በሴፕልቬዳ ቡሌቫርድ ማዶ ላይ ተሽከርካሪውን አቁሞ መንገዱን ከማቋረጡ እና ከመቀጠሉ በፊት የፖሊስ ማቆሚያውን ፎቶግራፍ ለማንሳት በመሞከር የካሊፎርኒያ አውራ ጎዳና ላይ የትራፊክ ማቆሚያውን በመቆጣጠር ላይ የነበረ የፖሊስ መኮንን፣ ሁለት ጊዜ ወደኋላ እንዲመለስ ትእዛዝ እንደሰጠው፣ የመዝናኛ ዜና ድርጣቢያ TMZ ይረዳል።
translations.reference: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.hypothesis: According to TMZ, a celebrity photographer was trying to photograph a police officer who was directing traffic on Sepulveda Boulevard when the officer ordered him to move his car and return to the opposite side of the street before he could proceed.

translations.source: ፖሊስ ባለው መሰረት፣ ፎቶግራፈሩን የገጨው ተሽከርካሪ ሹፌር የወንጀለኛ ቅጣት የመቀበል ዕድሉ እጅግ አናሳ ነው።
translations.reference: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.hypothesis: According to police reports, the driver of the vehicle that ran over the photographer will likely face criminal charges.

translations.source: በቀን የሚገኙ አስራ ስምንት ሜዳሊያዎችን ብቻ በማግኘት፣ በርካታ ሀገሮች የሜዳሊያ መድረክን መስራት ተስኗቸዋል።
translations.reference: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.hypothesis: Despite only winning eighteen medals throughout the Games, several countries have been unable to achieve their medal goals.

translations.source: እነሱ፣ አና ጆቼምሰን ሱፐር-ጂ ውስጥ የሴቶች ቋሚ ክፍል ውስጥ ዘጠነኛ በመጨረሷ ኔዘርላንድስን፣ እና ካትጃ ሳሪነን በተመሳሳይ ዝግጅት አስረኛ በመጨረሷ ፊንላድን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.hypothesis: These include the Netherlands, which finished ninth in the UEFA Women's Euro, and Finland, which finished tenth in the same tournament.

translations.source: የአውስትራሊያው ሚቼል ጎርሊ በወንዶቹ የቁም ሱፐር-ጂ ውስጥ አስራ አንደኛ ሆኖ ጨረሰ። የቼክ ተፎካካሪ ኦልድሪች ጄሊኔክ በወንዶቹ ወንበር ሱፐር-ጂ ላይ አስራ ስድስተኛ ሆኖ ጨረሰ።
translations.reference: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Australian Mitchell Gollin finished in 11th place in the men's super-giant slalom. Czech competitor Oldřich Jelínek finished in 16th place in the men's super-giant slalom.

translations.source: የሜክሲኮው አርሊ ቬላስከዝ በወንዶች የቁጭታ ሱፐር-ጂ አስራ አምስተኛ ሆኖ ጨርሷል። የኒው ዚላንዱ አዳም ሆል በወንዶቹ የቁም ሱፐር-ጂ ሆኖ ጨርሷል።
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mexico's early Velaquez finished fifth in the men's 100-meter sprint. New Zealand's Adam Hole finished fifth in the men's 100-meter sprint.

translations.source: ማየት የተሳናቸው የፖላንድ ወንዶች የበረዶ ተንሸራታች ማኪጅ ክረዝል እና መሪው ኣና ኦጋርዝይንስካ ሱፐር-ጂ ላይ ዐሥራ ሦስተኛ ሆነው አጠናቀዋል። የሳውዝ ኮሪያው ሰኦርክ ፓርክ በወንዶች መቀመጫ ሱፐር-ጂ ሃያ አራተኛ ሆኖ አጠናቋል
translations.reference: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Polish male skiers, including Piotr Dybala and Anna Ogarzynska, finished 13th and 14th respectively in the Super-G event. South Korean skier Seo-yeong Park finished fourth in the men's Super-G event.

translations.source: ከ 2010 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በኋላ ወደ ሃይቲ የገቡት የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ሃይሎች በጦር ሰፈሩ አቅራቢያ ለጀመረው የበሽታ ስርጭት ተጠያቂ ናቸው ተብሏል።
translations.reference: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.hypothesis: According to reports, the United Nations peacekeeping forces deployed in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake are being blamed for the outbreak of a disease.

translations.source: በተጠቀሰው ክስ መሠረት ከተባበሩት መንግሥታት ካምፕ የተወሰደ ቆሻሻ በትክክል የንጽሕና አጠባበቅ አልነበረውም ይህም ባክቴሪያዎች ትልቁን ወደ ሄይቲ ወደ አንዱ ወ ደሆነው የአርቢኒየን ወንዝ ገለል ብለው እንዲገቡ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.hypothesis: According to the specified report, the waste collected from the camp established by the participating countries was not properly disposed of, allowing bacteria to enter the Artibonite River and contribute to its pollution.

translations.source: ወታደሮች ከመድረሳቸው በፊት ሄይቲ ከ 1800ዎቹ ጀምሮ ከበሽታው ጋር የተያያዙ ችግሮች አጋጥሟት አያውቅም።
translations.reference: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.hypothesis: Before the arrival of the soldiers, Haiti had been struggling with health-related problems since the 1800s.

translations.source: የሄይቲ የፍትህና የዴሞክራሲ ተቋም የኔፓል የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ሻለቃ ባለማወቅ በሽታውን ወደ ሃይቲ ያመጣ መሆኑን የሚያመለክቱ ገለልተኛ ጥናቶችን ዋቢ አድርጓል።
translations.reference: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: The Haitian justice and democracy institutions have cited independent studies that suggest that the spread of the disease to Haiti was due to the negligence of the UN peacekeeping force, which failed to prevent its entry.

translations.source: ዳንዬል ላንታኝ፣ በበሽታው ዙሪያ የ ዩኤን ባለሙያ፣ ስርጭቱ በሰላም ጠባቂዎች የተከሰተ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ጠቅሳለች።
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.hypothesis: Daniel Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, suggested that the outbreak may have been caused by peacekeepers.

translations.source: ሀሚልተን የሃዋርድ ዩኒቨርስቲ ሆስፒታል ታማሚውን በተረጋጋ ሁኔታ መቀበሉን አረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.hypothesis: Humilten, at the Howard University Hospital, has confirmed its ability to provide stable and reliable care to patients.

translations.source: በሽተኛው በናይጄሪያ ነበር አንዳንድ የኢቦላ ቫይረስ የተከሰተበት ስፍራ።
translations.reference: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.hypothesis: The first Ebola virus outbreak occurred in Nigeria.

translations.source: ሆስፒታሉ የኢንፌክሽን ቁጥጥርን ለመከላከል፣ ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ለመከላከል በሽተኛውን ከሌሎች ጋር መለየትን ጨምሮ ፕሮቶኮልን የተከተለ ነበር።
translations.reference: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.hypothesis: The hospital followed protocols to prevent infections, including isolating patients from others to minimize the risk of transmission.

translations.source: ከ ዘ ሲምፕሰንስ በፊት ሳይመን በተለያዩ ቦታዎች በበርካታ ትርኢቶች ላይ ሠርቶ ነበር።
translations.reference: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.hypothesis: Before joining "The Simpsons," he worked on various television shows in different locations.

translations.source: በ1980ዎቹ ዘመን እንደ ታክሲ፣ ቺርስ እና ዘ ትሬይሲ ኡልማን ሾው ያሉ ዝግጅቶች ላይ ሠርቷል።
translations.reference: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.hypothesis: She worked on shows like "Taxi," "Cheers," and "The Tracey Ullman Show" in the 1980s.

translations.source: በ1989 ዘ ሲምሰንስን ከብሩክስ እና ጎሮኢኒንግ ጋር ለመፍጠር አግዟል እናም የፊልሙን የመጀመሪያ የጽሑፍ ቡድን የመቅጠር ኃላፊነትም የእሱ ነበር።
translations.reference: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.hypothesis: In 1989, he co-founded the Zime Sen Sin film company with Bruce and Goro, and he was also responsible for forming the film's initial writing team.

translations.source: በ1993 ዝግጅቱን ቢለቅም ኤክስኪዩቲቭ ፕሮዲውሰር ማዕረጉን ይዞ፣ በየክፍሉ በአስር ሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ዶላሮችን እንደ ባለመብት ሲቀበል ቆይቷል።
translations.reference: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.hypothesis: Despite abandoning the project in 1993, the executive producer has continued to receive royalties, estimated at over $10 million, for his share of the profits.

translations.source: ቀደም ብሎ የቻይና የዜና ኤጀንሲ ሺንሁዋ አንድ አውሮፕላን ሊታገት እንደሆነ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.hypothesis: Earlier, China's state-run news agency, Xinhua, reported that a Chinese aircraft had been grounded.

translations.source: በኋላ ላይ የውጡት ዘገባዎች፣ አውሮፕላኑ የቦንብ ዛቻ ደርሶት ወደ አፍጋኒስታን በማዞር፣ በካንዳሃር ማረፉ ተገልጿል።
translations.reference: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Later reports indicated that the aircraft, having reached its operational limit, had turned back from its mission to Afghanistan and landed at Kandahar.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያዎቹ ዘገባዎች አውሮፕላኑ በኡሩምቂ የድንገተኛ ጊዜ ማረፍ ከተከለከለ በኋላ ወደ አፍጋኒስታን ተመልሷል ይላሉ።
translations.reference: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: The initial reports indicate that the plane was diverted to Afghanistan after being unable to land at the emergency landing site in Urumqi.

translations.source: በኢራን ውስጥ የአየር አደጋዎች የተለመዱ ናቸው፣ ለውትድርናም ለህዝብም ክንዋኔዎች በመጥፎ ሁኔታ የተያዙ ያረጁ መርከቦች አሉት።
translations.reference: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.hypothesis: Air accidents are common in Iran, and there have been several incidents that have resulted in significant loss of life and property damage.

translations.source: እንደ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች አዳዲስ አውሮፕላኖችን መግዛት አይቻልም ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.hypothesis: It is not possible for international airlines to purchase new aircraft.

translations.source: በዚህ ሳምንት መጀመሪያ፣ አንድ የፖሊስ ሄሊኮፕተር አደጋ ሶስት ሰዎችን ገድሎ ሶስት ሰዎችን ደግሞ አቅስሏል።
translations.reference: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.hypothesis: At the beginning of this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and injured three others.

translations.source: ባለፈው ወር ኢራን ወደ አርሜኒያ የሚሄድ ኤርላይነር የመከስከስ አደጋ ሲደርስበትና 168 ሰዎችን ሲገል በዓመታት ያላየችውን እጅግ የከፋ የአየር አደጋን አይታለች።
translations.reference: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.hypothesis: In the previous month, Iranian Airlines experienced a major accident during a flight to Armenia, resulting in the loss of 168 lives. This was the worst air disaster the country had seen in years.

translations.source: በዚያው ወር በማሽሃድ አንድ ሌላ አውሮፕላን ከማረፊያው በማለፍ ግድግዳ መትቶ ዐሥራ ሰባት ሰዎችን ገድሏል።
translations.reference: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.hypothesis: In the same month, another plane crashed into a building while taking off from a nearby airport, killing 27 people.

translations.source: ኤሮስሚዝ በጉዞአቸው ላይ የነበሩትን ቀሪ ኮንሰርቶች ሰርዘዋል።
translations.reference: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.hypothesis: They have completed the remaining concerts on their tour.

translations.source: የሮክ ባንዱ እስከ ሴፕቴምበር 16 ድረስ ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና ካናዳን ለመጎብኘት ቀጠሮ ነበረው።
translations.reference: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.hypothesis: The rock band had planned to travel to the United States and Canada between September 1 and 16.

translations.source: መሪ ዘፋኙ ስቲቨን ታይለር ኦገስት 5 ላይ እየዘፈነ ከመድረክ ከወደቀ በኋላ ጉዳት ስለደረሰበት ጉብኝቱን ሰርዘዋል።
translations.reference: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.hypothesis: The singer, Steven Taylor, was seen being escorted away from the stage after falling during his performance on August 5.

translations.source: ሙሬይ ሁለቱም ወንዶች እያንዳንዱን የተወረውን ኳስ ከያዙ በኋላ የመጀመሪያውን የአቻ መስበሪያ ተሸነፈ።
translations.reference: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.hypothesis: In the end, both boys won the first round of the match after each had successfully scored a goal.

translations.source: ዴል ፖትሮ በሁለተኛው ዙር ቀዳሚ ጥቅም ነበረው፣ ግን ይህም 6-6 ከደረሱ በኋላ የአቻ መለያ አስፈለገው።
translations.reference: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Dell Potro was the favorite to win in the second round, but the match ended in a 6-6 tie.

translations.source: ፖትሮ በዚህ ጊዜ ለትከሻው ሕክምና አገኘ ግን ወደ ጨዋታው ለመመለስ ቻለ።
translations.reference: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.hypothesis: Potro received treatment for his injury, but was able to return to the game.

translations.source: መርሃ ግብሩ 8:30 ፒ.ኤም እንደ አካባቢው አቆጣጠር (15.00 ዩቲሲ) ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: The meeting began at 8:30 AM local time (15:00 UTC).

translations.source: በመላ አገሪቱ ያሉ ዝነኛ ዘፋኞች የባጃን ወይም የአምልኮ ዘፈኖችን ለሺሪ ሽያም እግሮች ስር አቀረቡ።
translations.reference: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.hypothesis: Renowned musicians across the country performed traditional religious songs, often accompanied by drumming and chanting, for the Shiri (a type of traditional Ethiopian dance).

translations.source: ምሽቱን የጀመረው ዘፋኙ ሳንጁ ሻርማ ነበር፣ ተከትሎ ጃይ ሻንካር ቹድሃሪም chhappan bhog bhajan ን አስደምሟል። ዘፋኙ ራጁ ካንደልዋል አብሮት ነበር።
translations.reference: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: The evening began with the performance of Sanjay Sharma, followed by Jay Shankar Chudhary's rendition of "Chhappan Bhog Bhajan." The duo was accompanied by Raj Kanwal.

translations.source: ከዚያ በኋላ፣ ላካ ሲንግ ባጃንን ለመዘመር ግንባር ቀደም ሆነ።
translations.reference: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: After that, Laka Sing became a leading figure in the performance of the traditional song, "Bajane."

translations.source: 108 የሻፓንግ ቡሆግ (በሂንዱይዝም ውስጥ 56 የተለያዩ የሚበሉ ነገሮች፣ ለምሳሌ፣ ጣፋጮች፣ ፍራፍሬዎች ፣ ለውዝ ፣ ሙሉ ምግብ ወዘተ.የመሳሰሉት ለአማልክት የሚቀርቡ) ለ ባባ ሺያም ቀርበዋል።
translations.reference: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: 108 offerings of Champak (56 different items offered to the gods in Hinduism, such as sweets, fruits, flowers, and complete meals, etc.) were presented to Baba Shiyam.

translations.source: ላካ ሲንግ የ chhappan bhog bhajan ንም አቅርቧል። ዘፋኙ ራጁ ካንደልዋል አብሮት ነበር።
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.hypothesis: The singer, Raju Kandelwal, performed the "Chhappan Bhog Bhajan."

translations.source: በሐሙሱ የቶኪዮ ጨዋታ ትርኢት መክፈቻ አቅርቦት ላይ የኒንቴንዶ ፕሬዝደንት ሳቶሩ ኢዋታ የኩባንያውን አዲሱን የኒንቴንዶ ሬቮሉሽን መሳሪያ ተቆጣጣሪውን ዲዛይን አቀረቡ።
translations.reference: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.hypothesis: On Tuesday, Nintendo President Satoru Iwata unveiled the company's new revolutionary controller, the Wii, during the Tokyo Game Show opening presentation.

translations.source: የቴሌቪዥን ሪሞት በመምሰል፣ መቆጣጠሪያው አቅጣጫውን በሶስት-ገፅታዊ ቦታ ለመከፋፈል ከተጠቃሚው ቴሌቪዥን አጠገብ የሚቀመጡ ሁለት ሴንሰሮችን ይጠቀማል።
translations.reference: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.hypothesis: By using a television remote, the device divides the user's television area into three sections using two sensors located on either side of the television.

translations.source: ይህ ተጫዋቾችን፤ በቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች ላይ መሣሪያውን በአየር ላይ በማንቀሳቀስ ድርጊቶችን እና እንቅስቃሴዎችን እንዲቆጣጠሩ ያስችላቸዋል።
translations.reference: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.hypothesis: This allows players to control the device in video games, enabling them to perform actions and movements by manipulating it in the air.

translations.source: ጂያንካርሎ ፊሲቼላ መኪናውን መቆጣጠር አቅቶት ገና ከጅምሩ ውድድሩን አቋረጠ።
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella immediately lost control of his car and crashed out of the race at the very beginning.

translations.source: የቡድን አባሉ ፈርናንዶ ኣሎንሶ ለአብዛኛው ውድድር መሪ ነበረ፤ ነገር ግን ለፍተሻ ከቆመ ቡኃላ ተጠናቀቀ፤ ምክኒያቱም በመጥፎ ሁኔታ የገባ የፊት ጎማ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.hypothesis: The team's captain, Fernando Alonso, was initially expected to lead the charge, but he was forced to withdraw due to concerns about his physical condition. There was a possibility that he might not be able to perform at his best due to the challenging track conditions.

translations.source: ሚካኤል ሽማከር ውድድሩ ከአሎሶ ብዙም ሳይቆይ አቋርጧል፣ ምክንያቱም በውድድሩ ወቅት በነበሩት በርካታ ውጊያዎች ላይ በደረሰበት የሰስፔንሽን አደጋ ምክንያት።
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.hypothesis: The Michael Schumacher competition was abruptly halted due to a serious accident during one of the races.

translations.source: "እሷ በጣም ቆንጆ ናት እና በጣም ጥሩም ትዘፍናለች፣ ብሏል በዜና ጉባኤው ግልባጭ መሠረት ነው።"
translations.reference: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.hypothesis: "According to a news report, she is very beautiful and also has a great sense of humor," the report stated.

translations.source: "በዚህ ላይ ልምምድ በምናደርግበት ጊዜ ሁሉ ስሜቴ ይቀሰቀስ ነበር፣ ከልቤ።"
translations.reference: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.hypothesis: "Every time I tried to do this, I felt a sense of unease, deep down inside."

translations.source: ከተነሳ 3 ደቂቃዎች አካባቢ፣ አንድ የተንቀሳቃሽ ካሜራ ከነዳጅ ታንክ ውስጥ በርካታ የሙቀት መጠበቂያ አረፋዎች ሰብረው ሲወጡ ያሳያል።
translations.reference: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.hypothesis: Approximately 3 minutes into the recording, a moving camera captures several coolant hoses detaching from a fuel tank.

translations.source: ነገር ግን፣ ለመንኮራኩሩ ምንም ጉዳት አድርሰዋል ተብሎ አይታሰብም።
translations.reference: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.hypothesis: However, it seems that the incident did not cause any harm to the crocodile.

translations.source: የናሳ መንኮራኩር ፕሮግራም ሃላፊ ኤን ዌይን ሀሌ ጁኒየር “እኛ ከሚያሳስበን ጊዜ በኋላ” አረፋው ወድቋል ብለዋል።
translations.reference: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.hypothesis: NASA's Mars rover program director, En Weyn Hale Junior, stated, "We have overcome many challenges along the way."

translations.source: በመስታወቱ አምስት ደቂቃ በኋላ ንፋሱ መግባት ይጀምራል፣ ከአንድ ደቂቃ በኋላ ንፋሱ 70ኪ.ሜ/ሰዓ. እየደረሰ ነው… ከዛ ዝናቡ ይመጣል ነገር ግን በጣም ከባድ እና ትልቅ ከመሆኑ የተነሳ ቆዳህን እንደ መርፌ ይመታዋል ከዛ በረዶ ከሰማይ ወረደ፣ ሰዎች እየደነገጡ እና እየጮሁ እና እርስ በራሳቸው ላይ ይሮጣሉ።
translations.reference: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.hypothesis: Five minutes later, the wind begins to pick up, and within a minute, it's gusting at 70 km/h… Then comes the hail, but it's so heavy and large that it tears at your skin. Afterwards, the snow falls from the sky, and people are running and shouting, trying to avoid being hit.

translations.source: እህቴን እና ጓደኛዋን አጣሁ እና በመንገዴ ላይ ሁለት አካል ጉዳተኞች በዊልቼር ላይ ነበሩ ፣ ሰዎች ዝም ብለው እየዘለሉ ይገፏቸው ነበር" አርማንድ ቬርሴስ እኝደተናገረው።
translations.reference: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.hypothesis: "I lost my sister and her friend, and I saw two disabled people in a wheelchair on the road. People were just standing by and watching," said Armand Verses.

translations.source: ኤንኤችኬ በኒጋታ ጠቅላይ ግዛት የሚገኘው የካሺዋዛኪ ካሪዋ የኒኩሊየር ኃይል ማመንጫ እንደተለመደው እየሰራ እንደነበር ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.hypothesis: Reports indicated that the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant, located in Niigata Prefecture, Japan, was operating normally.

translations.source: ሆኩሪኩ የኤሌትሪክ ኃይል ኮ. ከመሬት መንቀጥቀጡ ምንም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ እና እናም በሺካ የኒውክሊየር ኃይል ማመንጫ ያሉት ቁጥር 1 እና ቁጥር 2 ሬክተሮች እንደተዘጉ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.hypothesis: According to reports, the Hokuriku Electric Power Company has not experienced any damage from the earthquake, and the No. 1 and No. 2 nuclear power plants in Nishikari remain operational.

translations.source: በክልሉ ውስጥ ወደ 9400 የሚጠጉ ቤቶች ውሃ የላቸውም ፣ እና በግምት 100 የሚሆኑ ቤቶች ደግሞ መብራት አልባ ናቸው ተብሏል።
translations.reference: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.hypothesis: According to reports, approximately 9,400 homes in the region lack access to water, and around 100 homes are also without electricity.

translations.source: አንዳንድ መንገዶች ተጎድተዋል ፣ በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች የባቡር አገልግሎት ተቋርጧል እንዲሁም በኢሺካዋ መስተዳድር የሚገኘው የኖቶ አየር ማረፊያ እንደተዘጋ ነው።
translations.reference: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.hypothesis: Some roads have been damaged, and train services have been suspended in the affected areas. Additionally, the Noto Airport, located in the city of Ichiwa, has been closed.

translations.source: ከአገረ-ገዢው ጄኔራል ጽ/ቤት ውጭ አንድ ቦምብ ፈነዳ።
translations.reference: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.hypothesis: A bomb exploded outside the General Staff headquarters.

translations.source: በሁለት ሰዓት ውስጥ ሦስት ተጨማሪ ቦምቦች በመንግሥት ሕንፃዎች አቅራቢያ ፈንድተዋል።
translations.reference: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.hypothesis: Three additional bombs were detonated near government buildings within a two-hour period.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ዘገባዎች ይፋዊውን የሞት ብዛትን ስምንት ያደረጉ ሲሆን ይፋዊው ሪፖርቶች እስከ 30 የሚደርሱ ሰዎች እንደቆሰሉ አረጋግጠዋል፡፡ ግን የመጨረሻ ቁጥሮች ገና አልታወቁም።
translations.reference: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.hypothesis: Some reports indicate that the official death toll is eight, while other reports suggest that up to 30 people have died. However, the final figures are still unknown.

translations.source: ሁለቱም ሲያኑሪክ አሲድ እና ሜላሚን የተባሉ ንጥረ ነገሮች የቤት እንስሳት የተመረዘ ምግብ በልተው ሲሞቱ በሽንት ናሙናቸው ላይ ተገኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.hypothesis: The two substances, melamine and Sudan dye, were detected in the urine samples of animals that had consumed contaminated feed, leading to their deaths.

translations.source: ሁለቱ ውህዶች የኩላሊትን ስራ ሊያግድ የሚችሉ ክሪስታሎችን ለመስራት እርስ በርስ ይቀላቀላሉ፣ በዩኒቨርሲቲው ጥናት አድራጊዎች ተናገሩ።
translations.reference: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.hypothesis: The two compounds combine to form crystals that can damage the kidneys, according to a study conducted by university researchers.

translations.source: ተመራማሪዎቹ ሜላሚን እና ሲያኑሪክ አሲድ በመጨመር በድመት ሽንት ውስጥ የተፈጠሩ ክሪስታሎችን ተመልክተዋል።
translations.reference: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine after the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.

translations.source: የእነዚህ ክሪስታሎች ጥንቅር ከኢንፍራሬድ ስፔክትሮስኮፒ (FTIR) በኩል ሲታይ በተጎዱ የቤት እንስሳት ሽንት ውስጥ ከሚገኙት ጋር ይዛመዳል።
translations.reference: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: The composition of these crystals, as determined by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), correlates with the compounds found in the urine of affected animals.

translations.source: እርስዎ ይገነዘቡት ወይም አይገነዘቡት አላውቅም ፣ ግን ከመካከለኛው አሜሪካ የሚመጡ አብዛኛዎቹ ዕቃዎች ወደዚህ ሀገር የመጡት ከቀረጥ ነፃ ነው።
translations.reference: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.hypothesis: Whether you are aware of it or not, most goods coming from the Midwest of the United States are imported into this country duty-free.

translations.source: ሆኖም በመካከለኛው የአሜሪካ ሀገራት የዕቃዎቻችን ሰማኒያ ፐርሰንት በታሪፎች ምክንያት ታክስ ይቆረጥበታል። እኛ እንሸፍንልዎታለን።
translations.reference: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to tariffs, the customs duties on our goods in the middle American countries will be waived. We will absorb these costs.

translations.source: ይህ ለእኔ ትርጉም ያለው አልመሰለኝም፤ በእውነቱ አግባብ አልነበረም።
translations.reference: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.hypothesis: I didn't really understand what you were saying; it didn't make sense to me.

translations.source: ለሰዎች የምላቸው ነገር፤ እኛ እንደምናስተናግድዎ አስተናግዱን ነው።
translations.reference: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.hypothesis: We appreciate your feedback and hope you enjoyed your experience with us.

translations.source: የካሊፎርኒያ ገዥው አርኖልድ ሽዋርዚኔገር የአመጽ ቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎችን መሸጥ ወይም ማከራየትን ለታዳጊዎች የሚከለክል ህግን ተፈራርሟል።
translations.reference: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.hypothesis: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger has signed a law that prohibits the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

translations.source: ህጉ በካሊፎርኒያ ግዛት ውስጥ የሚሸጡ አመፀኛ ቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎች "18" በሚል ፅሑፍ ምልክት እንዲደረግባቸው እና ከዚያ ዓመት በታች ለሆነ ልጅ መሸጥ በአንድ ጥፋት $1000 የሚያስቀጣ ነው።
translations.reference: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.hypothesis: In the state of California, video games that depict violence are required to be labeled "18+" and selling them to minors under that age carries a fine of $1,000.

translations.source: የሕዝባዊ ዓቃቤ ሕግ ዳይሬክተር አቶ ኪየር ስታርመር ኪው.ሲ ዛሬ ጠዋት በሁኔ እና በፕራይስ ላይ ክሶች መከሰቱን አስታውቋል።
translations.reference: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: Mr. Kyer Starmer, Director of the National Prosecution Service, announced this morning that there have been cases of corruption involving officials in the Hun and Price departments.

translations.source: ሁህኔ ስልጣናቸውን ለቀዋል እና በካቢኔው ውስጥ በፓርላማ አባሉ Ed Davey ይተካሉ። የፓርላማ አባል ኖርማን ላም የቢዝነስ ሚኒስትር ዴቪድ እየለቀቀው ያለውን ስራ ይወስዳል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
translations.reference: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.hypothesis: They have resigned from their positions and Ed Davey, a Member of Parliament, is expected to take over as Business Secretary. Norman Lamb, another Member of Parliament, is likely to take over David Cameron's role as Health Secretary.

translations.source: ሁህኔ እና ፕራይስ በዌስትሚኒስተር ማጅስትሬትስ ፍርድ ቤት እንዲቀርቡ ፌብርዋሪ 16 ቀን ቀጠሮ ተይዞላቸዋል።
translations.reference: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.hypothesis: They have been scheduled to appear in the Westminster Magistrates' Court on February 16.

translations.source: ሌላው ውድድሯ በግዙፉ ስላሉም በሴቶች ቡድን ውስጥ በተደመረ ሰዓት 4:41.30 ዐሥረኛ ሆና ስትጨርስ አየናት፣ ከመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጨራሽ ኦስትሪያዊዋ ክላውዲያ ሎአስችህ 2:11.60 ቀስ ያለ እና ዘጠነኛ ከጨረሰችው የሃንጋሪዋ ግዮንግዪ ዳኒ 1:09.02 ያክል የዘገየ ጊዜ ነው።

translations.hypothesis: She finished in 10th place in the women's event, with a time of 4:41.30, which was not as fast as the leading Austrian, Claudia Loaschitz, who finished in 2:11.60, or as fast as the Hungarian, Gyongyi Dani, who finished in 1:09.02.

translations.source: አጠቃላይ የክስ አቅራቢ የሆነው የአክሊል ቢሮ ለጋዜጠኞች የክስ ማስረጃ እስኪኖር ድረስ ምንም አይነት አስተያየት አይሰጥም ብሏል።

translations.hypothesis: According to the document, which refers to information released by Sholko, the conflict over the border between Palestine and Israel predates the 1967 Six-Day War and reflects Palestine's desire to establish a border along the Green Line.

translations.hypothesis: Other covered topics, as reported, include the implications for both countries and Jordan regarding the Jerusalem issue, and the future status of Jerusalem.

translations.source: እስራኤል አንድ ስምምነት ከተፈረመ በኋላ ለአስር ዓመታት በሸለቆው ውስጥ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ መገኘት ትፈልጋለች፣ PA በበኩሉ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን መገኘት ለአምስት ዓመታት ብቻ እንዲሆን ይስማማል።

translations.source: ተጨማሪ የተባይ ቁጥጥር ሙከራ ውስጥ ተኳሾች በጠባቂዎች ቅርብ ቁጥጥር ይደረግባቸዋል ሙከራው በቁጥጥር ሥር ስለ ዋለ እና ውጤታማነቱ ስለ ተገመገመ።

translations.reference: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.hypothesis: Through the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia's (SSAA) wildlife management program, in partnership with the National Parks and Wildlife Service (NPWS) and the Australian Sporting Shooters Association (ASSIA) Inc., qualified individuals were able to obtain permits.

translations.source: በሚክ ኦ’ፍሊን፣ ከኤንፒደብሊውኤስ ጋር የፓርክ ጥበቃ እና ቅርስ ተጠባባቂ ዳይሬክተር መሰረት፣ ለመጀመሪያው የተኩስ ስራ የተመረጡት አራቱ ተኳሾች አጠቃላይ የደህንነት እና ስልጠና ትዕዛዝ ተቀብለዋል።
translations.reference: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.hypothesis: According to Mike O'Flan, Director of Park Protection and Heritage at NPS, the four shooters were selected for the first round of the competition after they successfully passed a comprehensive security and training assessment.

translations.source: ማርቴሊ ዘጠኝ አባላት ባሉት አዲስ የሽግግር ምርጫ ምክር ቤት (ሲኢፒ) ውስጥ ቃል ገብቷል።
translations.reference: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.hypothesis: Martel has pledged to participate in the newly formed transitional election council (TEC) consisting of nine members.

translations.source: ይህ በአራት ዓመታት ውስጥ የማርቴሊ አምስተኛው CEP ነው።
translations.reference: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.hypothesis: This is the fifth CEP (Comprehensive Economic Recovery Plan) for Ethiopia in the last four years.

translations.source: ያለፈው ወር ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ኮሚሽኑ ሀገሪቷን ወደ አዲሱ ምርጫ የሚወሰዷቸው እርምጃዎች ጥቅል አካል የሲኢፒን ቀድሞ መልቀቅን መክረዋል።
translations.reference: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.hypothesis: Last month, the Presidential Commission announced that the country would move forward with the new election process, effectively reversing the previous decision to disband the CPI.

translations.source: ኮሚሽኑ በጥቅምት ወር ለተጀመረው ሰፊ የፀረ-አገዛዝ ተቃውሞዎች የማርቲሊ ምላሽ ነበር።
translations.reference: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.hypothesis: The commission was established in response to the widespread anti-government protests that began in October.

translations.source: የአንዳንዴ-ዓመፃዊ ሰላማዊ ሰልፎች የሚነሱት ምርጫዎችን ካለማድረግ ነው አንዳንዶቹ ከ2011 ጀምሮ።
translations.reference: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Protests and demonstrations, often peaceful, have erupted in recent years, with some beginning as early as 2011.

translations.source: ወደ 60 የሚጠጉ የአይፖዶች ከመጠን በላይ መሞቅ ጉዳዮች ብልሽት ሪፖርት የተደረጉ ሲሆን፤ በአጠቃላይ ስድስት የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በመከሰታቸው አራት ሰዎችን መጠነኛ ቃጠሎ እንዲደርስባቸው አድርጓል።
translations.reference: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.hypothesis: Reports have been filed regarding numerous incidents of faulty iPod batteries, with a total of six fires resulting in four people suffering minor burns.

translations.source: የጃፓን የኢኮኖሚ፣ ንግድ እና ኢንዱስትሪ ሚኒስትር (ኤምኢቲአይ) ከመሳሪያዎቹ ጋር የተያያዙ 27 አደጋዎችን እንዳወቀ ተናግሯል።
translations.reference: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.hypothesis: The Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) announced that he had identified 27 potential risks related to the use of Japanese technology.

translations.source: ባለፈው ሳምንት፣ METI አፕል ኩባንያው “ከባድ ያልሆኑ” ብሎ የጠራቸውን 34 ተጨማሪ ከመጠን በላይ የመሞቅ ክስተቶች እንዳሳወቀው ገልጿል።
translations.reference: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.hypothesis: Last week, METI, the regulatory body, revealed that Apple had reported an additional 34 "minor" incidents of over-the-top marketing.

translations.source: ሚኒስትሩ የአፕልን የዘገባ ማሸጋገር "በዕውነቱ አሳዛኝ" በማለት ምላሹን ሰጥቷል።
translations.reference: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.hypothesis: The minister responded to the announcement about the apple harvest by saying that it was "quite disappointing."

translations.source: የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ማሪናን በ 07:19 ኤ.ኤም. በአካባቢው ሰዓት (አርብ 09:19 ፒ.ኤም ጂኤምቲ) ላይ መታት።
translations.reference: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.hypothesis: The ground shook violently at 07:19 AM local time (Friday, 09:19 PM GMT).

translations.source: የሰሜን ማሪያናስ ድንገተኛ አደጋዎች ማኔጅመንት ጽሕፈት ቤት፣ በሃገሪቱ ውስጥ ሪፖርት የተደረጉ ጉዳቶች የሉም ብሏል።
translations.reference: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.hypothesis: The Northern Mariana Islands Office of Civil Defense reports that there have been no reported incidents in the territory.

translations.source: እንዲሁም የፓስፊክ ሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ማዕከል የሱናሚ ምልክት እንደሌለ ተናግሯል።
translations.reference: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.hypothesis: In addition, the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center stated that there is no evidence of a tsunami.

translations.source: አንድ የቀድሞ የፊሊፒንስ ፖሊስ የፊሊፒንስ ዋና ከተማ በሆነችው ማኒላ ውስጥ አንድ አውቶቡስ በመጥለፍ የሆንግ ኮንግ ቱሪስቶች አግቶ ቆይተዋል።
translations.reference: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.hypothesis: A former Filipino police officer has been arrested in Manila, the capital of the Philippines, for allegedly kidnapping Hong Kong tourists.

translations.source: ሮላንዶ ሜንዶዛ የ M16 ጠመንጃውን በቱሪስቶች ላይ ተኩሷል።
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at tourists.

translations.source: በርካታ ታጋቾችን ማዳን ተችሏል እናም እስካሁን በትንሹ ስድስት እንደሞቱ ተረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.hypothesis: Many people have been rescued, and at least six have been confirmed dead.

translations.source: ሕፃናትንና አዛውንትን ጨምሮ ስድስት ታጋቾች፣ እንዲሁም የፊሊፒኖ ፎቶ ባለሞያዎች ቀደም ብለው ተለቀዋል።
translations.reference: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.hypothesis: Six contestants, including children and elderly individuals, as well as several Filipino photographers, have already been eliminated.

translations.source: መጸዳጃ ቤት መሄድ ስለፈለገች ፎቶ አንሺዎቹ ያረጀችዋን ሴትዮ ቦታ ወሰዱ። ሜንዶዛ በሽጉጥ ተገደለች።
translations.reference: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.hypothesis: The photo shows a woman standing in front of a laundromat, apparently waiting for her clothes to be finished. Mendoza is seen in the background.

translations.source: ሊጊንስ የአባቱን ፈለግ በመከተል የሕክምና ስራ ውስጥ ተቀላቀለ።
translations.reference: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.hypothesis: Lingins joined the medical profession by following in his father's footsteps.

translations.source: በማኅፀናት ሐኪምነት ሥልጠና አግኝተው በ 1959 በኦክላንድ ብሔራዊ የሴቶች ሆስፒታል መሥራት ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.hypothesis: After receiving training in obstetrics and gynecology, she began working at the Oakland County Hospital for Women in 1959.

translations.source: በሆስፒታል ውስጥ በሚሰራበት ጊዜ ሊጊንስ በትርፍ ጊዜው ስለ ቀድሞ የሚመጣ ምጥ ማጥናት ጀመረ።
translations.reference: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.hypothesis: While working at the hospital, Leegin began to study how the previous night's events might affect his work the following day.

translations.source: የእርሱ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው ሆርሞን ከተሰጠ የሕፃኑን የፅንስ የሳንባ ብስለት ያፋጥናል።
translations.reference: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.hypothesis: According to his research, the hormone disrupts the embryo's ability to implant in the uterus.

translations.source: የመንግስት መርማሪዎች ረቡዕ ዕለት ሁለት ‘የጥቁር ሣጥን’ የበረራ መቅጃዎችን ማግኘታቸውን ዢንህዋ ዘግቧል።
translations.reference: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.hypothesis: According to Xinhua, government investigators discovered two "black box" recorders on Wednesday.

translations.source: አብረዋት የሚሠሩ ታጋዮችም ለሉና ሃዘናቸውን ገለጹ፡፡
translations.reference: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Those who were present also expressed their grief and condolences.

translations.source: ቶሚ ድሪመር እንዳሉት “ሉና የመጀመሪያዋ የፅንፈኛ ንግሥት ነበረች። የእኔ የመጀመሪያ ሥራ አስኪያጅ። ሉና በሁለት ጨረቃዎች ምሽት አረፈች። ልክ እንደ እርሷ ልዩ ቆንጆ። ጠንካራ ሴት።"
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.hypothesis: As Tom Driver put it, "Luna was the first female CEO. She was my first manager, and she was a truly unique and inspiring woman. She was strong, intelligent, and always willing to go the extra mile."

translations.source: ደስቲን “ጎልደስት” ረነልስ በሰጡት አስተያየት “ሉና እንደ እኔ በጣም እብድ ነበረች… ምናልባት ከኔ የበለጠ… እወዳታለሁ እና ትናፍቀኛለች… በተሻለው ቦታ እንደምትኖር ተስፋ አለን።”
translations.reference: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.hypothesis: Destin "Golden" shared his thoughts: "Luna was really amazing... maybe even more so than me... I loved her and I think she loved me too. We hoped she would find a good place to live."

translations.source: ከ2010 ፌደራላዊ ምርጫ በፊት ከመረጡት 1,400 ሰዎች ውስጥ፣ የአውስትራሊያን ሪፐብሊክ መሆን የሚቃወሙት ከ2008 አንስቶ በ8 በመቶ አደጉ።
translations.reference: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Among the 1,400 people surveyed before the 2010 federal elections, the number of those who opposed Australia becoming a republic increased by 8% since 2008.

translations.source: ተጠባባቂ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጁሊያ ጊላርድ በ 2010 የፌዴራል ምርጫ ዘመቻ ወቅት ንግስት ኤልሳቤጥ II በንግሥና ማብቂያ አውስትራሊያ ሪፐብሊክ መሆን አለባት ብለው እንደሚያምኑ ተናግረዋል።
translations.reference: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.hypothesis: Prime Minister-designate Julia Gillard stated that during the 2010 federal election campaign, Queen Elizabeth II believed that Australia should become a republic before her reign ended.

translations.source: ከድምጽ መስጫ ጣቢያው ውስጥ 34 በመቶ የሚሆኑት ይህንን አመለካከት የሚጋሩ ሲሆን ንግስት ኤልሳቤጥ II የአውስትራሊያ የመጨረሻዋ ንግስት እንድትሆን ይፈልጋሉ።
translations.reference: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.hypothesis: According to a recent poll, 34% of respondents believe that Queen Elizabeth II should be the last monarch of Australia.

translations.source: በምርጫው ጫፎች ላይ፣ ከተጠኑት ውስጥ 29 በመቶዎቹ አውስትራሊያ በተቻለ ፍጥነት ሪፐብሊክ መሆን እንዳለባት ሲያምኑ፣ 31 በመቶዎቹ ደግሞ አውስትራሊያ መቼም ሪፐብሊክ መሆን እንደሌለባት ያምናሉ።
translations.reference: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.hypothesis: In the survey, 29% of respondents believed that Australia should become a republic as quickly as possible, while 31% believed that Australia would never become a republic.

translations.source: የኦሎምፒክ ወርቅ አሸናፊው በ100ሜ እና 200ሜ በነጻ የዋና ውድድር እኛ በኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ላይ ሦስት ዱላ ቅብብሎሽ ነው ነገር ግን በቀሬታዎቹ ምክንያት የአካል ብቃቱ በጥርጣሬ ላይ ነበር።
translations.reference: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.hypothesis: The Olympic gold medalist in the 100m and 200m races, who also won three Commonwealth Games titles, faced uncertainty regarding his eligibility due to concerns about his physical condition.

translations.source: ከጨዋታዎቹ የተከለከሉ በመሆናቸው ህመሙን ለመቋቋም የሚያስፈልጉትን መድኃኒቶች መውሰድ አልቻለም።
translations.reference: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.hypothesis: Because the games were banned, they were unable to access the medications they needed to cope with the pain.

translations.source: በማዕከላዊ ሚዙሪ ዩኒቨርሲቲ የሂሳብ ሊቅ እና የኮምፒተር ሳይንስ ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑት ከርቲስ ኩፐር፣ እስከ ጃንዋሪ 25 ቀን ድረስ ትልቁን የብቸኜ ቁጥር አግኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.hypothesis: Dr. Curtis Cooper, a professor of mathematics and computer science at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number as of January 25.

translations.source: ብዙ ሰዎች የተለያዩ ሃርድዌሮችን እና ሶፍትዌሮችን በመጠቀም ግኝቱን እስከ የካቲት መጀመሪያ ድረስ አረጋግጠው ማክሰኞ ይፋ ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.hypothesis: The breakthrough was confirmed on Monday, with multiple people using various hardware and software to verify the results by the beginning of February.

translations.source: ኮሜቶች ምናልባት ፕሮቲኖችን ሊፈጥሩ እና ህይወትን ሊደግፉ ከሚችሉ ኦርጋኒክ ንጥረ ነገሮች ጋር ወደ ምድር የውሃ አቅርቦት ምንጭ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.hypothesis: Comets may be composed of organic molecules that could have delivered water to Earth and supported the development of life.

translations.source: ኮሜቶች ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ከምድር ጋር ተጋጭተው ስለነበረ የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት ፕላኔቶች እንዴት እንደሚፈጠሩ በተለይም ምድር እንዴት እንደተመሰረተ ለመረዳት ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
translations.reference: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists hope that, thanks to recent discoveries, they will be able to understand how planets form, particularly how the Earth was created, after it was first formed long ago.

translations.source: የ 53 ዓመቱ ኩሞ አገዛዙን የጀመረው በዚህ ዓመት መጀመሪያ ላይ ሲሆን ተመሳሳይ የወሲብ ጋብቻን ሕጋዊ ለማድረግ ባለፈው ወር ተፈረመ።
translations.reference: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.hypothesis: The 53-year-old King Kumo began his reign earlier this year, and a law legalizing same-sex marriage was passed last month.

translations.source: አሉባታዎቹን «የፖለቲካ ሁካታ እና ጅልነት» ሲል ጠቅሷቸዋል።
translations.reference: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.hypothesis: He described the actions as "political maneuvering and manipulation."

translations.source: በ 2016 ለፕሬዚዳንትነት እንደሚወዳደሩ ይገመታል።
translations.reference: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.hypothesis: I suspect that he is considering running for president in 2016.

translations.source: NextGen፣ FAA አንድ አውሮፕላን በየዓመቱ ሚሊየን ጋሎን ነዳጅ እንዲቆጥብ እና የካርቦን ልቀትን እንዲቀንስ አጭር ጉዞዎችን እንዲያረግ ያስችላል ብሎ የሚያውጀው ሥርዓት ነው።
translations.reference: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.hypothesis: NextGen is a system developed by the FAA that allows airlines to track fuel consumption and reduce carbon emissions for each flight, thereby enabling shorter flights.

translations.source: ከቀድሞው መሬት-ራዳር ላይ የተመሠረተ ቴክኖሎጂ በተቃራኒ፣ የአየር ትራፊክ ተቆጣጣሪዎች አውሮፕላኖችን በከፍተኛ ትክክለኛነት እንዲለዩ እና ለአውሮፕላን አብራሪዎች የበለጠ ትክክለኛ መረጃ እንዲሰጡ ለማድረግ በሳተላይት ላይ የተመሠረተ ቴክኖሎጂን ይጠቀማል።
translations.reference: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike the previous ground-based radar technology, air traffic controllers use satellite-based technology to identify aircraft with greater accuracy and provide pilots with more precise information.

translations.source: ተጨማሪ ጉዞ እየተጨመረ አይደለም እናም ከመሬት በላይ የሚሄዱ ባቡሮች ዌምብሌይ ላይ አይቆሙም፤ እናም መኪና ማቆሚያ እኛ አቁመው-ይጓዙ ተቋማት መሬት ላይ አይገኙም።
translations.reference: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.hypothesis: There are no additional train routes, and the trains do not stop at Wembley. Furthermore, there are no parking facilities for cars near the train station.

translations.source: የመጓጓዣ እጦት ፍርሃቶች ጨዋታው በተዘጉ በሮች ውስጥ ያለቡድኑ ደጋፊዎች እንዲካሄድ የመገደዱን ዕድል ጨመሩት።
translations.reference: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.hypothesis: The lack of transportation options made it more difficult for supporters to attend the game, as they were unable to easily get to the stadium.

translations.source: በሳይንስ መጽሔት ውስጥ ሐሙስ ቀን የታተመ አንድ ጥናት፣ በኢኳዶሪያን ጋላፓጎስ ደሴቶች ላይ አዲስ የወፍ ዝርያ ስለመፍጠር ሪፖርት ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.hypothesis: A study published in a scientific journal on Thursday reported the discovery of a new species of bird on the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador.

translations.source: ዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ውስጥ የፕሪንስተን ዩኒቨርሲቲ እና የስዊድን ውስጥ አፕሳላ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ጥናት አድራጊዎች በብርቅዬ ዳርዊን ፊንች፣ ጂኦስፒዛ ፎርቴስ፣ እና በውጩ ካክተስ ፊንች፣ ጂኦስፒዛ ኮኒሮስትሪስ መካከል መራባት ምክንያት፣ ይህ ሂደት የበለጠ ረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚወስድ ይገመት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ ዝርያ በሁለት ትውልዶች ብቻ መፈጠሩን ዘግበዋል።
translations.reference: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Researchers at Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden have observed a new species of prickly pear cactus, *Opuntia*, emerging in the areas between Bryce Canyon National Park, Goblin Valley State Park, and the White Rim Mesa in Utah. While it was initially thought that this process would take several generations, the new species has apparently appeared in just two generations.

translations.source: ወርቅ ወደ ሁሉም ዓይነት ቅርፆች መሰራት ይችላል። ወደ ትንንሽ ቀርፆች መጠቅለል ይችላል።
translations.reference: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.hypothesis: Gold can be cast into various shapes, including small, intricate designs.

translations.source: መታጠፍ እና መጎንጎን ወደሚችል ቀጭን ሽቦ መለጠጥ ይችላል። ወደ ልሙጥነት መቀጥቀጥ ወይም መጠቅለል ይችላል።
translations.reference: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.hypothesis: It can be cleaned and shaped into a small wire. It can also be melted or molded.
