translations.source: በጣም ቀጭን ሆኖ ይሰራና እና በሌላ ብረት ላይ ይጣበቃል። በጣም ቀጭን ሆኖ መሰራት ከመቻሉ የተነሳ "ኢሉሚኔትድ ማኑስክሪፕትስ" በተባሉ መጻሕፍት ውስጥ በእጅ የተሳሉ ስዕሎች ላይ ለማስዋቢያነት የሚያገለግል ነበር።
translations.reference: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: It was made very thin and could be easily attached to other metal. Due to its thinness, it was used to create intricate drawings in manuscripts known as "Illuminated Manuscripts."

translations.source: ይህ የአንድ ኬሚካል ፒኤች ይባላል። የቀይ ጥቅል ጎመን ፈሳሽን ተጠቅመው ጠቋሚ መስራት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.hypothesis: This is called a chemical pH. It can be used to test the acidity of tomato juice.

translations.source: የጥቅል ጎመን ጁስ በኬሚካሉ አሲድነት ወይም ቤዝነት (አልካሊ) መሠረት ቀለም ይቀይራል።
translations.reference: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.hypothesis: The color of the tomato juice changes depending on whether it is acidic or alkaline (basic).

translations.source: በተሞከረው ኬሚካል ውስጥ ያለው የpH መጠን በሃይድሮጂን (H በ pH ውስጥ) አዮኖች መጠን ያመለክታል።
translations.reference: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.hypothesis: The pH level in a tested chemical indicates the concentration of hydrogen (H+) ions.

translations.source: የሃይድሮጂን አዮኖች ኤሌክትሮኖቻቸው የተወሰደባቸው ፕሮቶኖች ናቸው (ስለዚህ የሃይድሮጂን አተሞች አንድ ፕሮቶን እና አንድ ኤሌክትሮን ይይዛሉ)።
translations.reference: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.hypothesis: Hydrogen atoms are composed of one proton and one electron, with the electron having been removed from the proton.

translations.source: ሁለቱን ደረቅ ዱቄቶች አንድ ላይ በመፈተግ፣ ከዚያም በንጹህ እርጥብ እጆች ወደ ኳስ ይጫኗቸው።
translations.reference: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.hypothesis: Mix the two dry powders together, then carefully pour them into the bowl using clean, dry hands.

translations.source: በእጆችዎ ላይ ያለው እርጥበታማነት ከውጭ ንብርብሮች ጋር ይጋጫል ፣ ይህም አስቂኝ ስሜት ያለው እና አንድ ዓይነት ዛጎል ይሠራል።
translations.reference: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.hypothesis: The moisture on your hands creates a slippery sensation, similar to that of a wet, mossy surface, which can be both intriguing and slightly unsettling.

translations.source: የሃራፓ እና ሞሄንጆ-ዳሮ ከተሞች በተራቀቀ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃ ስርዓት የተያያዘው በእያንዳንዱ ቤት ውስጥ ፍላሽ ያለው መጸዳጃ ክፍል ነበራቸው።
translations.reference: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.hypothesis: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had sophisticated sewage systems, with individual houses featuring flushing toilets.

translations.source: የፍሳሽ ስርዓቱ ቅሪቶች በግሪክ ውስጥ በሚኖኣን ከተሞች ክሬቴ እና ሳንቶሪኒ ቤቶች ውስጥ ተገኝተዋል።
translations.reference: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.hypothesis: Traces of the ancient fluid system have been found in homes in the Greek islands of Crete and Santorini.

translations.source: በጥንት ግብፅ ፣ በፋርስ እና በቻይና መፀዳጃ ቤቶችም ነበሩ። በሮማውያን ሥልጣኔ ውስጥ መጸዳጃ ቤቶች አንዳንድ ጊዜ ወንዶችና ሴቶች በተቀላቀሉበት አንድ ላይ በሚገኙባቸው የሕዝብ መታጠቢያ ቤቶች ውስጥ አንድ አካል ነበሩ።
translations.reference: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.hypothesis: In ancient Egypt, Persia, and China, there were public bathhouses. During the Roman Empire, bathhouses were sometimes communal spaces where men and women could bathe together.

translations.source: በሺዎች በሚቆጠሩ ማይሎችን ርቆ ለሚኖር ሰው ሲደውሉ፣ ሳተላይትን እየተጠቀሙ ነው።
translations.reference: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.hypothesis: When calling someone who lives in a vast area spanning thousands of miles, they use satellite communication.

translations.source: በጠፈር ላይ ያለው ሳተላይት ጥሪውን ተቀብሎ በቅፅበት መልሶ ያንፀባርቃል።
translations.reference: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite, positioned in orbit, received the signal and immediately re-transmitted it.

translations.source: ሳተላይቱ ወደ ጠፈር በሮኬት ተላከ። የምድር አየር አንዳንዶቹን ብርሃኖች እና እይታዎችን ስለሚቀይር ተመራማሪዎች ጠፈር ላይ ቴሌስኮፖችን ይጠቀማሉ።
translations.reference: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.hypothesis: The satellite was launched into space using a rocket. Researchers on Earth use telescopes to observe the space, as the atmosphere can distort light and images.

translations.source: በጠፈር ላይ ሳተላይት ወይም ቴሌስኮፕን ለማስገባት ከ 100 ጫማ ከፍታ በላይ ያለው አንድ ግዙፍ ሮኬት ያስፈልጋል።
translations.reference: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.hypothesis: A large rocket is needed, with a height of at least 100 feet, to launch a satellite or telescope into space.

translations.source: መንኰራኩር ዓለምን በሚያስደንቅ ሁኔታ ለውጦታል። መንኮራኩሩ ለእኛ ያደረገው ትልቁ ነገር በጣም ቀላል እና ፈጣን መጓጓዣ ስለሰጠን ነው።
translations.reference: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.hypothesis: The automobile has dramatically changed the world. One of the most significant impacts of the automobile is that it has provided us with a fast and convenient mode of transportation.

translations.source: ባቡሩን ፣ መኪናውን እና ሌሎች ብዙ የትራንስፖርት መሳሪያዎችን አምጥቶልናል።
translations.reference: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.hypothesis: He has a car, a bicycle, and many other forms of transportation.

translations.source: በእነሱ ሥር ከጥንቸል እስከ አጋዘን ያሉ መካከለኛ መጠን ያላቸው እንስሶችን የሚበሉ መካከለኛ መጠን ያላቸው ድመቶች አሉ።
translations.reference: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.hypothesis: There are medium-sized rodents that feed on plants and seeds, ranging from voles to weasels.

translations.source: በመጨረሻም ፣ እንደ ነፍሳት ፣ አይጥ ፣ እንሽላሊቶች እና ወፎች ያሉ እጅግ በጣም ብዙ ትናንሽ እንስሳትን የሚበሉ ብዙ ትናንሽ ድመቶች አሉ (ልቅ የሆኑ የቤት እንስሳት ድመቶችን ጨምሮ)።
translations.reference: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, there are many small carnivores that prey on a wide variety of small animals, including insects, reptiles, amphibians, and birds.

translations.source: የስኬታቸው ምስጢር የመስክ ጽንሰ ሃሳብ ነው፣ እያንዳንዱ ድመት ከሌላው ጋር እንዳይፎካከር የሚያደርገው ልዩ ሥራ ነው።
translations.reference: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.hypothesis: The secret to their success lies in their unique ability to communicate and cooperate with each other.

translations.source: አንበሶች መንጋዎች በሚባሉ ትላልቅ ቡድኖች የሚኖሩ፣ በጣም ማሕበራዊ ድመቶች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.hypothesis: Elephants live in large groups called herds, and they are highly social animals.

translations.source: የአንበሳ መንጋዎች የሚመሰረቱት ከአንድ እስከ ሶስት ወጣት ወንዶች፣ ሰላሳ ከሚደርሱ ሴቶች እና ደቦሎች ነው።
translations.reference: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.hypothesis: The ant colonies consist of one to three young males, hundreds of females, and workers.

translations.source: እንስቶቹ ብዙውን ጊዜ እርስ በእርሳቸው በጣም የተዛመዱ ናቸው ፣ ብዙ የእህቶች እና የሴቶች ልጆች ቤተሰቦች ናቸው።
translations.reference: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.hypothesis: The bees are often closely related to each other, forming large colonies with many worker bees and queen bees.

translations.source: አንበሳ መናጋዎች እንደ ተኩላዎች ወይም ውሾች፣ እንደ አንበሳ ላሉ እንስሳዎች (ግን ሌሎች ትላልቅ ድመቶች አይደሉም) እና ለታዳኛቸው በጣም አደገኛ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.hypothesis: Leopards are ambush predators, similar to lions or cheetahs, and are extremely dangerous to other animals, especially those that are smaller than themselves.

translations.source: ነብሩ በደንብ ክብ ቅርጽ ያለው አትሌት፣ መውጣት የሚችል (ምንም እንኳን ጥሩ ባይሆንም) ፣ መዋኘት ፣ ብዙ ርቀቶችን መዝለል እና ከጠንካራ የሰው ኃይል አምስት እጥፍ ጋር መሳብ ይችላል።
translations.reference: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.hypothesis: The athlete possesses a well-defined, muscular physique, capable of running, jumping, and enduring long distances. He also has exceptional strength, allowing him to lift five times his own weight.

translations.source: ነብር እንደ አንበሶች፣ ሌፐርድ እና ጃጓሮች አንድ ዓይነት ቡድን ውስጥ ነው (ጀነስ ፓንትራ)። ማጓራት የሚችሉት እነዚህ አራቱ ድመቶች ብቻ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.hypothesis: Like hyenas, leopards, and jaguars, bears belong to the same family (Ursidae). These are the only four species in that family.

translations.source: የነብር ጩኸት እንደ አንበሳ የሙሉ ድምፅ ጩኸት አይደለም፣ ግን የበለጠ እንደ አረፍተ ነገር ጫጫታ እና ጩኸት ቃላቶች ነው፡፡
translations.reference: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.hypothesis: While a hippo's roar is not as loud as a lion's, it is more of a deep, rumbling sound, with a mix of grunts and vocalizations.

translations.source: ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች ትናንሽ እንስሳትን መብላት ይወዳሉ። ከቻሉ ዝንጀሮዎችን ፣ እባቦችን ፣ አይጥና ወፎችን ይይዛሉ። ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች የሚያድናቸው እንስሳት በሙሉ ማለት ይቻላል ከእነሱ እጅግ ያነሱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.hypothesis: Desert foxes/sand foxes are known to eat small animals. They typically prey on rodents, birds, and reptiles. Desert foxes are opportunistic hunters, and they will eat almost anything that they can catch.

translations.source: የሳይንስ ሊቃውንት ኦሴሎትስ/የበረሃ ድመቶች በምድር ላይ ለነበሩበት ቦታ እየነፉ በማሽተት የሚመገቡትን (እንስሳትን) እንስሳት ተከትለው ያገኛሉ።
translations.reference: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.hypothesis: Scientists have observed that animals follow herds of migrating herbivores (such as gazelles) as these animals move across the landscape, using their sense of smell to detect the presence of the herds.

translations.source: በምሽት ዕይታ በደንብ ማየት ይችላሉ፣ እንዲሁም በጥሩ ሁኔታም መንቀሳቀስ ይችላሉ። ኦሴሎቶች ከአካባቢያቸው ጋር በመመሳሰል የሚታደኑ እንስሳዎችን ያገኛሉ።
translations.reference: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.hypothesis: You can clearly see them at night, and they are also able to move around effectively. You can find animals that resemble the owls in their environment.

translations.source: አነስተኛ ህይወት ያላቸው ነገሮች (አነስተኛ ህዝብ ቁጥር) ከመጡበት ዋና ህዝብ ቁጥር (ለምሳሌ ተራራማ አካባቢ አልፈው ወይም ወንዝ አቋርጠው ወይም በቀላሉ መመለስ ወደ የማይችሉበት አዲስ ደሴት ከተጓዙ) ብዙ ጊዜ እራሳቸውን ከቀድሞው በፊት ከነበሩበት በተለየ አካባቢ ውስጥ ያገኛሉ፡፡
translations.reference: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.hypothesis: When small organisms (with a small population size) migrate from their original habitat (for example, across a mountain range, or past a river, or to an island where they cannot easily return), they often find themselves in a completely different environment than they were before.

translations.source: ይህ አዲስ አከባቢ የተለያዩ ሀብቶች እና የተለያዩ ተፎካካሪዎች አሉት፣ ስለሆነም አዲሱ ዝርያ ከዚህ በፊት ከሚያስፈልገው በላይ ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ለመሆን የተለያዩ ባህሪያትን ወይም ማስተካከያዎችን ይፈልጋል።
translations.reference: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.hypothesis: This new environment presents a variety of resources and competitors, making the new species need to develop specific traits or adaptations to be more competitive than its predecessors.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያው ዝርያ በጭራሽ አልተለወጠም ፣ አሁንም እንደበፊቱ ተመሳሳይ ማመቻቸት ይፈልጋሉ።
translations.reference: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.hypothesis: The initial proposal has not changed; it still requires the same level of modification.

translations.source: በጊዜ ሂደት፣ አዲሱ ህዝብ አዲሱን አካባቢውን መልመድ ሲጀምር፣ ከሌሎች ህዝቦች ጋር ያላቸው መመሳሰል እየቀነሰ ይሄዳል።
translations.reference: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.hypothesis: Over time, as the new population adapts to its new environment, their similarities with other populations tend to diminish.

translations.source: መጨረሻ ላይ፣ ከሺዎች ወይም ከሚሊዮን ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ሁለቱ ህዝቦች በመልክ በጣም ከመለያየታቸው የተነሳ አንድ ዓይነት ዝርያዎች መባል አይችሉም።
translations.reference: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, after thousands or millions of years, the two populations will have diverged so much that they can no longer be considered the same species.

translations.source: ይህንን ሂደት ስፔሺኤሽን እንለዋለን ፣ ይህም ማለት አዲስ ዘሮችን መስራት ማለት ነው። አዲስ ዘሮችን መስራት የማይቀር ውጤት እና የዝግመተ ለውጥ አስፈላጊ አካል ነው።
translations.reference: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.hypothesis: We refer to this process as "specialization," which means creating new varieties. The creation of new varieties is an inevitable outcome and an essential component of adaptation.

translations.source: እጽዋት ሰዎች የሚተነፍሱትን ኦክስጅንን ይሠራሉ ፣ እንዲሁም ሰዎች የሚያወጡትን ካርቦን-ዳይኦክሳይድን ይወስዳሉ (ማለትም ወደ ውጭ የሚተነፈሰውን)።
translations.reference: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.hypothesis: Plants produce the oxygen that humans breathe, and they also absorb the carbon dioxide that humans exhale (i.e., release).

translations.source: እፅዋት ከፀሀይ በብርሃን አስተፃምሮ ምግባቸውን ያዘጋጃሉ። ጥላም ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.hypothesis: Plants absorb sunlight to produce their own food. They also provide shade.

translations.source: ቤቶቻችንን ከእጽዋት እናደርጋለን እንዲሁም ከእጽዋት ልብሶችን እንሰራለን። የምንበላቸው አብዛኛዎቹ ምግቦች እፅዋቶች ናቸው። ያለ ዕፅዋት እንስሳት መኖር አይችሉም።
translations.reference: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.hypothesis: We build our homes from plants, and we make clothing from plant fibers. Most of the food we eat comes from plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.

translations.source: ሞዛሳሩስ የዘመኑ የአዳኞች ቁንጮ ነበር፣ ስለሆነም ከሌሎቹ ሞዛሳሩስ በስተቀር ምንም አይፈራም ነበር።
translations.reference: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.hypothesis: Mozaros was the most prominent poet of his time, and therefore, he was unafraid of anyone except Mozaros himself.

translations.source: ረዣዥም መንገጭላዎቹ ከ 70 በላይ ምላጭ በሚስሉ ጥርሶቻቸው የታጠቁ ሲሆን በአፉ ጣራ ላይ አንድ ተጨማሪ ስብስብ ይዘው ነበር ፣ ይህም ማለት መንገዱን ለሚያልፍ ምንም ማምለጫ የለም ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.hypothesis: The long trucks, each carrying over 70 bales of goods, were equipped with additional cargo securing systems on their roofs, ensuring that nothing could fall out during transit.

translations.source: በእርግጠኝነት አናውቅም ፣ ግን ሹካ የሆነ ምላስ ኖሮት ይሆናል። የእሱ ምግብ ኤሊዎችን ፣ ትልልቅ ዓሳዎችን ፣ ሌሎች ሞሳሶርስ ያካተተ ሲሆን ምናልባትም የራሱን ዘር በይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.hypothesis: We can't be certain, but it's likely to be a large, sluggish fish. Its diet probably consists of eels, large fish, and other types of marine life, and it may even be a top predator in its ecosystem.

translations.source: በውሃው ውስጥ የሚገባ ማንኛውንም ነገርም ያጠቃ ነበር፣ እንደ ቲ.ሬክስ ዓይነት ግዙፍ ዳይኖሰር እንኳን ለሱ አቻ ሊሆን አይችልም።
translations.reference: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.hypothesis: It could affect anything that entered the water, even a massive dinosaur like a T. rex, making it impossible for them to survive.

translations.source: አብዛኛውን ምግባቸውን የምናውቀው ቢሆንም ሮማውያን የዱር ከርከሮ፣ ጣዎስ፣ ቀንድ አውጣዎች እና ዶርማውስ የሚባል የአይጥ አይነትን ጨምሮ እንግዳ ወይም ያልተለመዱ የድግስ ምግቦች ነበሯቸው
translations.reference: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.hypothesis: While we are familiar with many of their common foods, the Romans also consumed unusual and less common delicacies, such as dormice, dormice, and a type of wild rabbit called "cauda equina."

translations.source: ሌላው ልዩነት ደግሞ ድሆቹ እና ሴቶቹ ወንበሮች ላይ ተቀምጠው ምግብ ሲመገቡ፣ ሀብታሞቹ ምግባቸውን በሚመገቡበት ጊዜ በጎን በኩል አብረው የሚዝናኑበት ትልቅ ድግስ ማድረግ ይወዳሉ።
translations.reference: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.hypothesis: Another significant difference is that the wealthy often prefer to dine together, allowing them to socialize and enjoy each other's company while the poor and women typically eat separately.

translations.source: የጥንት የሮማኖች ምግቦች በኋለኞቹ መቶ ዘመናት ከአሜሪካ ወይም ከእስያ ወደ አውሮፓ የመጡ ምግቦችን ማካተት አልቻሉም።
translations.reference: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient Roman cuisine did not include foods that originated in America or Asia, which became popular in Europe over the next two centuries.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ በቆሎ አልነበራቸውም፣ ቲማቲም፣ ድንች፣ ወይም ኮኮዋም ቢሆን አልነበራቸውም እናም አንድም የቱርክ ዶሮ የቀመሰ የጥንት ሮማዊ የለም።
translations.reference: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.hypothesis: For example, they didn't have any onions, tomatoes, lentils, or even cocoa. And, most importantly, there were no traditional Turkish-style roasted chickens.

translations.source: ባቢሎናውያን ለእያንዳንዳቸው አማልክቶቻቸው የአማልክት ቤት ተደርጎ የሚወሰድ ዋና ቤተመቅደስ ሠሩላቸው።
translations.reference: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.hypothesis: The Babylonians built a central temple for each of their gods, which served as their main place of worship.

translations.source: ሰዎች ለአማልክት መስዋእት ያቅርቡ ነበር እናም ካህናቱ በክብረ በዓላት እና በበዓላት አማካይነት ለአማልክቶች ፍላጎቶች ለመከታተል ይሞክሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.hypothesis: People offered sacrifices to the gods, and the priests would try to understand the gods' desires through religious ceremonies and festivals.

translations.source: እያንዳንዱ ቤተ መቅደስ ክፍት የሆነ የቤተመቅደስ ግቢ እና ካህናቱ ብቻ መግባት የሚችሉበት የውስጥ መቅደስ ነበረው።
translations.reference: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.hypothesis: Each church had an open courtyard and a sanctuary that was only accessible to priests.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ልዩ የፒራሚድ ቅርፅ ያላቸው፣ ዚጉራትስ የሚባሉ ማማዎች የመቅደሶቹ አካል እንዲሆኑ ይገነቡ ነበር።
translations.reference: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.hypothesis: Sometimes, pyramids with unique shapes, known as zigurats, were constructed as part of the temple complex.

translations.source: የግንቡ አናት ለአምላኩ ልዩ መቅደስ ነበር።
translations.reference: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.hypothesis: The top of the building was a sacred space dedicated to God.

translations.source: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ሞቃት የአየር ፀባይ፣ ቤቱ ብዙም አስፈላጊ አልነበረም።
translations.reference: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.hypothesis: The warm, dry climate of the Middle East made the house unsuitable for living.

translations.source: አብዛኛው የዕብራውያን ቤተሰብ ሕይወት የሚመራው ከቤት ውጪ ላይ ነበር።
translations.reference: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.hypothesis: The majority of the lives of the Israelites were spent outside the home.

translations.source: ሴቶች በጓሮው ውስጥ ምግብ ያበስላሉ፤ መደብሮች ወደ ጎዳና የሚመለከቱ ክፍት መሸጫ ጠረጴዛዎች ነበሩ። ድንጋይ፣ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት ያገለግል ነበር።
translations.reference: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.hypothesis: Women were shopping for food in the market; stalls lined the street, offering a variety of goods. Stone was used to build houses.

translations.source: በከነዓን ምድር ውስጥ ትላልቅ ደኖች አልነበሩም፣ ስለሆነም እንጨት እጅግ በጣም ውድ ነበር።
translations.reference: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.hypothesis: Because there were few large lakes in the region of Kena, wood was extremely valuable.

translations.source: ግሪንላንድ ተበትኖ ነበር የሰፈረው። በኖርስ ሳጋስ እንደሚናገሩት ከሆነ ኤሪክ ዘ ሬድ በግድያ ወንጀል ከአይስላንድ በግዞት ተሰደደ እናም ወደ ምዕራብ አቅጣጫ ሲጓዝ ግሪንላንድን አገኛት እና ግሪንላንድ ብሎ ሰየማት።
translations.reference: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: Greenland was the place where Erik the Red had established himself. According to Norse sagas, Erik the Red sailed from Iceland and, after being exiled, discovered Greenland and named it so.

translations.source: ግን የእሱ ግኝት ምንም ይሁን ምን፣ የኤስኪሞ ጎሳዎች በወቅቱ እዚያ ይኖሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.hypothesis: Regardless of the discovery, the Eskimo people were living there at the time.

translations.source: እያንዳንዱ ሃገር “ስካንዲኔቪያዊ” የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በዴንማርክ፣ ስዊድን፣ ኖርዌይ እና አይስላንድ ሰዎች፣ ነገስታት፣ ልማዶች እና ታሪክ መካከል ብዙ ልዩነቶች ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: While each country considered itself "Scandinavian," there were many differences between the people, nobles, customs, and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Iceland.

translations.source: ናሽናል ትሬዠር የሚለውን ፊልም ካዩት፣ በነፃነት አዋጁ ጀርባ የሀብት ካርታ እንደተፃፈ ሊያስቡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.hypothesis: When watching the film "National Treasure," viewers might consider the idea that the treasure map, as depicted in the movie, was likely created after the passage of the Emancipation Proclamation.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ ያ እውነት አይደለም። በሰነዱ ጀርባ ላይ የተጻፈ ነገር ቢኖርም፣ ይህ የ ሀብት ካርታ አይደለም።
translations.reference: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.hypothesis: However, that is not the case. While there may be something written on the document, it is not a map of wealth.

translations.source: በነጻነት መግለጫ ጀርባ ላይ የተፃፉት “የነፃነት መግለጫ የመጀመሪያ ቀን ጁላይ 4 ቀን 1776” የሚሉ ቃላት ነበሩ። ጽሑፉ በሰነዱ ታችኛው ክፍል ላይ ተገልብጦ ይታያል።
translations.reference: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.hypothesis: The phrase "Declaration of Independence, July 4, 1776" was written on the back of the document. The text is located at the bottom of the document.

translations.source: ማን እንደፃፈው ማንም በእርግጠኝነት ባያውቅም፣ በህይወቱ መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ ትልቁ የብራና ሰነድ (29¾ ኢንች በ 24½ ኢንች ይለካል) ለመቀመጥ ተጠቅልሏል።
translations.reference: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.hypothesis: While the exact author remains unknown, it is believed that this large sheet of parchment (measuring 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was used for writing at the beginning of his life.

translations.source: ስለዚህ ፣ ማስታወሻው እንደ መለያ ብቻ የታከለ ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, the note could simply be marked as a reference.

translations.source: የዲ-ቀን ማረፊያዎች እና የሚከተሉት ውጊያዎች ሰሜን ፈረንሳይን ነፃ ያወጡ ነበር ፣ ሆኖም ግን ደቡብ አሁንም ነፃ አልወጣም ነበር።
translations.reference: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.hypothesis: The battles in the north liberated Northern France, but Southern France remained under occupation.

translations.source: የሚተዳደረው በ “ቪቺ” ፈረንሳዮች ነበር። እነዚህ በ 1940 ከጀርመኖች ጋር ሰላም የፈጠሩ እና እነሱን ከመዋጋት ይልቅ ከወራሪዎች ጋር አብረው የሠሩ የፈረንሣይ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
translations.reference: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.hypothesis: The Vichy regime was established in France. These were French citizens who made a pact with the Germans in 1940, and instead of resisting the occupation, they collaborated with the enemy.

translations.source: ኦገስት 15 ቀን 1940 አሊያንስ ደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይን ወረሩ ፣ ወረራው “ኦፕሬሽን ድራጎን” ተባለ።
translations.reference: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.hypothesis: On August 15, 1940, the Allies launched an attack on Southern France, which was codenamed "Operation Dragon."

translations.source: በሁለት ሳምንታት ውስጥ ብቻ አሜሪካውያኖቹ እና ነፃ የፈረንሳይ ኃይሎች ደቡብ ፈረንሳይን ነፃ አውጥተው ወደ ጀርመን እየተመለሱ ነበር።
translations.reference: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.hypothesis: Within just two weeks, the Americans and the free French forces had liberated southern France and were returning to Germany.

translations.source: ስልጣኔ ተባብረው በሚኖሩ እና በሚሰሩ ሰፊ ህዝቦች፣ ማሕበረሰብ የሚጋራ ነጠላ ባሕል ነው።
translations.reference: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.hypothesis: Our shared culture is a single, unified culture that arises from the diverse peoples who live and work together.

translations.source: ሲቪላይዜሽን የሚለው ቃል የመጣው ከሲቪሊስ ሲሆን፣ ሲቪል ማለት ነው፣ ከላቲን ሲቪስ ጋር ሲገናኝ፣ ይህ ደግሞ ዜጋ ማለት ነው፣ እንዲሁም ሲቪታስ ማለት ከተማ ወይም የከተማ መስተዳድር ማለት ሲሆን ይህም በሆነ መልኩ የሕብረተሰቡን መጠን ይገልፃል።
translations.reference: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.hypothesis: The word "civilization" comes from the Latin word "civis," which means "citizen." When combined with the Latin word "civitas," it refers to a city or urban administration, and thus represents the scale and complexity of a society.

translations.source: የከተማ-ግዛቶች የሃገሮች ቀደምቶች ናቸው። የሥልጣኔ ባህል በበርካታ ትውልዶች ውስጥ የእውቀት ማስተላለፍን የሚያመለክት ነው ፣ ዘላቂ የባህል አሻራ እና ፍትሃዊ ስርጭትን።
translations.reference: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.hypothesis: Urban centers have historically been the centers of power and culture in nations. The transmission of knowledge and traditions across generations demonstrates the enduring cultural impact and equitable distribution of resources within these centers.

translations.source: አናሳ ባህሎች ብዙውን ጊዜ ጠቃሚ ታሪካዊ ማስረጃን ሳይተዉ ይጠፋሉ እናም እንደ መደበኛ ሥልጣኔ ዕውቅና አያገኙም።
translations.reference: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.hypothesis: Traditional cultures often disappear without leaving behind valuable historical evidence, and they also fail to receive the recognition they deserve from mainstream society.

translations.source: በአብዮታዊ ጦርነት ወቅት አሥራ ሦስቱ ግዛቶች በመጀመሪያ ደካማ ማዕከላዊ መንግሥት አቋቋሙ-ኮንግረሱ ብቸኛ አካል ሆኗቸው ማለት ነው - በኮንፌዴሬሽን አንቀጾች መሠረት።
translations.reference: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: During the revolutionary war, the thirteen colonies established a weak central government – the Continental Congress – as the sole governing body, as stipulated in the Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: ምክር ቤቱ ግብር ለመጣል ስልጣን አልነበረውም፣ እና ምንም ብሔራዊ አስፈፃሚ ወይም ፍርድ ቤት ስለሌለ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ሁሉንም ህጎቹን ለማስፈፀም በማይተባበሩ የግዛት አመራሮች ይተማመን ነበር።
translations.reference: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.hypothesis: The parliament did not have the authority to levy taxes, and therefore, it often relied on the individual governors of each region to enforce all laws, as there was no national executive or court to do so.

translations.source: እንዲሁም በክልሎች መካከል የግብር ህጎችን እና ታሪፎችን የመሻር ስልጣን አልነበረውም።
translations.reference: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, the regions did not have the authority to independently determine their own tax laws and rates.

translations.source: አንቀጾቹ ከመጽደቃቸው በፊት ከሁሉም ክልሎች አንድላይ ፈቃድ ያስፈላጋቸዋል እና ክልሎቹ መዓከላዊ መንግስቱን በትክክል ካልመውሰዳቸው የተነሳ ተወካዮቻቸው በአብዛኛው ቀሪ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.hypothesis: Before the enactment of the constitution, efforts were made to obtain consent from all regions, but due to the central government's failure to effectively represent the interests of the regions, most of the representatives were from the remaining regions.

translations.source: የጣሊያን ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ከጀርመን ብሄራዊ ቡድን ጋር በመቀጠል በዓለም ላይ በጣም ስኬታማ ቡድን ሲሆን በ 2006 የፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ሻምፒዮን ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.hypothesis: The Italian national football team is considered one of the most successful teams in the world, having won the 2006 FIFA World Cup, defeating the German national team in the final.

translations.source: ታዋቂ ስፖርቶች እግር ኳስ፣ ቅርጫት ኳስ፣ መረብ ኳስ፣ ውሃ-ፖሎ፣ የጎራዴ ጨዋታ፣ ራግቢ፣ ሳይክል መንዳት፣ የበረዶ ሆኪ፣ ሮለር ሆኪ እና ኤፍ1 የሞተር ውድድርን ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.hypothesis: The popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water polo, field hockey, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey, and Formula 1 racing.

translations.source: ጣልያኖች በአለም አቀፋዊ ጨዋታዎች እና የኦሎምፒኮች ላይ እየተወዳደሩ ፣ የክረምት ስፖርቶች በጣም የሚታወቁት በሰሜናዊ አካባቢዎች ነው።
translations.reference: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.hypothesis: The Italians are known for their participation in international competitions and the Olympics, and their expertise in winter sports is particularly prominent in northern regions.

translations.source: ጃፓኖች ወደ 7,000 የሚጠጉ ደሴቶችን የያዙ (ትልቁ ደግሞ ሆንሹ ይባላል) ሲሆን ጃፓንን በዓለም 7 ኛ ትልቋ ደሴት ያደርጋታል!
translations.reference: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.hypothesis: Japan possesses over 7,000 islands, the largest of which is Honsu. This makes Japan the seventh-largest island country in the world.

translations.source: ጃፓን ባላት የደሴቶች ስብስብ/ቡድን ምክንያት ጃፓን ብዙውን ጊዜ በጂኦግራፊያዊ አነጋገር "አርኪፔላጎ" ተብላ ትጠራለች
translations.reference: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Due to Japan's collection of islands, it is often referred to geographically as an "archipelago."

translations.source: ታይዋን የጀመረው በ 15 ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ነበር፣ የአውሮፓ መርከበኞች የሚያልፉ ጊዜ የደሴቷን ኢልሃ ፎርሞሳ ወይም ውብ ደሴት ብለው ሰየሟት።
translations.reference: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.hypothesis: Taiwan was first discovered in the 16th century by European explorers, who named the island Ilha Formosa, or "Beautiful Island."

translations.source: በ1624፣ ደች ምስራቅ ህንድ ኩባንያ በደቡባዊ ታይዋን የአገሬዎች የእህል አመራረት ልምዶች ላይ ለውጥን በማነሳሳትና በስኳር እና ሩዝ ፋብሪካዎቹ ውስጥ እንዲሰሩ ቻይናዊ የቀን ሰራተኞችን በመቅጠር መሰረቱን መስርቷል።
translations.reference: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.hypothesis: In 1624, the Dutch East India Company established a base in southern Taiwan by introducing new agricultural practices and employing Chinese laborers to work in its sugar and rice plantations.

translations.source: በ 1683 የቺንግ ሥርወ-መንግሥት (1644-1912) ኃይሎች የታይዋን ምዕራባዊ እና ሰሜናዊ የባህር ዳርቻ አካባቢዎችን ተቆጣጥረው ታይዋንን በ 1885 የቺንግ ኢምፓየር አውራጃ መሆኗን አወጁ።
translations.reference: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.hypothesis: In 1683, the Qing dynasty (1644-1912) controlled the western and northern coastal areas of Taiwan, and in 1885, the Qing Empire formally declared Taiwan a province.

translations.source: በ 1895 የመጀመሪያው የቻይና-ጃፓን ጦርነት (1894-1895) ከተሸነፈ በኋላ የቺንግ መንግስት የሺሞኖስኪን ስምምነት በመፈረም በታይዋን ላይ ሉዓላዊነትን ለጃፓን ያስረከበ ሲሆን ደሴቲቱ እስከ 1945 ድረስ ተቆጣጠራለች።
translations.reference: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.hypothesis: Following their defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signed the Shimonoseki Treaty, ceding Taiwan to Japan. Japan controlled the island until 1945.

translations.source: ማቹ ፒቹ ኢንትኋታና፣ የጸሐይ ቤተ መቅደስ እና ሶስት መስታወት ያለው ክፍል ተብለው የሚጠሩ ሶስት ዋና አወቃቀሮችን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: The main components of the structure are the "Sun House," the "Temple of Light," and a three-story building with glass walls.

translations.source: ቱሪስቶች መጀመሪያ እንዴት እንደመጡ የተሻለ ግንዛቤ እንዲኖራቸው ለማድረግ በግቢው ውስጥ የሚገኙት አብዛኛዎቹ ሕንፃዎች እንደገና ተገንብተዋል።
translations.reference: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.hypothesis: To give tourists a better understanding of how the area developed, most of the buildings in the square have been rebuilt.

translations.source: በ1976 የማቹ ፒቹ ሰላሳ ፐርሰንት ተመልሶ ነበር እናም የመልሶ ግንባታ ሥራው እስካሁን ይቀጥላል።
translations.reference: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.hypothesis: In 1976, Machu Picchu experienced a 30% decline in visitors, and reconstruction efforts are still ongoing.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ ፣ በዓለም ላይ በጣም የተለመደው አሁንም የምስል ፎቶግራፍ ቅርጸት 35 ሚሜ ነው፣ ይህ በአናሎግ የፊልም ዘመን ማብቂያ ላይ ዋነኛው የፊልም መጠን የነበረ ነው።
translations.reference: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.hypothesis: For example, the most common and widely used photographic format today is 35mm, which was the most popular film size during the decline of film photography.

translations.source: ዛሬ ድረስ ይመረታል ነገር ግን ምጥጥነ ዕይታው በዲጂታል ካሜራዎች ምስል ዳሳሽ ቅርጸቶች ተወርሷል።
translations.reference: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.hypothesis: While it was once considered a viable option, the use of digital cameras for capturing images has become increasingly prevalent due to their superior image quality.

translations.source: የ 35 ሚሜ ቅርፀት በእውነቱ በተወሰነ መልኩ ግራ የሚያጋባ፣ 36 ሚሜ ስፋት በ 24 ሚሜ ቁመት ያለው ነበር።
translations.reference: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.hypothesis: The 35mm format actually had a slightly unusual aspect ratio, with a width of 36mm and a height of 24mm.

translations.source: የዚህ ቅርጸት ምጥጥነ ገጽታ (በጣም ቀላሉን አጠቃላይ የቁጥር ሬሾ ለማግኘት በአስራ ሁለት በመክፈል) 3:2 ነው ይባላል።
translations.reference: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.hypothesis: The aspect ratio of this format (the ratio of width to height, obtained by dividing by 12) is 3:2.

translations.source: ብዙ የተለመዱ ቅርፀቶች (ለምሳሌ የ APS ቅርጸቶች ቤተሰብ) የዚህ ገጽታ ጥምርታ እኩል ወይም በጣም ቅርብ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.hypothesis: Many common fonts (such as the APS font family) share a similar appearance or are very close to this style.

translations.source: የተንገላታው እና የሚሳቅበት የሦስተኛ ወገን ደንብ በምስሉ ላይ የተወሰነ ደረጃን ጠብቆ በሚቆይበት ጊዜ ተለዋዋጭነትን ለመፍጠር ቀላል መመሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.hypothesis: The provided image illustrates a simple method for creating variability in a third-party API by maintaining a specific level of consistency between the two sides.

translations.source: ለዋናው ጉዳይ በጣም ውጤታማው ቦታ ምስሉን ወደላይ እና በአግድመት ወደ ሦስት በሚያካፍሉ የመስመሮች መቆራረጫ ላይ አንደሆነ ይናገራል (ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ)።
translations.reference: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.hypothesis: The main point is that the image is divided into three sections, with the most important part being at the top and the least important part at the bottom (see example).

translations.source: በዚህ በአውሮፓ ታሪክ ጊዜ ውስጥ ሃብታም እና ባለስልጣን የሆነው የካቶሊክ ቤተክርስቲያን ምርመራ ውስጥ ገባ።
translations.reference: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.hypothesis: During this period in European history, the Catholic Church, a powerful and influential institution, became embroiled in an investigation.

translations.source: ከአንድ ሺህ ለሚበልጡ ዓመታት የክርስትና ሃይማኖት የቋንቋና የባህል ልዩነቶች ቢኖሩም የአውሮፓን ግዛቶች አንድ ላይ አቆራኝቷል። እኔ
translations.reference: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.hypothesis: Despite the linguistic and cultural differences that have existed for over a thousand years, Christianity has united the European nations under one banner.

translations.source: ሁሉን አጥፊ የሆነው ኃይሉ ከሊቅ እስከ ደቂቅ ሁሉንም የሚነካ ነው።
translations.reference: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.hypothesis: This power, which is destructive in every way, affects everything from the smallest to the largest.

translations.source: ከዋና ዋና ክርስቲያናዊ መሠረተ ሐሳቦች አንዱ ሀብትን መከራን እና ድህነትን ለማቃለል ጥቅም ላይ መዋል አለበት የሚለው ሲሆን የቤተ ክርስቲያኒቱ የገንዘብ ፈንድ በተለየ ለዚህ ምክንያት የተመደበ ነው።
translations.reference: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.hypothesis: One of the core tenets of Christian faith is that wealth should be used to alleviate poverty and promote social justice. To this end, the church's financial resources are often allocated to specific programs and initiatives aimed at addressing these issues.

translations.source: የቤተክርስቲያኑ መካከለኛው ባለሥልጣን ከአንድ ሺህ ዓመታት በላይ በሮም ውስጥ ነበር እናም ይህ የኃይል እና የገንዘብ ክምችት ብዙዎች መሠረታዊ የመመሪያ እምነቱ እየተሞላ እንደሆነ እንዲጠይቁ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.hypothesis: The Catholic Church has been based in Rome for over a thousand years, and this has led many to question whether its immense power and wealth have corrupted its fundamental principles.

translations.source: ጠብ ከተነሳ ብዙም ሳይቆይ ብሪታንያ የጀርመንን ባህር ኃይል ማገድ ጀመረች።
translations.reference: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.hypothesis: As the German fleet set sail, Britain quickly began to take control of the seas.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ይህ እገታ ባለፉት ሁለት ምዕተ ዓመታት በበርካታ ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶች የተቀናጀ በአጠቃላይ ተቀባይነት ያገኘ ዓለም አቀፍ ሕግን የጣሰ ቢሆንም ፣ አስፈላጊው ወታደራዊ እና ሲቪል አቅርቦቶችን በመቁረጥ ስልቱ ውጤታማ ሆኗል።
translations.reference: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.hypothesis: Although this measure, which was adopted in several international agreements over the past two decades and has become a generally accepted international law, aims to restrict military and civilian supplies, it has proven effective in achieving its goal.

translations.source: የብሪታንያ ማንኛውም መርከብ በሰፋፊ የውሃ ክፍሎች ላይ እንዳያልፉ ለማድረግ ዓለም አቀፍ ውሃ አካላትን በቦምብ ጠመደች፣ ይህም ለገለልተኛ መርከቦች እንኳን ሳይቀር አደጋ ነበረው።
translations.reference: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.hypothesis: The British implemented a global naval blockade, using mines to prevent ships from entering or leaving any major waterways, which posed a significant threat to even neutral vessels.

translations.source: ለዘዴው የተወሰነ መልስ ብቻ ስለነበር ጀርመን ላልተገደበው የሰርጎገብ መርከብ ጦርነት ተመሳሳይ ጠብቃ ነበር።
translations.reference: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.hypothesis: Because Germany's naval strategy was limited to a specific type of warship, it was similar to the British strategy of focusing on a particular type of warship.

translations.source: በ1920ዎቹ፣ የብዙ ዜጎች እና ሃገራት የጎላው ፀባይ ፀረ ጦርነት እና ብቸኝነት ነበር።
translations.reference: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In the 1920s, anti-war sentiment and a sense of isolation were common among many citizens and nations.

translations.source: በአንደኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወቅት የጦርነትን አስከፊ እና ጭካኔ ከተመለከቱ በኋላ፣ ሃገሮች ለወደፊቱ እንዲህ ዓይነቱን ሁኔታ እንደገና ለማስወገድ ፈለጉ።
translations.reference: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.hypothesis: Following the horrific and brutal experiences of World War I, nations sought to prevent a similar conflict from occurring in the future.

translations.source: በ 1884 ቴስላ በኒው ዮርክ ሲቲ ውስጥ በኤዲሰን ኩባንያ ውስጥ ሥራ ለመቀበል ወደ አሜሪካ ተዛወረ።
translations.reference: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.hypothesis: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States to begin working for Edison's company in New York City.

translations.source: በስሙ 4 ሳንቲም፣ የግጥም መፅሐፍ እና ከቻርልስ ባችለር (የቀድሞ ስራው ኃላፊ) ለቶማስ ኤዲሰን የምስጋና ደብዳቤ ይዞ ዩኤስ ውስጥ ገባ።
translations.reference: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: Arriving in the US, he carried with him a 4-cent poem, a book of poetry, and a letter of thanks to Thomas Edison from Charles Babbage (his former supervisor).

translations.source: ጥንታዊ ቻይና የተለያዩ የጊዜ ወቅቶችን የማሳያ ልዩ መንገድ አለው፣ ሁሉም የቻይና ደረጃ ወይም ሁልም በሥልጣን ላይ የነበረ ቤተሰብ በግልጽ የሚለይ ሥርወ መንግሥት ነበረው።
translations.reference: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient China had a unique way of marking different historical periods, with each era clearly distinguished by the ruling dynasty or the family that held power at the time.

translations.source: እናም በእንያንዳንዱ ስርወ-መንግስት መካከል የተከፋፈሉ ክፍልሃገራት ያልተረጋጋ ዘመን ነበር። በእነዚህ ጊዜያት ይበልጥ የሚታወቀው በሃን እና ጂን ስርወ-መንግስት መካከል ለ60 ዓመታት የተካሄደው የሶስት ግዛቶች ዘመን ነበር።
translations.reference: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.hypothesis: The period was marked by instability and division among the various states that had emerged from the Ottoman Empire. One of the most notable periods was the Thirty Years' War (1618-1648), which took place between the Habsburg and Protestant states.

translations.source: በእነዚህ ጊዜያት ለዙፋኑ በሚታገሉ በብዙ መኳንንት መካከል ከባድ ጦርነት ተካሂዷል።
translations.reference: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.hypothesis: During this period, a fierce war was waged between numerous kingdoms vying for control of the throne.

translations.source: ሦስቱ መንግስታት በጥንታዊ ቻይና ታሪክ ውስጥ በደም የተሞላ ጊዜ ነበር፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በዢያን ቤተ መንግሥት በከፍተኛው ወንበር ላይ ለመቀመጥ ሲታገሉ ተዋግተው ሞቱ።
translations.reference: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: The three states were embroiled in a bloody conflict during ancient China, where thousands of people fought and died for control of the throne of the Yan dynasty.

translations.source: እንደ የሜትሪክ ስርዓት አጠቃቀም፣ ከእውነተኝነት ወደ ህዝባዊነት መቀየር፣ ብሔራዊነት እና አገሪቱ የህዝቡ እንጂ የአንድ ብቸኛ ገዢ አለመሆኗን ያሉ በርካታ ማህበራዊ እና ፖለቲካዊ ተፅእኖዎች አሉ፡፡
translations.reference: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.hypothesis: There are numerous social and political implications associated with shifting from a metric system to a more human-centered approach, including the recognition of national and regional identities, and the understanding that the population, rather than a single dominant group, should be the primary focus.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ከአብዮቱ በኋላ እጅግ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት ያላቸው እና ስኬታማ እንዲሆኑ የሚያስችሏቸው ሙያዎች ለሁሉም ወንድ አመልካቾች ክፍት ነበሩ።
translations.reference: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, a wide range of professions, highly sought after and essential for success after the revolution, were open to all male applicants.

translations.source: ያው ለወታደሩም ተመሳሳይ ነው፣ ምክንያቱም በሠራዊት ደረጃ አሰጣጥ በክፍል ላይ ከመመስረት ይልቅ አሁን በካይላይበር ላይ ተመስርተው ነበር።
translations.reference: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.hypothesis: It was also similar for the military, as the organization had shifted from a hierarchical structure to a more decentralized system based on the Kai-Liber model.

translations.source: የፈረንሣይ አብዮት የሌሎች ብዙ አገራት በጫና ውስጥ ያሉ የሰራተኛው መደብ ሰዎች የራሳቸውን ዐመፅ እንዲጀምሩ አነሳስቷቸዋል።
translations.reference: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.hypothesis: The French Revolution inspired many other countries to give their working-class populations a voice and allow them to organize and advocate for their own interests.

translations.source: መሐመድ ከዚህ ተራ ከሆነ ሕይወት ባሻገር ባሉ ጉዳዮች ላይ ጥልቅ ፍላጎት ነበረው። ለማሰላሰል በ “ኑር” (ብርሃን) ተራራ “ሂራ’ ”በመባል የሚታወቀው ዋሻ ላይ መሄድ ያዘወትር ነበር።
translations.reference: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.hypothesis: Mohammed was deeply interested in matters beyond his immediate surroundings. He frequently visited a cave known as "Hir' " located on a hill called "Nur" (Light), with the intention of exploring its depths.

translations.source: ከዘመኑ የተረፈው ዋሻው ራሱ, የመሐመድን መንፈሳዊ ዝንባሌዎች በጣም ግልፅ የሆነ ምስል ይሰጣል።
translations.reference: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.hypothesis: The cave itself, a relic of the past, provides a clear and tangible image of the spiritual essence of Muhammad.

translations.source: ከመካ በስተሰሜን በአንዱ ተራሮች አናት ላይ ማረፉ፣ ዋሻው ሙሉ በሙሉ ከሌላው ዓለም እንዲገለል አድርጓል።
translations.reference: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.hypothesis: Located on a mountaintop to the north of Mek, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.

translations.source: በእውነቱ ፣ አንድ ሰው መኖሩን ቢያውቅም በጭራሽ ማግኘቱን ቀላል አይደለም። አንዴ ወደ ዋሻው ውስጥ ከገባ በኋላ አጠቃላይ መገለል ነው።
translations.reference: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.hypothesis: In reality, it's not easy to find them, even if you know they exist. Once you're inside, the experience is completely different.

translations.source: ከብዙዎቹ ተራሮች ዙሪያ ካለው ግልጽ፣ ውብ ሰማይ በስተቀር ምንም አይታይም። ከዋሻው ውስጥ ማየት ወይም መስማት የሚቻለው የዚህን ዓለም በጣም ትንሽ የሆነውን ክፍል ነው።
translations.reference: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.hypothesis: From the surrounding hills, the only visible thing is the clear, beautiful sky. Inside the cave, one can only see or hear a very small part of this world.

translations.source: በጊዛ የሚገኘው ታላቁ ፒራሚድ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ቆሞ ያለ ከሰባቱ አስደናቂ ነገሮች ብቸኛው ነው።
translations.reference: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World that still stands today.

translations.source: በሦስተኛው ክፍለ ዘመን BCE በግብፃውያን የተገነባው ታላቁ ፒራሚድ፣ የሞተውን ፈርዖንን ለማክበር ከተገነቡ በርካታ ትላልቅ የፒራሚድ ሕንፃዎች አንዱ ነው።
translations.reference: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.hypothesis: Built during the Third Dynasty of the Old Kingdom in Egypt, the Great Pyramid is one of the many large pyramid structures built to honor the deceased pharaohs.

translations.source: በግብጽ የሙታን ሸለቆ ውስጥ የሚገኘው “ጊዛ ፕላቱ” ወይም “ጊዛ ነክሮፖሊስ” በርካታ ፒራሚዶችን ይዟል (ከእነዚህም ውስጥ ትልቁ ፒራሚድ ትልቁ ነው) ፣ በርካታ ትናንሽ መቃብሮች ፣ በርካታ ቤተመቅደሶች እና ታላቁ እስፊንክስ ይገኙበታል።
translations.reference: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the necropolis of Giza in Egypt, the "Giza Plateau" or "Giza Necropolis" contains numerous pyramids (including the Great Pyramid, the largest of them all), numerous smaller tombs, numerous temples, and the Great Sphinx.

translations.source: ታላቁ ፒራሚድ የተሠራ ፈርዖን ክሁፉን ለማክበር ነበር እና አብዛኛዎቹ ትንንሽ ፒራሚዶች፣ መቃብሮች እና ቤተ መቅደሶች የተሠሩት የክሁፉን ሚስቶች እና ቤተሰቦች ለማክበር ነበር።
translations.reference: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
translations.hypothesis: The Great Pyramid was built to honor the pharaoh Khufu, and most of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.

translations.source: “የላይ እጥፋት” ምልክት V ይመስላል እና “የታች እጥፋት ምልክት” የስቴፕለር ሽቦ ወይም ታችኛው ክፍሉን ያጣ ካሬ ይመስላል።
translations.reference: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.hypothesis: The "top cut" marking appears as a "V", and the "bottom cut" marking looks like a square that has lost its lower section, or resembles a Staple wire.

translations.source: ወደላይ ማለት ጫፉ ላይ በመጀመር ቀስቱን መግፋት አለብዎት ማለት ሲሆን ወደታች ማለት ደግሞ ከእንቁራሪቱ መጀመር አለብዎት ማለት ነው (ይህም እጅዎ ቀስቱን የያዘበት ቦታ ነው) እና ቀስቱን ይሳቡ።
translations.reference: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.hypothesis: "To start from the top means to begin at the highest point, while to start from the bottom means to begin at the lowest point (which is also where you hold the rope). Then, swing the rope."

translations.source: የላይኛው-ምት ብዙውን ጊዜ ለስላሳ ድምፅ ያመነጫል ፣ የታችኛው-ምት ግን የበለጠ ጠንካራ እና የበለጠ አረጋጋጭ ነው።
translations.reference: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.hypothesis: The upper register typically produces a smoother, more resonant sound, while the lower register is generally louder and more forceful.

translations.source: የራስዎን ውጤት በእርሳስ ምልክት ማድረግ ይችላሉ፣ ነገር ግን የታተሙ ቦዊንግ ምልክቶች የተቀመጡት ለሙዚቃ ምክንያቶች ስለሆነም እነሱ መከበር አለባቸው።
translations.reference: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.hypothesis: You can create your own scoring system, but it's important to follow the established bowling scoring rules, as they are in place for musical reasons.

translations.source: በጣም የተደናገጠው ንጉስ ሉዊስ 16 ኛ፣ ንግስት ማሪ አንቶይኔቴ ንግስት ማሪ አንቶይንትቴ ሁለቱ ትናንሽ ልጆቻቸው (የ 11 ዓመቷ ማሪ እሴይ እና የአራት ዓመቷ ሉዊ-ቻርለስ) እና የንጉሱ እህት ማዳም ኤልዛቤት በኦክቶበር 6 ቀን 1789፣ በተቆጣው የገበያ ሴቶች ስብስብ ከቬርሳይ ወደ ፓሪስ እንዲመለሱ ተገደዱ።
translations.reference: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.hypothesis: The deeply distraught King Louis XVI, along with his queen, Marie Antoinette, their two young children (11-year-old Marie Thérèse and 4-year-old Louis-Charles), and the King's sister, Marie-Elisabeth, were all executed on October 6, 1789, after being forced to return from Versailles to Paris by a mob.

translations.source: በንጉሱ እና በንግሥቲቱ ላይ ጩኸት እና ማስፈራሪያ በሚያሰሙ ብዙ ሰዎች ተከበው ወደ ፓሪስ ተመልሰዋል።
translations.reference: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.hypothesis: Upon their return to Paris, the King and Queen were met by a large crowd of people who were eager to see them and express their support.

translations.source: ለአመጽ የተሰባሰቡ ሰዎች የንጉሱን እና ንግሥቲቱን የሰረገላ መስኮቶች በስፋት እንዲከፍቱ አስገደዷቸው፡፡
translations.reference: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.hypothesis: The king and queen ordered that the windows of their palace be widened so that the people could see them more clearly.

translations.source: በአንድ ወቅት አንድ የስብስብ ቡድን አባል በተደናገጠችው ንግሥት ፊት በቬርሳይለስ ላይ የተገደለውን የንጉሣዊ ዘበኛ ጭንቅላት እያውለበለበ ነበር።
translations.reference: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.hypothesis: At one point, a member of the group was holding the severed head of the king's executioner, which had been displayed in the courtyard of Versailles.

translations.source: የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ኢምፔሪያሊዝም የጦርነቱንየወጪ ለፊሊፒንስ ሰዎች ከፍለዋል።
translations.reference: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.hypothesis: The United States' imperialist policies have led to increased military spending in the Philippines.

translations.source: በፊሊፒንስ መንግሥት ስም አየር ላይ ያለ ወጪዎች እና የቦንድ ወለድ በዋልስትሪት ባንኮች በኩል ለዩ.ኤስ ገዢ ሃይል ለመክፈል ተስማሙ።
translations.reference: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.hypothesis: The Philippine government has agreed to pay for air travel and bond purchases from U.S. banks through the Walton Street Bank.

translations.source: በእርግጥ፣ የተራዘመ የፊሊፒንስን ሕዝብ ብዝበዛ ከተመሠረቱት እጅግ አትራፊዎች ለአሜሪካ ኢምፔሪያሊዝም መሠረታዊ ጥቅሞችን ያስገኛሉ።
translations.reference: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.hypothesis: Indeed, the vast majority of Filipinos who were brought over by American imperialists benefited significantly from the establishment of American colonial rule.

translations.source: ቴምፕላሮችን ለመረዳት አንድ ሰው የሃይማኖት ቡድኑን መፈጠር ያነሳሳውን ሁኔታ መገንዘብ አለበት።
translations.reference: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.hypothesis: To understand temples, one must recognize the circumstances that lead a person to create a religious group.

translations.source: ክንዋኔዎቹ የተከሰቱበት ጊዜ ከፍተኛ መካከለኛው ዘመን በመባል ይታወቃል በአውሮፓ ታሪክ ውስጥ 11ኛው፣ 12ኛው እና 13ኛው ክፍለዘመናት (AD 1000–1300)።
translations.reference: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: The period during which these events occurred is known as the High Middle Ages in European history, spanning the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).

translations.source: ከፍተኛዎቹ መካከለኛ ዘመኖች በመጀመሪያዎቹ የመካከለኛው ዘመኖች ይቀደማሉ እናም በመጨረሻዎቹ መካከለኛ ዘመኖች ይከተላሉ ይህም በስምምነት 1500 ላይ ያበቃል።
translations.reference: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: The High Middle Ages followed the Early Middle Ages and preceded the Late Middle Ages, with a period of relative stability around the year 1000.

translations.source: የቴክኖሎጂ ቁርጠኝነት በተግባር በርካታ ሀሳቦችን የሚያካትት፣ ከቴክኖሎጂ-ግፊት ወይም ከቴክኖሎጂ አስፈላጊነት ወደ የሰው ልጅ እጣ ፈንታ ከሳይንሳዊ ህጎች እና በቴክኖሎጂው መገለጥ ጋር የተዛመደ መሰረታዊ አመክንዮ የሚመነጭ እንደሆነ ወደ ማሰብ ያደላ ጠንካራ ስሜት።
translations.reference: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.hypothesis: A strong conviction in the power of technology, which encompasses a wide range of ideas, from the practical applications of technology to the fundamental principles that govern its development, and from the scientific laws that underpin it to the human challenges it can address.

translations.source: አብዛኛዎቹ የቴክኖሎጂ ቆራጥነት ትርጓሜዎች ሁለት አጠቃላይ ሀሳቦችን ይጋራሉ፥ የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት ራሱ ከባህላዊ ወይም ከፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ባሻገር እጅግ በጣም ብዙ መንገድን እንደሚከተል ፣ እና ቴክኖሎጂ በበኩሉ ከማህበራዊ ሁኔታ ይልቅ በተፈጥሯቸው ባሉ ህብረተሰቦች ላይ “ተጽዕኖዎች” አለው።
translations.reference: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.hypothesis: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two main ideas: that technological development proceeds largely independently of cultural or political influences, and that technology, in turn, has a significant impact on societies, rather than being shaped by them.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ የሞተር መኪና በግድ ወደ መንገድ ልማት ይመራል ሊባል ይችላል፡፡
translations.reference: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.hypothesis: For example, a car engine could be used to power a road development project.

translations.source: ነገር ግን ለትንሽ መኪኖች ሀገር አቀፍ የመንገድ አውታረመረብ በኢኮኖሚ አያስኬድም ስለዚህ የመኪና ባለቤትነት ዋጋን ለመቀነስ አዳዲስ የማምረቻ ዘዴዎች ተመሥርተዋል።
translations.reference: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.hypothesis: However, the existing national road network is not suitable for small cars, so new manufacturing methods have been developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.

translations.source: የብዙ መኪና ባለቤት መሆን እንዲሁ በመንገድ ላይ ከፍተኛ የአደጋ አጋጣሚዎችን ያስከትላል፤ ይህም ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን አካላት ለመጠገን አዳዲስ ቴክኒኮችን ወደ መፍጠር ያመራል።
translations.reference: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.hypothesis: Owning multiple cars also increases the risk of accidents on the road, which has led to the development of new techniques to prevent and mitigate the consequences of such accidents.

translations.source: ሮማንቲሲዝም እንደ ጎተ ፣ ፍቼ እና ሽጌል ካሉ ፀሐፊዎች የተገኘ የባህል ቁርጠኝነት ትልቅ አካል ነበረው።
translations.reference: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Romanticism, as exemplified by writers like Goethe, Fichte, and Schiller, was a significant aspect of this cultural movement.

translations.source: በሮማንቲሲዝም አውድ ውስጥ፣ የጂኦግራፊ ግለሰቦችን ቀርጾ እናም ከጊዜ በኋላ ጂኦግራፊ ጋር የተዛመዱ ባሕሎች እና ከህብረተሰቡ ቦታ ጋር የሚስማሙ በዘፈቀደ ህጎች ከማድረግ የተሻሉ ነበሩ።
translations.reference: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.hypothesis: Within the Romantic era, geographers focused on describing individuals and cultures, and on mapping out geographical features and their relationship to society. They sought to create a system of geographical knowledge that was both accurate and aesthetically pleasing.

translations.source: ፓሪስ የዘመናዊው ዓለም የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ እንደምትባለው ሁላ፣ ኮንስታንቲኖፕል የፊውዳል አውሮፓ የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ ይባል ነበር።
translations.reference: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.hypothesis: While Paris is widely considered the center of modern fashion, Constantinople was once the center of fashion in feudal Europe.

translations.source: የቅንጦት ዋና መዓከል የመሆኑ ዝና በ400 ኤ.ዲ ላይ ጀምሮ እስከ 1100 ኤ.ዲ ድረስ ቆየ።
translations.reference: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: The period of the Golden Age lasted from approximately 400 AD to 1100 AD.

translations.source: በዐሥራ ሁለተኛው ክፍለ ዘመን በዋነኝነት ክርስቲያናዊ ጦርነት ተዋጊዎች እንደ ሃር እና ቅመም ያሉ ከባይዛንታይን ገበያ ከሚያቀርባቸው በላይ ዋጋ የተሰጣቸው ስጦታዎችን ይዘው በመመለሳቸው ሁኔታው ዝቅ አለ።
translations.reference: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.hypothesis: During the 18th century, the situation was significantly different. Instead of returning with gifts from the Byzantine market, as was common, Christian warriors primarily brought back goods from the Black Sea region, which were often less valuable.

translations.source: በዚህ ጊዜ ነበር የፋሽን ዋና ከተማ የሚለው ርዕስ ከኮንስታንቲኖፕል ወደ ፓሪስ የተላለፈው።
translations.reference: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.hypothesis: This was the time when the title of "fashion capital" shifted from Constantinople to Paris.

translations.source: ጎቲክ ቅርጽ በ10ኛው እና በ11ኛው ከፍለ ዘመኖች መካከል እና በ14ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ከፍተኛ ሆኖ ነበር።
translations.reference: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.hypothesis: The Gothic style flourished during the 10th, 11th, and 14th centuries, with its peak occurring in the 12th century.

translations.source: መጀመሪያ ላይ፣ ቀሚስ በምሥራቅ በባይዛንታይን ባህል ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ አሳድሯል።
translations.reference: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.hypothesis: Initially, the kimono had a significant impact on the culture of the eastern Japanese region.

translations.source: ሆኖም፣ በአዝጋሚ የግንኙነት መንገዶች ምክንያት በምእራብ በኩል ያሉ የኑሮ ዘይቤዎች ከ 25 እስከ 30 ዓመት ሊዘገዩ ይችላሉ፡፡
translations.reference: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.hypothesis: However, due to the prevailing trade routes, lifestyles in the west may be delayed by 25 to 30 years.

translations.source: በመካከለኛው ዘመን መጨረሻ አካባቢ ምዕራብ አውሮፓ የራሳቸውን የአለባበስ ዘዴ መፍጠር ጀመሩ። በጦርነቶቹ ምክንያት ከጊዜው ትልቆቹ ዕድገቶች አንዱ ሰዎች ልብሳቸውን ለመዝጋት ቁልፍ መጠቀም መጀመራቸው ነበር።
translations.reference: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.hypothesis: Towards the end of the Middle Ages, Western Europe began to develop its own fashion trends. One of the most significant changes during this period was the increasing use of buttons to fasten clothing.

translations.source: መቆያ ግብርና ማለት ገበሬውን እሱን እና ቤተሰቡን ብቻ ሊጠቅም የሚችል ምርት ሲኖረው ማለት ነው።
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.hypothesis: Subsistence farming refers to a system where a farmer produces enough food to feed themselves and their family.

translations.source: የራስን ኑሮ ለመምራት የሚደረግ እርሻ ቀላል ፣ ብዙውን ጊዜ ኦርጋኒክ ፣ ለሥነ-ምህዳሩ ተወላጅ የሆነውን የተቀመጠ ዘርን በመጠቀም ምርትን ከፍ ለማድረግ ከሰብል ማሽከርከር ወይም ከሌሎች በአንፃራዊነት ቀላል ቴክኒኮች ጋር በማቀላቀል የሚደረግ ቀላል ስርዓት ነው።
translations.reference: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.hypothesis: Self-sufficiency in agriculture involves a relatively simple system, often using organic methods and locally adapted varieties, that focuses on increasing yields through techniques like crop rotation or other relatively easy methods.

translations.source: በታሪክ አብዛኛዎቹ አርሶ አደሮች ከእጅ ወደ አፍ ግብርና ውስጥ ተሰማርተው ይኖሩ የነበረ ሲሆን ይህ በብዙ ታዳጊ ሀገሮች ውስጥ አሁንም እንደዚያው ነው።
translations.reference: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.hypothesis: Historically, most farmers in Ethiopia cultivated land using manual labor, a practice that continues to be prevalent in many developing countries today.

translations.source: ንዑስ ባህላት በማሕበራዊ ደረጃዎች እንደተገለሉ የሚሰማቸውን አንድ ዓይነት አስተሳሰብ ያላቸው ግለሰቦች አንድ ላይ አምጥቶ የማንነት ስሜት እንዲያዳብሩ ያስችላቸዋል።
translations.reference: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.hypothesis: Individuals who share a common worldview can come together and develop a sense of identity by observing how subcultures are expressed in social settings.

translations.source: የአባላቱ ዕድሜ፣ ብሔር፣ ክፍል፣ ቦታ፣ እና/ወይም ጾታ በመከተል ውስጠ ባህላት ልዩ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.hypothesis: Their individual characteristics may vary depending on their age, ethnicity, social class, location, and/or gender.

translations.source: አንድን ንዑስ ባህል ልዩ የሚያደርጉት ባህሪዎች የቋንቋ፣ የስነ ውበት፣ የሃይማኖት፣ የፖለቲካ፣ የጾታዊ፣ የመልካ ምድራዊ ወይም የእነዚህ ቅልቅል ምክንያቶች ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.hypothesis: Subcultures are often distinguished by unique characteristics related to language, aesthetics, religion, politics, sexuality, or a combination of these factors.

translations.source: የአንድ ንዑስ ባህል አባላት ብዙውን ጊዜ ፋሽንን ፣ አሰራሮችን እና አርጎትን ያካተተ ልዩ እና ምሳሌያዊ በሆነ የአጻጻፍ ዘይቤ አባልነታቸውን ያመለክታሉ።
translations.reference: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.hypothesis: Members of a subculture often express their affiliation through a distinctive and symbolic writing style that incorporates elements of fashion, work, and art.

translations.source: የማህበራዊ ሕይወትን አስፈላጊነት ለማስረዳት ከምንጠቀምባቸው በጣም የተለመዱ መንገዶች ውስጥ አንዱ፣ በመጥፎ ሁኔታዎች፣ በበደል፣ ወይም በመከራ ውስጥ ያደጉ፣ በአሳዳጊዮቻቸው አብሮ መኖርን ያልተማሩ ሕፃናትን በማየት ነው።
translations.reference: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.hypothesis: One of the most common ways to illustrate the importance of social interaction is by observing children who have grown up in difficult circumstances, such as abusive or neglectful homes, and who have not learned to interact with others in a healthy way.

translations.source: እንደነዚህ ያሉት ልጆች "ፌራል" ወይም ስዶች ይባላሉ። አንዳንድ ስድ ልጆች በሰዎች ተዘግቶባቸዋል (ብዙውን ጊዜ የራሳቸው ወላጆች)፤ በአንዳንድ ሁኔታዎች ይህ ልጅ መተው ወላጆቹ የልጁን ከባድ የአእምሮ ወይም የአካል እክል ባለመቀበላቸው ነው።
translations.reference: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.hypothesis: Children like these are referred to as "feral" or "wild." Some feral children are raised by humans (often their own parents), but in many cases, they are abandoned because their parents are unable or unwilling to cope with the child's severe mental or physical disabilities.

translations.source: የተጣሉ ልጆች ከመጣላቸው ወይም ከመሸሻቸው በፊት ከባድ የልጆች ጥቃት ወይም የስሜት ቀውስ አጋጥሟቸው ይሆናል።
translations.reference: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.hypothesis: Before they are adopted, they may experience severe childhood trauma or a mental health crisis, either as a result of their own experiences or due to the circumstances surrounding their adoption.

translations.source: ሌሎች በእንስሳት ያደጉ ናቸው ተብሎ ይታሰባል፣ አንዳንዶቹ በጫካ ውስጥ ብቻቸውን እንደኖሩ ይነገራል።
translations.reference: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.hypothesis: Some are believed to have originated from animals, and some are thought to have lived in the forest alone.

translations.source: የሰው-ልጅ ባልሆኑ እንስሳት ሙሉ በሙሉ ሲያድጉ ፣ የዱር ልጅ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንደ ልዩ እንሰሳት የመሰሉ ባህሪያትን ያሳያል (ለምሳሌ በሰው ልጆች ላይ ፍርሃት ወይም ግዴለሽነት)።
translations.reference: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.hypothesis: In human-animal hybrids, the offspring exhibit characteristics of both species, such as the human's capacity for fear or indifference, while retaining some of the unique traits of the animal parent (e.g., in the case of a human-dog hybrid, the offspring might display the dog's loyalty or hunting instincts).

translations.source: በፕሮጀክት ላይ የተመሠረተ ትምህርት መማርን ቀላል እና ሳቢ ማድረግ ቢያስፈልግም ፣ ስካፎልዲንግ ግን አንድ እርምጃ ቀድሞ ይሄዳል።
translations.reference: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.hypothesis: While learning through project-based education can be effective and efficient, scaffolding provides an additional layer of support.

translations.source: ስካፍፎልዲንግ የመማር ዘዴ አይደለም፣ ነገር ግን አዲስ የመማር ሂደት የሚጀምሩ ለምሳሌ አዲስ የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም ለሚጠቀሙ ወይም አዲስ ፕሮጀክት ለሚጀምሩ ግለሰቦችን የሚረዳ ድጋፍ ነው።
translations.reference: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.hypothesis: Scaffolding is not a learning method in itself, but rather a form of support that helps individuals who are starting a new learning process, such as those who are learning a new computer program or starting a new project.

translations.source: ማጠቃለያ ምናባዊም እውነተኛም ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ በሌላ አገላለጽ አስተማሪ ልክ ማይክሮሶፍት ኦፊስ ላይ ወረቀት እንደሚያያይዝ ትንሹ ሰው አንድ የማጠቃለያ መንገድ ነው፡፡
translations.reference: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: In essence, both hypothetical and real scenarios can be used as examples. For instance, one way to illustrate the concept of summarization is to use Microsoft Word as a tool to create a summary of a document.

translations.source: ቨርቹዋል ስካፎልዶች በሶፍትዌሩ ውስጥ ያሉ ናቸው እናም ተማሪው ብቻውን እንዲይዝ ፈታኝ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ አሰራሮችን ለመጠየቅ ፣ ሊመረምር እና ሂደቶቹን ለማብራራት የታሰበ ነው።
translations.reference: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.hypothesis: Virtual scaffolds are software-based tools designed to help students explore, investigate, and understand complex processes by allowing them to interact with the software independently.

translations.source: ትኩረት ባለማግኘት፣ በጥቃት እና አልፎ ተርፎም እስከ ስርቆት ድረስ ባሉ የተለያዩ ምክንያቶች ልጆች በማደጎ እንክብካቤ ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ።
translations.reference: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.hypothesis: Children may require childcare due to a variety of reasons, including lack of parental supervision, neglect, and even abuse.

translations.source: የትኛውም ልጅ እንክብካቤ የሌለበት፣ አሳቢ፣ እና አስተማሪ ያልሆነ አካባቢ ውስጥ ማደግ የለበትም፣ ነገር ግን ማደጋቸው አይቀርም።
translations.reference: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.hypothesis: Children should not be raised in an environment that is neglectful, abusive, or lacking in proper care and education, but they must still be cared for.

translations.source: እኛ የማደጎ እንክብካቤ ሥርዓትን ለነዚህ ልጆች የደኅንነት ቀጠና አድርገን እናየዋለን።
translations.reference: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.hypothesis: We have established a safe zone for these children, providing them with the necessary care and support.

translations.source: የእኛ የማሳደጊያ እንክብካቤ ስርዓት ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ቤቶችን ፣ አፍቃሪ ተንከባካቢዎችን ፣ የተረጋጋ ትምህርት እና አስተማማኝ የጤና እንክብካቤን ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
translations.reference: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.hypothesis: Our assisted living facility is known for providing safe and secure homes, attentive care, a stable learning environment, and reliable healthcare.

translations.source: የአሳዳጊዎች እንክብካቤ ከዚህ ቀደም በተወሰዱበት ቤት ውስጥ የጎደላቸውን ሁሉንም አስፈላጊ ነገሮች ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይታሰባል።
translations.reference: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.hypothesis: It is generally understood that a nursery provides all the necessary items for childcare, which were previously obtained from the parents' home.

translations.source: በይነመረብ የግዝፈት እና የሁለት ሰዎች ግንኙነት ባህሪያትን ያዋህዳል።
translations.reference: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.hypothesis: It explores the characteristics of online infidelity and two-person relationships.

translations.source: የአጠቃቀም እና እርካታ አቀራረብን በተመለከተ የበይነመረብ ልዩ ባህሪዎች ወደ ተጨማሪ ልኬቶች ይመራሉ።
translations.reference: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.hypothesis: Regarding the use and enjoyment of the internet, specific characteristics of the online environment lead to further complexities.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ ፣ “መማር” እና “ማህበራዊነት” ለበይነመረብ አገልግሎት እንደ ወሳኝ አነሳሺዎች ሆነው ተጠቁሟል (James et al., 1995)።
translations.reference: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: For example, "learning" and "social interaction" have been identified as key features of online services (James et al., 1995).

translations.source: በተጨማሪም “የግል ተሳትፎ” እና “ቀጣይ ግንኙነቶች” በኢጊሜ እና ማኮርድ (1998) የድርጣቢያዎች የታዳሚዎች ምላሾችን ሲመረምሩ እንደ አዲስ ተነሳሽነት ገጽታዎች ተለይተዋል።
translations.reference: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
