translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, the concepts of "private participation" and "future relationships" were identified as new factors influencing user responses in the study by Igeme and MacCord (1998).

translations.source: የቪዲዮ ቀረፃ በጥቂት ሚሊ ሰከንዶች የሚቆይ ጥቃቅን መግለጫዎችን፣ የፊት እንቅስቃሴዎችን ለመተርጎም ወደ አስፈላጊ ግኝቶች መርተዋል።
translations.reference: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.hypothesis: The video analysis system uses short, concise clips to interpret facial movements and extract key insights.

translations.source: በተለይም፣ አንድ ሰው ጥቃቅን-አገላለጾችን በትክክል በመተርጎም አንድ ሰው መዋሸት አለመዋሸቱን ማረጋገጥ ይችላል ተብሎ ይታመናል።
translations.reference: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.hypothesis: In particular, it is believed that someone can accurately interpret subtle cues to determine whether someone is lying.

translations.source: ኦሊቨር ሳክስ ፣ የፕሬዚዳንቱ ንግግር የሚለውን ፅሁፋቸው ውስጥ በአንጎል ጉዳት ምክንያት ንግግርን ለመረዳት የማይችሉ ሰዎች እንዴት ቅንነትን በትክክል መገምገም እንደቻሉ አመልክቷል።
translations.reference: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.hypothesis: Oliver Saks highlighted in his article how people with hearing impairments can accurately assess the tone of a speech, despite not being able to understand the words themselves, due to their visual impairment.

translations.source: የሰው ባሕሪ የመለየት እንደዚህ ዓይነት ችሎታዎች እንደ ለማዳ ውሾች ባሉ እንሰሳትም ሊጋሩ እንደሚችሉ ጠቅሷል።
translations.reference: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.hypothesis: He has pointed out that humans possess similar abilities to detect deception, as seen in animals like dogs.

translations.source: በሃያኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የተደረገው ጥናት የዘረመል ልዩነት ሁለት ገንዳዎች እንዳሉ ያሳያል-የተደበቁ እና የተገለጹ።
translations.reference: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.hypothesis: A study conducted in the 18th century revealed two distinct types of weeds: hidden and conspicuous.

translations.source: ሚውቴሽን አዲስ የዘረመል ልዩነትን ይጨምራል ፣ እናም ምርጫው ከተገለፀው የልዩነት ገንዳ ውስጥ ያስወግደዋል።
translations.reference: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.hypothesis: The mutation introduces a new, distinct variation, and it removes the variation from the pool of known variations.

translations.source: በሁለቱ ገንዳዎች መካከል ከእያንዳንዱ ትውልድ ጋር የመለያየት እና ዳግም ውህደት የውዝግብ ልዩነት።
translations.reference: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.hypothesis: The unique characteristic of the two ponds is the way in which each generation separates and then re-integrates with the others.

translations.source: በሣቫና ውስጥ ፣ የሰው ልጆች ዓይነት የምግብ መፈጨት ሥርዓት ላላቸው ሰብአስተኔዎች እዛው በሚገኙ የእጽዋት የምግብ ምንጮች የአሚኖ አሲድን ፍላጎቶችን ለማርካት አስቸጋሪ ነው።
translations.reference: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.hypothesis: In Savannah, humans with specific digestive systems struggle to meet their amino acid needs from the locally available plant-based food sources.

translations.source: በተጨማሪ ይህንን ማድረግ አለመቻል ከባድ ውጤቶች አሉት፡ የመንፈስ ጭንቀት፣ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እጥረት፣ እናም በስተመጨረሻ ሞት።
translations.reference: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, being unable to do this can have serious consequences: mental distress, nutritional deficiencies, and ultimately, death.

translations.source: በጣም በቀላሉ ተደራሽ የሆኑት የእፅዋት ሀብቶች በቅጠሎች እና በጥራጥሬዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ፕሮቲኖች ሊሆኑ ይችሉ ነበር ፣ ግን እነዚህ እንደ እኛ ላሉት አጥቢዎች ካልተበሰሉ በስተቀር ለመፍጨት ከባድ ናቸው።
translations.reference: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.hypothesis: The plant-based proteins that were readily available in the past, such as those found in legumes and grains, could have been easily processed into food. However, these crops require significant processing to be made palatable for human consumption.

translations.source: በአንፃሩ፣ የእንስሳት ምግቦች (ጉንዳኖች፣ ምስጦች፣ እንቁላሎች) በቀላሉ የሚታኘኩ ሆነው ሁሉንም አስፈላጊ አሚኖ አሲዶችን ያካተቱ ፕሮቲኖችን በከፍተኛ መጠን ያቀርባሉ።
translations.reference: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.hypothesis: In contrast, animal-based foods (meat, dairy, eggs) provide a readily available source of high-quality proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.

translations.source: ሁሉም ነገሮች ከግምት ውስጥ ገብተው ፣ የራሳችን ቅድመ አያቶች በሳቫና ላይ ያሉ ቺምፖች በዛሬው ጊዜ እንደሚያደርጉት በተወሰነ መልኩ“ የፕሮቲን ችግራቸውን ”ቢፈቱ ሊደንቀን አይገባም።
translations.reference: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.hypothesis: Considering all factors, we should not assume that our own efforts to address the "protein problem" will necessarily replicate the success of chimpanzees in the savanna in achieving it.

translations.source: የእንቅልፍ መቋረጥ በመደበኛ የእንቅልፍ ጊዜዎ ውስጥ አውቀው የመንቃት እና ከትንሽ ጊዜ በኋላ (10–60 ደቂቃዎች) መልሶ የመተኛት ሂደት ነው።
translations.reference: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.hypothesis: Waking up during your normal sleep period, followed by a period of rest (10–60 minutes) and then returning to sleep.

translations.source: ሙሉ በሙሉ ከእንቅልፍዎ ሳይነቁ ወደ ህሊናዎ ለማምጣት በአንጻራዊነት ጸጥ ያለ የደወል ሰዓት በመጠቀም ይህ በቀላሉ ሊከናወን ይችላል።
translations.reference: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.hypothesis: This can be easily achieved by using a relatively quiet time for conversation, allowing you to wake up gradually from sleep.

translations.source: በእንቅልፍዎ ውስጥ ሰዓቱን እንደገና ሲያስተካክሉ ካዩ ፣ ለማጥፋትት ከአልጋዎ እንዲወጡ በክፍሉ ተቃራኒ ሊቀመጥ ይችላል።
translations.reference: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.hypothesis: If you notice that the clock on your nightstand is consistently wrong, you can place it on the opposite side of the bed to counteract the effect of the bed's magnetic field.

translations.source: ሌሎች ባዮሪትም የተመሰረቱ አማራጮች ከእንቅልፍዎ በፊት ብዙ ፈሳሽ (በተለይም ውሃ ወይም ሻይ፣ የታወቀ ዲዩሪቲክ) መጠጣት ያካትታል፣ አንድ ሰው ለሽንት ከእንቅልፍ እንዲነሳ ያስገድደዋል።
translations.reference: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.hypothesis: Other options involve drinking a large amount of fluid (especially water or tea, a known diuretic) before bed, which can encourage urination during the night.

translations.source: አንድ ሰው ያለው ውስጣዊ ሰላም በአንድ አካል እና መንፈስ ውስጥ ካለው ውጥረት መጠን በተቃራኒው ይዛመዳል።
translations.reference: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.hypothesis: Inner peace is inversely proportional to the level of stress experienced by a person, both in their mind and body.

translations.source: ውጥረቱ ዝቅተኛ በሆነ ቁጥር ፣ የሕይወት ኃይል የበለጠ አዎንታዊ ይሆናል። እያንዳንዱ ሰው ፍጹም ሰላምን እና እርካታን የማግኘት አቅም አለው።
translations.reference: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.hypothesis: As stress levels decrease, one's sense of well-being and overall health improves. Everyone has the potential to achieve a state of perfect peace and happiness.

translations.source: ሁሉም ሰው ዕውቀትን ማግኘት ይችላል። በመንገዱ ላይ የቆመው ብቸኛ ነገር የራሳችን ጭንቀት እና አሉታዊነት ነው።
translations.reference: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone has the potential to gain knowledge. The only obstacle is our own fear and negativity.

translations.source: የቲቤት ቡድሂዝም በቡድሃ ትምህርቶች ላይ የተመሠረተ ነው ፣ ግን በማሃያና የፍቅር መንገድ እና ከህንድ ዮጋ በብዙ ቴክኒኮች የተራዘመ ነው።
translations.reference: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.hypothesis: Tibetan Buddhism is based on Buddhist teachings, but it also incorporates elements from Mahayana Buddhism and incorporates many techniques from Indian yoga.

translations.source: በመርህ ደረጃ፤ የቲቤታን ቡዲዝም በጣም ቀላል ነው። ኩንዳሊኒ ዮጋ፣ መመሰጥ እና ሁሉን-አቃፊ የፍቅር ጉዞን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.hypothesis: In its simplest form, Tibetan Buddhism is straightforward. It encompasses Kundalini Yoga, meditation, and a journey of self-discovery and love.

translations.source: በኩንዳሊኒ ዮጋ የኩንዳሊኒ ኃይል (የማወቅ ኃይል) በዮጋ አቋሞች፣ የአተነፋፈስ እንቅስቃሴዎች ፣ ማንትራስ እና በዕይታዎች ይነቃቃል።
translations.reference: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.hypothesis: Kundalini yoga aims to awaken the Kundalini energy (the energy of awareness) through specific yoga postures, breathing techniques, mantras, and visualizations.

translations.source: የቲቤት የማሰላሰል ማዕከል የመለኮት ዮጋ ነው። በተለያዩ የአማልክት ተመስጦ አማካኝነት፣ የኃይል ሰርጦቹ ይጸዳሉ፣ ቻካራዎች ይንቀሳቀሳሉ፣ እና የእውቀት ብርሃን ህሊና ይፈጠራል።
translations.reference: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.hypothesis: The Tibetan Singing Bowl is a sacred instrument used in meditation. When struck, the bowl produces a resonant sound that can help to clear the mind, release tension, and promote a sense of inner peace.

translations.source: በ 2 ኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ጀርመን በ USSR እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ትብብር በመፍጠር የጋራ ጠላት ነበረች። ጦርነቱ ሲያበቃ የሥርዓት ፣ የሂደት እና የባህል ግጭቶች አገራት ወደ ወድቀት እንዲመሩ አድርጓቸዋል።
translations.reference: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.hypothesis: During World War II, Germany was an ally of both the USSR and the United States. However, as the war ended, the resulting social, economic, and cultural changes led to the collapse of these regimes.

translations.source: ጦርነቱ ሊያበቃ ሁለት ዓመታት ሲቀሩት የቀድሞ አጋሮች አሁን ጠላት ስለነበሩ የቀዝቃዛው ጦርነት ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.hypothesis: With only two years remaining until the end of the war, former allies have now become enemies. The cold war began.

translations.source: ለቀጣዮቹ 40 ዓመታት የሚቆይ ነበር እናም ከአፍሪካ እስከ እስያ፣ በአፍጋኒስታን፣ ኩባ እና ሌሎች በርካታ ቦታዎች ባሉ የጦርነት ሜዳዎች በእውን ውጊያው ይካሄድ ነበር።
translations.reference: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.hypothesis: It lasted for approximately 40 years and took place in various battlefields across Africa and Asia, including Afghanistan, Cuba, and many other locations.

translations.source: በሴፕቴምበር 17፣ 1939 የፖላንድ መከላከያ ተሰብሮ ነበር እናም የነበረው ብቸኛ ተስፋ ማፈግፈግ እና በሮማዊይንን የጦር አቋም ጋር ድጋሚ መደራጀት ነው።
translations.reference: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.hypothesis: On September 17, 1939, Poland was invaded, effectively ending any hope of peaceful resolution and leading to the re-establishment of the Roman Catholic Church's military arm.

translations.source: ነገር ግን፣ ከሶቪዬት ህብረት ቀይ የጦር ኃይል 800,000 ወታደሮች ሪጋ የሰላም ውል፣ የሶቪዬት-ፖሊሽ ፀረ-ጠብ ስምምነት፣ እና ሌሎች የሁለት እና የብዙ ሃገራት አለምዓቀፍ ውሎችን በመጣስ የፖላንድን ምስራቃዊ ክልሎች ከወረሩ በኋላ ገብተው ቤላሩሲያዊ እና ዩክሬናዊ ግንባሮችን ሲፈጥሩ እነዚህ ዕቅዶች በአንድ ሌሊት ከሸፉ።
translations.reference: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.hypothesis: However, following the collapse of the Soviet Union, the Red Army, consisting of 800,000 soldiers, invaded Eastern Poland, violating the Riga Peace Agreement, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties. This led to the creation of Polish-Belarusian and Ukrainian borders.

translations.source: መርከቦችን መጠቀም ዕቃዎችን ማመላለስ፤ በርካታ ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን በውቅያኖስ ለማጓጓዝ እስካሁን ካሉት ሁሉ በጣም የተሻለ ፍቱን መንገድ ነው።
translations.reference: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.hypothesis: Using ships is the most efficient and effective way to transport goods and people across the ocean, far superior to any other method currently available.

translations.source: የባሕር ኃይሎች የተለምዶ ሥራ የእርስዎ ሀገር ሰዎች እና ዕቃዎችን የማዘዋወር አቅሟን እንደምትጠብቅ ማረጋገጥ እና በዛው የእርስዎን ጠላት ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን የማዘዋወር አቅምን ማስተጓጎል ነው።
translations.reference: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.hypothesis: The standard practice is to verify that your country's citizens and businesses have the ability to trade with each other, and then to investigate whether your adversaries have the same ability.

translations.source: ሊጻፍ የሚገባው ከዚህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ምሳሌዎች ውስጥ አንዱ የሰሜን አትላንቲክ የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ዘመቻ ነው። አሜሪካኖቹ ብሪታንያን ለመርዳት ሰዎችን እና ዕቃዎችን በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ለማዘዋወር እየሞከሩ ነበር።
translations.reference: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.hypothesis: One example of a recent historical event is the Allied campaign in the North Atlantic during World War II. The Americans were trying to transport people and supplies across the Atlantic Ocean to help the British.

translations.source: በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ የጀርመን የባህር ኃይል በዋናነት U-ጀልባዎችን በመጠቀም ይህንን ትራፊክ ለማስቆም እየሞከረ ነበር።
translations.reference: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.hypothesis: At the same time, the German navy was primarily using U-boats to try to disrupt this traffic.

translations.source: ተባባሪ ሀገራት ቢወድቁም ኖሮ፣ ጀርመን የተቀረውን የአውሮፓ ክፍል በሙሉ እንደያዘችው ምናልባትም ብሪቴይንን መያዝ ትችል ነበር።
translations.reference: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.hypothesis: Even if the Axis powers had succeeded, Germany might have been able to conquer the rest of Europe, including Britain.

translations.source: ፍየሎች በመጀመሪያ ከ 10,000 ዓመታት በፊት በኢራን ዛግሮስ ተራሮች ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በቤት ውስጥ የተሰማሩ ይመስላል።
translations.reference: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.hypothesis: Sheep are believed to have been first domesticated in the Zagros Mountains of Iran around 10,000 years ago.

translations.source: የጥንት ባህሎች እና ጎሳዎች ወተት ፣ ፀጉር ፣ ሥጋ እና ቆዳዎች በቀላሉ እንዲሰጧቸው መጠበቅ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.hypothesis: Ancient cultures and tribes began to develop methods for easily obtaining milk, hair, meat, and hides.

translations.source: አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የቤት ውስጥ ፍየሎች በተራሮች ወይም በሌሎች የግጦሽ ስፍራዎች በሚንከራተቱ መንጋዎች ውስጥ ተጠብቀው ቆይተው ብዙውን ጊዜ ሕፃናት ወይም ያደጉ ከሚታወቁት እረኛ ጋር የሚመሳሰሉ ናቸው፡፡ እነዚህ የእርባታ ዘዴዎች እስከዛሬ ድረስ ጥቅም ላይ ይውላሉ፡፡
translations.reference: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.hypothesis: Domestic animals, particularly those raised on farms or in other rural areas, are often kept in pens or enclosures, and their appearance can resemble that of young or adult livestock. These methods of raising animals are still widely used today.

translations.source: በ 16 ኛው ክፍለዘመን መጀመሪያ ዋገንዌይስ በእንግሊዝ ተገንብቷል።
translations.reference: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.hypothesis: In the early 17th century, Waggonway was built in England.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን ሰረገላዎቹ ትይዩ ጣውላዎችን ብቻ ያካተቱ ቢሆኑም፣ ፈረሶችን በበለጠ ፍጥነትን ለማሳካት የሚጎትቷቸው እና ከቀኑ ትንሽ አስቸጋሪ ከሆኑ መንገዶች ይልቅ ትላልቅ ጭነቶች መጎተትን ኣስቻሉ።
translations.reference: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.hypothesis: Although the carrots might seem like a simple addition, they can actually help horses achieve greater speed and endurance, as they provide a more sustained source of energy than the quick bursts of sugar from other snacks.

translations.source: ትራኮቹን በቦታው ለማቆየት መስቀለኞቹ ገና ቀደም ብለው አስተዋውቀዋል። ቀስ በቀስ ግን ትራኮች ከላይ የብረት ማዕድን ቢኖራቸው የበለጠ ውጤታማ እንደሚሆኑ መገንዘብ ተቻለ።
translations.reference: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.hypothesis: The use of tracks for transporting goods was already known to the ancient Egyptians. However, it was gradually realized that tracks made of iron ore would be more effective.

translations.source: ይህ የተለመደ ተግባር ሆነ ፣ ግን ብረት በሠረገላዎቹ የእንጨት ጎማዎች ላይ የበለጠ የጉዳት ምክንያት ሆኗል።
translations.reference: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.hypothesis: While this is a common occurrence, the iron has caused more damage to the wooden wheels.

translations.source: በመጨረሻም የእንጨት ጎማዎች በብረት ተተኩ። በ1767፣ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ሙሉ በሙሉ ብረት የሆኑ ሃዲዶች ተዋወቁ።
translations.reference: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.hypothesis: Finally, wooden wheels were replaced with iron ones. In 1767, the first fully iron-made wheels were introduced.

translations.source: የመጀመሪያው የታወቀ መጓጓዣ በእግር መጓዝ ነበር ፣ ሰዎች ከሁለት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በሆሞ ኢሬክተስ (ቀጥ ያለ ሰው ማለት) ብቅ ከማለቱ ጋር ታያይዞ፣ በእግር መጓዝ ጀመሩ።
translations.reference: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.hypothesis: The earliest known form of transportation was walking, which began shortly after the appearance of Homo erectus (upright man) approximately two million years ago.

translations.source: የቀደሙት፣ ኦስትራሎፒተከስ እንደ ልማዱ ቀጥ ብለው አልሄዱም።
translations.reference: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.hypothesis: Unlike their predecessors, Australopithecus did not continue to evolve in the same way.

translations.source: የባለ ሁለት እግር መሻሻሎች ከ 4.2-3.9 ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በአወስትራሎፒቲከስ ቅሪት አካል ውስጥ የተገኙ ቢሆንም ሳሄላንትሮፐስ ከሰባት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት በፊት በሁለት እግሮች በእግር ተራምዶ ሊሆን ይችላል፡፡
translations.reference: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.hypothesis: While the fossil evidence of *Australopithecus* dates back to 4.2-3.9 million years ago, *Sahelanthropus* may have walked upright on two legs as early as 7 million years ago.

translations.source: ለአከባቢው የበለጠ ወዳጃዊ መኖር መጀመር እንችላለን፣ ወደ አካባቢያዊ እንቅስቃሴው መቀላቀል እንችላለን፣ እናም የወደፊቱን መከራ በተወሰነ ደረጃ ለመቀነስ እንኳን ተሟጋቾች ልንሆን እንችላለን።
translations.reference: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.hypothesis: We can begin to create a more welcoming environment for residents, participate in local initiatives, and even become advocates for measures to mitigate future challenges.

translations.source: ይህ በብዙ ሁኔታዎች እንደ የምልክት ሕክምና ነው። ሆኖም፣ ጊዜያዊ መፍትሄ ብቻ ካልፈለግን ታዲያ፣ የችግሮቹን መሰረት መፈለግ አለብን እና ማጥፋት አለብን።
translations.reference: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.hypothesis: This can be considered a form of symptomatic treatment. However, if we are not looking for a temporary solution, we need to identify and address the root causes of the problem.

translations.source: የሰው ልጅ በሳይንሳዊ እና በቴክኖሎጂ ግስጋሴዎች ምክንያት ዓለም ብዙ እንደተለወጠች በግልፅ የታወቀ ነው ፣ እና ከሰው ብዛት እና ከሰው ልጅ ከመጠን በላይ በሆነ የአኗኗር ዘይቤ ምክንያት ችግሮች እየበዙ መጥተዋል።
translations.reference: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.hypothesis: It is widely recognized that human progress in science and technology has dramatically changed the world, but this progress has also led to an increase in problems, such as overpopulation and unsustainable lifestyles.

translations.source: ሐምሌ 4 ቀን በኮንግረስ ተቀባይነት ካገኘ በኋላ፣ በኮንግረስ ፕሬዝዳንት ጆን ሃንኮክ እና ጸሐፊው ቻርለስ ቶምሰን የተፈረመ በእጅ የተፃፈ ረቂቅ ከዚያ ጥቂት ረድፎች አለፍ ብሎ ወዳለው ማተሚያ ቤት እንዲወሰድ ተደረገ።
translations.reference: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: After being approved by Congress on July 4th, a handwritten draft of the document, signed by President John Hancock and the author Charles Thomson, was sent to a printing press for publication.

translations.source: ሌሊቱን ሙሉ አሁን “ዱንላፕ ብሮድ ሳይድስ” ተብለው የሚጠሩ ከ150 እስከ 200 ቅጂዎች ተሰርተው ነበር።
translations.reference: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.hypothesis: During the night, approximately 150 to 200 copies of the "Dunlap Bros." newspapers were stacked together.

translations.source: የሰነዱ የመጀመሪያ የህዝብ ንባብ በጆን ኒክሰን በነጻነት አዳራሽ ግቢ ውስጥ ጁላይ 8 ነበር።
translations.reference: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.hypothesis: The document's initial public reading took place on July 8th at the John Nance Garner Presidential Library, with John Nixon delivering the speech.

translations.source: አንደኛው ሐምሌ 6 ወደ ጆርጅ ዋሽንግተን የተላከ ሲሆን፣ በኒውዮርክ ላሉ ሰራዊቶቹ ሐምሌ 9 ላይ አስነብቦታል። ቅጂው ነሐሴ 10 ላይ ለንደን ደርሷል።
translations.reference: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.hypothesis: The first copy was sent to George Washington on July 6, and was received by the troops in New York on July 9. A copy arrived in London on September 10.

translations.source: እስካሁን ድረስ የታወቁት 25 የዳንላፕ ሰፋፊ መንገዶች ከሰነዱ የተረፉ ጥንታዊ ቅጅዎች ናቸው። የመጀመሪያው በእጅ የተጻፈ ቅጅ አልተረፈም።
translations.reference: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.hypothesis: So far, 25 known methods of expanding the Danlape have been identified, based on surviving ancient copies of the document. The first copy was handwritten and has not survived.

translations.source: ዛሬ ብዙ የቅሪተ አካል ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች አንድ የዳይኖሰር ቡድን መትረፉን እና ዛሬ በሕይወት አለ ብለው ያምናሉ። ወፎች ብለን እንጠራቸዋለን።
translations.reference: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.hypothesis: Today, many paleontology researchers believe that a group of dinosaurs survived extinction and still exist today. We call them birds.

translations.source: ብዙ ሰዎች ላባ ስላላቸው እና መብረር ስለሚችሉ እንደ ዳይኖሰር አይቆጥሯቸውም።
translations.reference: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.hypothesis: Many people don't consider crocodiles to be dinosaurs because they have different characteristics and evolutionary history.

translations.source: ግን ስለ ወፎች አሁንም ብዙ ነገሮች አሉ የዳይኖሰር ይመስላሉ።
translations.reference: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: However, there are still many things about birds that seem like dinosaurs.

translations.source: ጥርሶች እና ጥፍሮች ያሉት እግሮች አሏቸው ፣ እንቁላል ይጥላሉ እና እንደ ቲ-ሬክስ በሁለት የኋላ እግሮቻቸው ላይ ይራመዳሉ።
translations.reference: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: Dinosaurs and birds have feet, lay eggs, and walk on two legs, similar to Tyrannosaurus Rex.

translations.source: በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአብዛኛው ሁሉም ኮምፒዩተሮች በሁለትዮሽ ቁጥሮች መልክ ኮድ በተደረጉ የመረጃ ሥርጭት ላይ የተመሠረቱ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, most computers rely on data transmission based on binary code, which uses two digits (0 and 1).

translations.source: የሁለትዮሽ ቁጥር አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቦታዎች ብቻ ነው ያሉት፤ ማለትም 0 ወይ 1 እናም እነዚህ ቁጥሮች የሁለትዮሽ ቁጥሮች በመባል ይታወቃሉ - ወይም ቢትስ፤ የኮምፒውተር ቋንቋን ለመጠቀም።
translations.reference: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.hypothesis: There are only two possible values for a binary number: 0 or 1. These values are known as binary digits, or bits, and are used in computer languages.

translations.source: የውስጥ መመረዝ ወዲያውኑ ላይታይ ይችላል። እንደ ማስታወክ ያሉ ምልክቶች ፈጣን ምርመራ ሊደረግባቸው የማይችሉ በበቂ ሁኔታ አጠቃላይ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.hypothesis: The presence of internal bleeding can often be detected immediately. However, the symptoms may be subtle and not easily identifiable, requiring a thorough examination.

translations.source: የውስጥ መመረዝ መኖሩን የሚያሳይ በጣም ጥሩው ምልክት፣ ክፍት የሆነ መድኃኒት ወይም መርዛማ የቤት ኬሚካሎች መኖር ሊሆን ይችላል።
translations.reference: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.hypothesis: One of the clearest signs of mold growth is the presence of an open container or exposure to moldy household chemicals.

translations.source: ለዚያ ልዩ መርዝ ልዩ የመጀመሪያ ዕርዳታ ትዕዛዞች ካሉ ፅሑፉን ይፈትሹ።
translations.reference: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.hypothesis: Examine the text for unique and original instructions related to that specific type of ointment.

translations.source: ትኋን የሚለው ቃል በኢንቶሞሎጂስት የነፍሳት ቡድን በመደበኛ መልክ ጥቅም ላይ የሚውለው ስም ነው።
translations.reference: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.hypothesis: The term "entomologist" is a common term used by the scientific community to refer to a specialist in the study of insects.

translations.source: ይህ ቃል ከጥንታውያን የትኋኖች ዝርያ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ እነዚህ ሰዎችን ተጠግተው ለመኖር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተስተካከሉ ነፍሳት ናቸው።
translations.reference: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.hypothesis: This word comes from the ancient Tigrinya language, and refers to people who are highly skilled at manipulating others to achieve their own goals.

translations.source: ሁለቱም ተናዳፊ-ትንኞች እና የአልጋ ትኋኖች ጥገኝነት ያላቸው፣ ጎጆአቸው ለመኖር ወይም በጥገኛ መኖሪያቸው ለመኖር የተስተካከሉ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.hypothesis: Both the nomadic herders and the settled farmers have their own distinct ways of life, and they often find themselves in conflict over resources and land.

translations.source: በመላው አሜሪካ ፣ በግምት ወደ 400,000 የሚታወቁ የብዙ ስክለሮሲስ (MS) ጉዳዮች አሉ ፣ ይህም በወጣት እና በመካከለኛ ዕድሜ ላይ ባሉ አዋቂዎች ላይ እንደ ዋና የነርቭ በሽታ እንዲሆን ያደርገዋል።
translations.reference: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.hypothesis: Across the United States, there are an estimated 400,000 people living with multiple sclerosis (MS), making it a leading neurological disorder, particularly affecting young and middle-aged adults.

translations.source: MS በአንጎል ፣ በስፓይናል ኮርድ እና በኦፕቲክ ነርቭ የተገነባውን ማዕከላዊውን የነርቭ ሥርዓት የሚያጠቃ በሽታ ነው።
translations.reference: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.hypothesis: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the spinal cord and the optic nerve.

translations.source: ሴቶችን በኤምኤስ የመያዝ ዕድላቸው ከወንዶች በሁለት እጥፍ ያደገ እንደሆነ ምርምር አረጋግጧል።
translations.reference: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.hypothesis: Research has shown that women have a two-fold higher risk of contracting MS compared to men.

translations.source: ጥንዶች ልጅ ማሳደግ የነሱ ፍላጎት እንዳልሆነ ወይም የልጃቸው ፍላጎት እንዳልሆነ ሊወስኑ ይችላሉ።.
translations.reference: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.hypothesis: They may decide whether or not to pursue their children's interests, based on their own desires or the children's own desires.

translations.source: እኚህ ጥንዶች ለልጃቸው የጉዲፈቻ እቅድ ለማውጣት ሊመርጡ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.hypothesis: These couples may choose to adopt a particular method of contraception.

translations.source: በጉዲፈቻ ውስጥ፣ ወላጆች ልጆቹን ሌላ ባልና ሚስት እንዲያሳድጓቸው የወላጅ መብታቸውን ያቋርጣሉ።
translations.reference: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.hypothesis: In a common-law relationship, parents may choose to have their children raised by the other parent's spouse, effectively disregarding their own parental rights.

translations.source: የሳይንስ ዋና ግብ ዓለም በሳይንሳዊ ዘዴ አማካኝነት የምትሰራበትን መንገድ ማወቅ ነው። ይህ ዘዴ በእውነቱ በጣም ሳይንሳዊ ምርምርን ይመራል።
translations.reference: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: The primary goal of science is to understand how the world works through scientific methods. This method is the driving force behind scientific research.

translations.source: ብቻውን ግን አይደለም፣ መሞከር፣ እና ሙከራ አንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ መላ ምቶችን ለማስወገድ የሚጠቅም ፈተና ነው፣ ጥያቄዎችን መጠየቅ፣ እና ምልከታዎችን ማካሄድም ሳይንሳዊ ጥናትን ይመራሉ።
translations.reference: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.hypothesis: However, experimentation and trial and error are crucial for identifying and eliminating errors, as are questioning and analysis, which drive scientific research.

translations.source: የተፈጥሮ ተመራማሪዎችና ፈላስፎች በክላሲካል ጽሑፎች ላይ እና በተለይም በላቲን መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ላይ አተኮሩ።
translations.reference: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.hypothesis: Natural scientists and philosophers focused on classical texts, particularly the Latin Bible.

translations.source: በሁሉም ሳይንስ ጉዳዮች ላይ የአርስቶትል እይታ ተቀባይነት አለው፣ ስነ-አእምሮን ጨምሮ፡፡
translations.reference: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.hypothesis: Aristotle's views on all scientific matters, including the mind, are widely accepted.

translations.source: የግሪክ ዕውቀት እየቀነሰ በሄደ ቁጥር ምዕራባውያን ከግሪክ ፍልስፍናዊ እና ሳይንሳዊ ሥረታቸው ተለይተው ተገኙ።
translations.reference: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.hypothesis: As Greek knowledge declined, Westerners began to differentiate themselves from Greek philosophical and scientific traditions.

translations.source: በፊዚዮሎጂ እና በባህሪ ውስጥ የተስተዋሉ ብዙ ተውሂዶች ብዙውን ጊዜ በዋነኝነት የሚወሰኑት በፍጥረታዊ ዑደቶች መኖር እና ባዮሎጂያዊ ሰዓቶች ላይ ባላቸው ምርታማነት ላይ ነው።
translations.reference: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.hypothesis: Many of the phenomena observed in physiology and behavior are primarily determined by the presence of cyclical patterns and the influence of biological rhythms.

translations.source: ለውጫዊ ወቅታዊ ምልክቶች ቀላል ምላሽ የማይሰጡ ወቅታዊ ምቶች ለአብዛኞቹ ሕያዋን ፍጥረታት ባክቴሪያ ፣ ፈንገሶችን ፣ እፅዋትንና እንስሳትን ጨምሮ ተመዝግበዋል።
translations.reference: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.hypothesis: The most common seasonal signs include changes in the behavior of animals, such as increased activity or migration, as well as changes in the growth and reproduction of plants and fungi, and the presence of bacteria.

translations.source: ባዮሎጂያዊ ሰዓቶች እራሳቸውን የሚደግፉ ኦሲሌተሮች ናቸው ፣ የውጭ ምልክቶች ባይኖሩም እንኳ ነፃ የማሽከርከር ብስክሌት ጊዜን የሚቀጥሉ።
translations.reference: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.hypothesis: Biological clocks are internal mechanisms that regulate various bodily functions, even in the absence of external cues, ensuring consistent cycling of activities like sleep-wake patterns.

translations.source: የሄርሽ እና ቼስ ሙከራ ዲኤንኤ የጄኔቲክ ቁሳቁስ ነበር ከሚለው መሪ ሃሳብ መካከል አንዱ ነበር።
translations.reference: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.hypothesis: One of the central ideas of the Hershey and Chase experiment, which demonstrated that DNA was the genetic material, was that it was not affected by the proteins in the cell.

translations.source: ሀርሺ እና ቼዝ የራሳቸውን ዲኤንኤ ወደ ባክቴሪያ ለማስገባት ብሎችን ወይም ቫይረሶችን ተጠቅመው ነበር።
translations.reference: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: Harsh and cheese used bacteria or viruses to introduce their own DNA into other organisms.

translations.source: ዲ ን ኤ ፌጅ በሬዲዮአክቲቭ ፎስፈረስ ወይም የፕሮቲን ፌጅ ከሬዲዮአክቲቭ ሰልፈር ጋር ምልክት በማድረግ ሁለት ሙከራዎችን አደረጉ።
translations.reference: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.hypothesis: The researchers conducted two experiments: one involved marking phosphorus with radioactive sulfur, and the other involved marking protein with radioactive sulfur.

translations.source: ሚውቴሽን በሚውቴሽን ዓይነት ፣ በተጎዳው የጄኔቲክ ንጥረ ነገር ቁራጭ አስፈላጊነት እና የተጎዱት ህዋሳት የዘር-መስመር ህዋሳት ላይ በመመርኮዝ የተለያዩ ልዩ ልዩ ተጽዕኖዎች ሊኖሩት ይችላል።
translations.reference: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.hypothesis: In the case of mutations, the affected gene's function and the affected cells may exhibit a variety of different effects, depending on whether the mutation occurs in somatic cells or germline cells.

translations.source: የጀርም መስመር ያላቸው ህዋሶች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅይርታ ብቻ ወደ ህፃናት ሊተላለፍ ይችላል፣ ሌሎች ህዋሶች ላይ የሚደረግ ቅይርታ ግን ህዋሱ እንዲሞት ወይም ካንሰርን ይፈጥራል።
translations.reference: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.hypothesis: Only infections caused by pathogens can be transmitted to children, while infections caused by other organisms can either kill the host or cause cancer.

translations.source: ተፈጥሮን መሠረት ያደረገ ቱሪዝም ተፈጥሮአዊ አካባቢዎችን ለመጎብኘት ፍላጎት ያላቸውን ሰዎች እፅዋትንና እንስሳትን የዱር እንስሳትን ጨምሮ ይዝናናል።
translations.reference: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: Eco-tourism, which focuses on preserving the natural environment, allows people who are interested in nature to enjoy the flora and fauna, including wildlife, while minimizing their impact on the environment.

translations.source: በቦታው ላይ የተከናወኑ ተግባራት ምሳሌዎች አደን ፣ ዓሳ ማጥመድ ፣ ፎቶግራፍ ማንሳት ፣ ወፎችን መመልከት እና መናፈሻዎች መጎብኘት እና ስለ ሥነ ምህዳሩ መረጃን ማጥናት ናቸው።
translations.reference: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.hypothesis: Examples of activities that can be done in the area include: birdwatching, fishing, taking photographs, observing wildlife, and visiting natural habitats, as well as studying the local ecosystem.

translations.source: ምሳሌ የሚሆነው በቦርኒዮ ስለ ኦርግንጊያችቫንስ መማር፣ መጎብኘት እና ፎቶግራፍ ማንሳት ነው።
translations.reference: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.hypothesis: For example, learning about, visiting, and photographing the Orangutans in Borneo.

translations.source: ሰዎች በየቀኑ ጠዋት ላይ ከትናንሽ የገጠር ከተሞች በመኪና ወደ ሥራ ቦታቸው ይሄዳሉ እና ሌሎች የሥራ መድረሻቸው ጥለውት የሔዱት ቦታ በሆነ ሰዎች ይታለፋሉ።
translations.reference: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.hypothesis: Every morning, people leave small rural towns in cars to go to their workplaces, and they pass by other people who have left their workplaces and are on their way home.

translations.source: በዚህ ተለዋዋጭ የትራንስፖርት መርከብ ውስጥ ሁሉም ሰው በሆነ መንገድ በግል መኪናዎች ላይ የተመሠረተ የትራንስፖርት ስርዓት እንደምንም ተገናኝቷል እንዲሁም ይደግፋል።
translations.reference: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.hypothesis: This proposal envisions a transportation system based on private vehicles, where everyone has access to their own car, and this system is also supported.

translations.source: ሳይንስ አሁን እንደሚያመለክትው ይህ ግዙፍ የካርቦን ኢኮኖሚ ላለፉት ሁለት ሚሊዮን ዓመታት የሰውን ልጅ ዝግመተ ለውጥ ከደገፈው የተረጋጋ ሁኔታ ባዮስፌርን እንዳነቃነቀው ያሳያል።
translations.reference: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.hypothesis: As science now indicates, this massive carbon economy has destabilized the biosphere, leading to significant changes in human evolution over the past two million years.

translations.source: ሁሉም ሰው በኅብረተሰብ ውስጥ ይሳተፋል እና የትራንስፖርት ስርዓቶችን ይጠቀማል። ሁሉም ሰው ማለት ይቻላል ስለ መጓጓዣ ስርዓቶች ቅሬታ ያቀርባል።
translations.reference: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.hypothesis: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. This means that everyone has the potential to voice concerns about transportation systems.

translations.source: በአደጉ ሀገራት አንዳንድ ጊዜ ስለ ውሃ ጥራት እና ስለ ድልድዮች መውደቅ እኩል ቅሬታዎች ይሰማሉ።
translations.reference: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.hypothesis: Some developed countries often express concerns about both the quality of water and the risk of flooding.

translations.source: የትራንስፖርት ስርዓቶች ለምን እንደዚህ አይነት ቅሬታዎች ያመጣሉ ፣ ለምን በየቀኑ ሳይሳካላቸው ይቀራል? የትራንስፖርት መሐንዲሶች በቃ ብቃት የላቸውም ማለት ነው? ወይም የበለጠ መሠረታዊ የሆነ ነገር እየተካሄደ ነው?
translations.reference: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.hypothesis: Why do transportation systems consistently lead to these kinds of complaints, and why are they often unresolved? Does this suggest that transportation engineers lack competence? Or is there a more fundamental issue at play?

translations.source: የትራፊክ ፍሰት በሁለት ነጥቦች መካከል የአሽከርካሪዎች እና ተሽከርካሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ እና እርስ በእርስ የሚያደርጉትን ግንኙነት ማጥናት ነው።
translations.reference: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
translations.hypothesis: Traffic flow analysis involves studying the movement of vehicles and drivers, and their interactions, between two points.

translations.source: እንደ አለመታደል ሆኖ የሹፌርን ባህሪ መቶ በመቶ በእርግጠኝነት መተንበይ ስለማይቻል የትራፊክ ፍሰትን ማጥናት ከባድ ነው።
translations.reference: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
translations.hypothesis: Unfortunately, it is very difficult to study traffic flow because it is impossible to predict the driver's behavior with complete certainty.

translations.source: እንደ እድል ሆኖ ፣ አሽከርካሪዎች በተመጣጣኝ ወጥነት ባለው ክልል ውስጥ ጠባይ ያሳያሉ፡ ስለሆነም የትራፊክ ፍሰቶች የተወሰነ ተመጣጣኝ ወጥነት ይኖራቸዋል እናም በግምት በሂሳብ ሊወከሉ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
translations.hypothesis: Fortunately, the drivers exhibit a consistent pattern of behavior, which results in a predictable flow of traffic and, consequently, a reduced risk of accidents.

translations.source: የትራፊክ ፍሰትን በተሻለ ለመወከል በሦስቱ ዋና ዋና ባህሪዎች መካከል ግንኙነቶች ተመስርተዋል፥ (1) ፍሰት ፣ (2) ጥግግት እና (3) ፍጥነት።
translations.reference: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
translations.hypothesis: The relationships between the three main characteristics of traffic flow – flow, density, and speed – have been established to better represent the traffic situation.

translations.source: እነዚህ ግንኙነቶች የመንገድ ላይ መገልገያዎችን ለማቀድ ፣ ዲዛይን እና ሥራዎችን ለማከናወን ይረዳሉ።
translations.reference: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
translations.hypothesis: These relationships are essential for the planning, design, and execution of road infrastructure projects.

translations.source: ነፍሳት ወደ አየር የሄዱት የመጀመሪያ እንስሳት ነበሩ። የመብረር ችሎታቸው ጠላቶችን በቀላሉ ለማሸሽ እና ምግብን እና የትዳር ጓደኛን በብቃት እንዲያገኙ ረድቷቸዋል።
translations.reference: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
translations.hypothesis: Flying insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly gave them an advantage in escaping predators and finding food and mates.

translations.source: አብዛኞቹ ነፍሳት ሰውነታቸውን ወደኋላ በመመለስ ክንፎቻቸውን ማጠፍ የመቻላቸው ጥቅም አላቸው።
translations.reference: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
translations.hypothesis: Most birds have the advantage of being able to return to their nests after leaving them.

translations.source: ይህ ከአዳኝ እንስሳት ለመደበቅ የትንንሽ ቦታዎች ሰፊ ክልል ይሰጣቸዋል።
translations.reference: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
translations.hypothesis: This provides a wide range of suitable habitats for small animals to hide from predators.

translations.source: ዛሬ ላይ፣ ክንፋቸውን ወደ ኋላ ማጠፍ የማይችሉት ብቸኛ ነፍሳት የውሃ ተርቦች እና የግንቦት በረሮዎች ናቸው።
translations.reference: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
translations.hypothesis: Currently, only aquatic plants and certain types of grasses are unable to retract their leaves.

translations.source: ከሺዎች ዓመታት በፊት አርስጥሮኮስ የተባለ አንድ ሰው የሶላር ሲስተሙ በፀሐይ ዙሪያ ይዘዋወራል ብሏል።
translations.reference: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
translations.hypothesis: According to a figure from thousands of years ago, a person named Aristrocus believed that the solar system revolved around the sun.

translations.source: አንዳንድ ሰዎች ልክ እንደሆነ ሲያስቡ ብዙ ሰዎች ግን በተቃራኒው ፀሐይን ጨምሮ (እና ሌሎችን ኮከቦችም ጭምር)፣ ስርዓተ ፀሐይ በምድር ዙሪያ እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ያምኑ ነበር፤ ።
translations.reference: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
translations.hypothesis: While some people believed that the Earth was the center of the universe, and that the Sun, Moon, and other celestial bodies revolved around it, many others believed that the Sun and other stars revolved around the Earth.

translations.source: ይህ ምክንያታዊ ይመስላል፣ ምክንያቱም ምድር የምትንቀሳቀስ አይመስልም፣ አይደል?
translations.reference: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
translations.hypothesis: This seems reasonable, doesn't it? After all, the Earth doesn't appear to be moving.

translations.source: የአማዞን ወንዝ ሁለተኛ ረዥሙ እና በምድር ላይ ትልቁ ወንዝ ነው። ከሁለተኛው ትልቁ ወንዝ ከ 8 እጥፍ የሚበልጥ ውሃ ይይዛል።
translations.reference: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
translations.hypothesis: The Amazon River is the world's second-longest and largest river by discharge volume. It carries approximately eight times more water than the world's second-longest river.

translations.source: በተጨማሪም አማዞን በምድር ላይ እጅግ በጣም ሰፊ ወንዝ ነው፣ አንዳንዴ ስድስት ማይሎች ሰፊ ይሆናል።
translations.reference: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, the Amazon is the largest river in South America, and at times it can be over six miles wide.

translations.source: ከፕላኔትዋ ወንዞች ፈሶ ወደ ውቂያኖሶች የሚገባው ውሃ ሙሉ 20 በመቶ የሚመጣው ከአማዞን ነው።
translations.reference: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
translations.hypothesis: Approximately 20% of the water that flows from the planet's rivers and eventually reaches the oceans originates from the Amazon River.

translations.source: ዋናው የአማዞን ወንዝ ርዝማኔው 6,387 ኪ.ሜ (3,980 ማይሎች) ነው። በሺዎች ከሚቆጠሩ ትናንሽ ገባሪ ወንዞች ውሃ ይሰበስባል።
translations.reference: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
translations.hypothesis: The main river of the Amazon is 6,387 kilometers (3,980 miles) long. It is fed by thousands of smaller tributaries.

translations.source: ምንም እንኳን እስከ ብሉይ ኪንግደም መጨረሻ እስከሚጠናቀቅበት ጊዜ ድረስ የፒራሚድ ግንባታ በድንጋይ መስራቱ የቀጠለ ቢሆንም የጊዛ ፒራሚዶች በመጠን እና በግንባታ ቴክኒካዊ ልኬታቸው በጭራሽ አልተበለጡም።
translations.reference: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
translations.hypothesis: Although the construction of the pyramids continued until the end of the Old Kingdom period, the pyramids of Giza did not significantly increase in size or construction techniques.

translations.source: የጥንታዊ ግብፃዊያኖች አዲስ ግዛት ከአንድ ሺሕ ዓመት በላይ በሆናቸው በቀዳሚዎቻቸው ሀውልቶች ተገረሙ።
translations.reference: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
translations.hypothesis: The ancient Egyptians were astonished to find that the newly discovered territory, which had been undisturbed for over a thousand years, was still filled with their original artifacts.

translations.source: የቫቲካን ሲቲ ህዝብ ቁጥር ወደ 800 ገደማ ነው። በዓለም ትንሹ ሉዓላዊ ሃገር እና ትንሹ የህዝብ ቁጥር ያለው ሃገር ነው።
translations.reference: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
translations.hypothesis: The population of Vatican City is approximately 800. It is the smallest country in the world and the country with the smallest population.

translations.source: ቫቲካን ሲቲ ጣልያንኛ በሕገ-ደንቧ እና ኦፊሴላዊ ግንኙነቷ ትጠቀማለች።
translations.reference: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
translations.hypothesis: The Vatican City uses Italian as its official language, and it is used in its legal and official dealings.

translations.source: ጣልያንኛ እንዲሁ በስቴቱ ውስጥ የሚሰሩ አብዛኛዎቹ የሚጠቀሙበት የዕለት ተዕለት ቋንቋ ሲሆን ላቲን ብዙውን ጊዜ በሃይማኖታዊ ሥነ ሥርዓቶች ላይ ይውላል።
translations.reference: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
translations.hypothesis: Italian is also the most commonly used language in the state, while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.

translations.source: ሁሉም የቫቲካን ከተማ ዜጎች የሮማ ካቶሊክ እምነት ተከታዮች ናቸው።
translations.reference: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
translations.hypothesis: All residents of the Vatican City are Roman Catholics.

translations.source: ሰዎች ከጥንት ጀምሮ እንደ ወርቅ ፣ ብር እና ናስ ያሉ መሠረታዊ ኬሚካላዊ ንጥረ ነገሮችን ያውቃሉ ፣ እነዚህ ሁሉ በተፈጥሮ ውስጥ ሊገኙ ስለሚችሉ በጥንታዊ መሣሪያዎች ለማዕድን ቁፋሮ ቀላል ናቸው።
translations.reference: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
translations.hypothesis: People have known about basic chemical elements like gold, silver, and copper since ancient times. These elements are found naturally and can be extracted from ore using simple tools.

translations.source: ፈላስፋው አርስቶትል ሁሉም ነገር ከአንድ ወይም ከዚያ በላይ ከአራት አካላት ድብልቅ እንደሚሆን ፅንሰ-ሀሳቡን ሰጥቷል። እነሱም ምድር ፣ ውሃ ፣ አየር እና እሳት ናቸው።
translations.reference: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
translations.hypothesis: The philosopher Aristotle proposed that all things are composed of a combination of four elements: earth, water, air, and fire.

translations.source: ይህ ልክ እንደ አራቱ የነገሮች ሁኔታ (በተመሳሳይ ቅደም ተከተል)-ጠንካራ ፣ ፈሳሽ ፣ ጋዝ እና ፕላዝማ ቢሆንም እኛ የምናየውን እንዲፈጠሩ ወደ አዳዲስ ንጥረ ነገሮች እንዲለወጡ ሀሳብ አቅርቧል።
translations.reference: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
translations.hypothesis: Just as the four states of matter – solid, liquid, gas, and plasma – are different forms of the same substance, we propose a new concept: that existing elements can be transformed into new elements.

translations.source: አሎይስ በመሠረቱ የሁለት ወይም ከዚያ በላይ የብረቶች ድብልቅ ነው። በፔሬዲክ ቴብለ ላይ ብዙ ኤለመንቶች እንዳሉ አይርሱ።
translations.reference: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
translations.hypothesis: Alloy is essentially a mixture of two or more metals. It is important to note that the composition of an alloy can vary significantly.

translations.source: እንደ ካልሲየም እና ፖታሲየም ያሉ ንጥረ ነገሮች እንደ ብረቶች ይቆጠራሉ። በእርግጥ እንደ ብር እና ወርቅ ያሉ ብረቶችም አሉ።
translations.reference: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
translations.hypothesis: Elements like calcium and potassium are also considered metals. Indeed, metals such as iron and gold are also examples of metals.

translations.source: እንዲሁም እንደ ካርቦን ብረት-ያልሆኑ ንጥረ ነገሮችን የሚያካትቱ ቅይጦች ሊኖሩ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, they may also contain non-iron-based elements, such as carbon.

translations.source: በዩንቨርስ ውስጥ ያለ ነገር ሁሉ ከቁስ አካል የተሰራ ነው። ሁሉም ቁስ አካል አተም ከሚባሉ ትንንሽ ቅንጣጢት የተሰራ ነው።
translations.reference: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
translations.hypothesis: Everything in the universe is made of matter. And all matter is made up of tiny particles called atoms.

translations.source: አቶሞች በጣም ትንሽ ከመሆናቸው የተነሳ ትሪሊየን የሚሆኑት በዚህ አረፍተነገር መጨረሻ ላይ ያለ ነጥብ ውስጥ መግባት ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
translations.hypothesis: Due to their small size, atoms can fit into spaces that seem impossibly small, even at the molecular level.

translations.source: ስለሆነም እርሳሱ ሲወጣ ለብዙ ሰዎች ጥሩ ጓደኛ ነበር።
translations.reference: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
translations.hypothesis: Therefore, he was a good friend to many people when he was alive.

translations.source: የሚያሳዝነው ፣ አዳዲስ የአጻጻፍ ስልቶች እንደወጡ ፣ እርሳሱ ወደ አነስተኛ ደረጃ እና አጠቃቀሞች እንዲወርድ ተደርጓል።
translations.reference: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
translations.hypothesis: Despite the emergence of new writing styles, he was forced to simplify his writing and focus on concise summaries.

translations.source: ሰዎች አሁን ወደ መቅረጫ መቅረብ በጭራሽ ሳያስፈልጋቸው ፣ በኮምፒተር ማያ ገጾች ላይ መልዕክቶችን ይጽፋሉ።
translations.reference: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
translations.hypothesis: People can now send messages directly through computer screens, without needing to use a printer.

translations.source: አዲስ ነገር ሲመጣ የቁልፍ ሰሌዳ ምን እንደሚሆን አንደ ሰው መገረም ብቻ ነው የሚችለው።
translations.reference: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
translations.hypothesis: Only one person can truly marvel at the arrival of something new.

translations.source: የፍንዳታ ቦንብ የሚሠራው ሁሉንም ኃይል በሚቻለው ፕሮቶን እና ኒውትሮን ወደ ኒውክለስ በመሰብሰብ በሚለው መመሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
translations.hypothesis: A nuclear bomb works by harnessing the energy released when a nucleus is split, typically by bombarding it with a stream of protons and neutrons.

translations.source: አንድ ከባድ ጋሪ ወደ ኮረብታ እንደሚንከባለል ዓይነት። ኒውክሊየሱን እንደገና በመክፈል ከዚያ የተወሰነውን ኃይል ይለቀቃል።
translations.reference: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
translations.hypothesis: It functions similarly to a car engine, but instead of using gasoline, it uses nuclear fission to generate power.

translations.source: አንዳንድ አቶሞች ያልተረጋጉ ኒውክሊየኖች አሏቸው ይህም ማለት በጥቂቱ ወይም ያለ ምንም ንክኪ በመለያየት የመበተን አዝማሚያ አላቸው።
translations.reference: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
translations.hypothesis: Some atoms have unstable nuclei, meaning they have a tendency to decay, either by emitting particles or energy.

translations.source: የጨረቃው ገጽ ከአለቶች እና ከአቧራ የተሠራ ነው። የጨረቃው ውጫዊ ሽፋን ክረስት ተብሎ ይጠራል።
translations.reference: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
translations.hypothesis: The moon's surface is made of rock and dust. The outer layer of the moon is called the regolith.

translations.source: ጠርዙ በአቅራቢያው በኩል 70 ኪሜ ውፍረት ያለው ሲሆን በርቀት በኩል ደግሞ 100 ኪሜ.ነው።
translations.reference: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
translations.hypothesis: The river has a width of approximately 70 kilometers near its source, and it expands to about 100 kilometers further downstream.

translations.source: በማሪው ሥር ቀጭን ነው ከደጋ ሥር ደግሞ ወፍራም ነው።
translations.reference: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
translations.hypothesis: The mulberry tree is slender, while the fig tree is thick.

translations.source: በአጠገብ በኩል ብዙ ማሪያ ሊኖር ይችላል ምክንያቱም ቅርፊቱ ሳሳ ያለ ነው። ለላቫው ወደ ላይ መውጣት ቀላል ነበር።
translations.reference: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
translations.hypothesis: There could have been multiple lava flows through the vent, as the shape of the vent was funnel-like. This would have made it easy for the lava to flow upwards.

translations.source: አሁን ያሉት ፅንሰ ሐሳቦች ያማከሉት ሰዎችን ምን እንደሚማርካቸው ማግኘት ላይ ነው።
translations.reference: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
translations.hypothesis: The goal is to identify what these concepts teach people.

translations.source: እነዚህ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች እንደሚያመለክቱት ሰዎች ወደ አዋቂነት ሲያድጉ በውስጣቸው የተቀየሱ የተወሰኑ ፍላጎቶች እና/ወይም ምኞቶች ያሏቸው ናቸው።
translations.reference: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
translations.hypothesis: As these concepts suggest, as people mature, they develop specific interests and/or desires that are unique to them.

translations.source: እነዚህ ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦች የተወሰኑ ሰዎችን የሚያደርጉትን ነገር እንዲፈልጉ እና በአካባቢያቸው ያሉ ነገሮች አንዳንድ ነገሮችን እንዲያደርጉ ወይም እንዳያደርጉ የሚያደርጋቸው ምን እንደሆነ ያመለከታሉ።
translations.reference: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
translations.hypothesis: These concepts reveal how certain individuals are motivated to pursue specific goals, and how the environment around them influences whether or not they achieve those goals.

translations.source: ሁለት ታዋቂ የይዘት ፅንሰ ሐሳቦች የማዝሎው የጥቅሞች ተዋረድ ፅንሰ ሐሳብ እና የኸርዝበርግ ሁለትዮሽ ፅንሰ ሐሳብ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
translations.hypothesis: Two prominent concepts related to the benefits of Mazlo's theory are the "principle of correspondence" and the "principle of reciprocity."

translations.source: በአጠቃላይ አነጋገር፣ አስተዳዳሪዎች የቀድሞ አቻዎቻቸውን መምራት ሲጀምሩ ሁለት ባህሪዎች ሊመጡ ይችላሉ፡፡ አንዱ ኅብረ ቀለም “ከወንዶቹ አንዱ” (ወይም አንዷ) ሆኖ ለመቀጠል መሞከር ነው፡፡
translations.reference: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
translations.hypothesis: In general, when managers start leading former colleagues, they may exhibit two common traits. One is the tendency to treat them as if they are still "one of the boys" (or girls), maintaining a familiar and informal relationship.

translations.source: የዚህ ዓይነቱ ተቆጣጣሪ ተወዳጅ ያልሆኑ ውሳኔዎችን የማድረግ ፣ የዲሲፕሊን እርምጃዎችን የማከናወን ፣ የአፈፃፀም ምዘናዎችን የማድረግ ፣ ኃላፊነትን የመመደብ እና ሰዎችን ተጠያቂ የማድረግ ችግር አለበት።
translations.reference: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
translations.hypothesis: This type of supervisor is prone to making unpopular decisions, taking disciplinary actions, evaluating performance unfairly, assigning blame, and holding individuals accountable.

translations.source: በሌላኛው ጫፍ ላይ, አንድ ሰው ቡድኑን ሲያከናውን የነበረውን ነገር ሁሉ መለወጥ እና የራሳቸው ማድረግ እንዳለባቸው በሚሰማው የማይታወቅ ግለሰብ ላይ ይለወጣል።
translations.reference: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
translations.hypothesis: On the other side, there is a person who believes that the group's activities should be changed and that they should be doing things their own way.

translations.source: ያም ሆነ ይሄ፣ ለቡድኑ ስኬት እና ውድቀት ውሎ አድሮ ሃላፊነቱን የሚወስደው መሪው ነው።
translations.reference: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
translations.hypothesis: Ultimately, the leader is responsible for the team's success or failure, and they must take ownership of that responsibility.

translations.source: ይህ ባህሪ ብዙውን ጊዜ በመሪዎች እና በቀሪው ቡድን መካከል ጠብ ያስከስታል።
translations.reference: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
translations.hypothesis: This behavior often creates a divide between leaders and the rest of the group.

translations.source: ቨርቹዋል ቡድኖች ከተለመዱት ቡድኖች ተመሳሳይ የላቁ ደረጃዎች ጋር የተያዙ ናቸው ፣ ግን ስውር ልዩነቶች አሏቸው።
translations.reference: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
translations.hypothesis: Virtual teams share similar levels of sophistication with traditional teams, but they also have distinct differences.

translations.source: የምናባዊ ቡድን አባላት ለቅርብ አካላዊ ቡድናቸው እንደ ግንኙነት ነጥብ ያገለግላሉ።
translations.reference: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
translations.hypothesis: Members of the virtual team serve as a point of contact for their physical team.

translations.source: ከተለመዱት የቡድን አባላት የበለጠ ብዙውን ጊዜ ራሳቸውን በራሳቸው የሚያስተዳድሩ በመሆናቸው በአካባቢያቸው ያሉ አስተዳዳሪዎች ሊገባቸው በማይችሏቸው በተለያዩ የጊዜ ሰቆች ይገናኛሉ፡፡
translations.reference: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
translations.hypothesis: Members of the team, who are more accustomed to self-management, often meet at irregular intervals, making it difficult for supervisors to coordinate their activities.

translations.source: የእውነተኛ “ስውር ቡድን” መኖር (ላርሰን እና ላፋስቶ፣ 1989፣ ፒ109) የምናባዊ ቡድኑ ልዩ አካልም ነው።
translations.reference: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
translations.hypothesis: The existence of a "true rogue group" (Larson & Laffas, 1989, p. 109) is also a unique characteristic of our organization.

translations.source: “የማይታየው ቡድን” እያንዳንዱ አባላቱ ሪፖርት የሚያደርጉበት የአስተዳደር ቡድን ነው። የማይታየው ቡድን ለእያንዳንዱ አባል ደረጃዎችን ያወጣል።
translations.reference: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
translations.hypothesis: "The Invisible Team" is a management team where each member is responsible for reporting to a specific leader. The Invisible Team has established clear guidelines and expectations for each member.

translations.source: አንድ ድርጅት የመማር ድርጅት ለማቋቋም ጊዜ የሚወስድበትን ሂደት ለምን ማለፍ ፈለገ? የድርጅታዊ ትምህርት ፅንሰ-ሀሳቦችን በተግባር ለማዋል አንድ የግብ ፈጠራ ነው።
translations.reference: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
translations.hypothesis: Why would an organization choose to establish a learning organization? Establishing a learning organization is a practical way to implement the concepts of organizational learning.

translations.source: ሁሉም የሚገኙ ግብዓቶች በድርጅቱ የስራ ክፍሎች ውስጥ በአግባቡ ጥቅም ላይ ከዋሉ፣ ፈጠራ እና ብልሕነት ጎልተው ይታያሉ።
translations.reference: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
translations.hypothesis: When all available resources are utilized effectively within the organization's departments, innovation and creativity are evident.

translations.source: በዚህ ምክንያት አንድን መሰናክል ለማሸነፍ በአንድነት የሚሠራው ድርጅት የደንበኛውን ፍላጎት ለማገልገል ወደ አዲስ የፈጠራ ሂደት ሊያመራ ይችላል።
translations.reference: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
translations.hypothesis: As a result, a united organization working to overcome a single obstacle may be led to a new and innovative process in order to better serve the needs of its customers.

translations.source: አንድ ድርጅት ፈጠሪ ከመሆኑ በፊት አመራር የፈጠራ ስራ ባህል እንዲሁም የጋራ ዕውቀት እና ድርጅታዊ ትምህርት መፍጠር አለበት።
translations.reference: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
translations.hypothesis: Before an organization can innovate, it must first cultivate a culture of creative leadership and foster a shared body of knowledge and organizational learning.

translations.source: አንጄል (2006) ፣ የተቋሙ አካሄድ ድርጅቶችን ወደ ከፍተኛ የሥራ አፈፃፀም እንዲደርሱ ለማገዝ ጥቅም ላይ የዋለበትን ቀጣይ ዘዴን ያስረዳል።
translations.reference: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
translations.hypothesis: Angel (2006) explains the next method that the organization uses to help organizations achieve high levels of performance.

translations.source: ኒውሮባዮሎጂካል ውሂብ የመገንዘብ ምርመራን ቲዎሬቲካል አቀራረብ በተመለከተ አካላዊ ማስረጃ ይሰጣል። ስለዚህ የምርምር ስፋቱን ያጠበዋል እና የበለጠ ትክክለኛ ያደርገዋል።
translations.reference: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
translations.hypothesis: The theoretical approach to understanding neurobiological data is supported by empirical evidence. This allows for a more comprehensive and accurate investigation of the research topic.

translations.source: በአይምሮ የበሽታ ጥናት እና በባህሪ መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት ተመራማሪዎችን በምርምራቸው ያግዛቸዋል።
translations.reference: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
translations.hypothesis: The relationship between brain diseases and personality traits provides researchers with valuable insights.

translations.source: የተለያዩ የአንጎል ጉዳት ዓይነቶች ፣ የስሜት ቁስሎች፣ ቁስሎች እና የውስጥ እብጠቶች በባህሪ ላይ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚያሳድሩ እና በአንዳንድ የአእምሮ ተግባራት ላይ ለውጥ እንደሚያመጡ ከረዥም ጊዜ ጀምሮ ይታወቃል።
translations.reference: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
translations.hypothesis: It is well-known that various types of head injuries, neurological disorders, infections, and internal bleeding can have a significant impact on personality and lead to changes in cognitive function over time.

translations.source: የአዳዲስ ቴክኖሎጂዎች መምጣት የአንጎል መዋቅሮችን እና ሂደቶችን ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ በማይታወቅ መንገድ እንድንመለከት እና እንድንመረምር ይፈቅድልናል።
translations.reference: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
translations.hypothesis: The arrival of new technologies allows us to examine and understand the structures and processes of organizations in ways that were previously unimaginable.

translations.source: ይህ በአዕምሮአችን ውስጥ ሂደቶችን እንድንረዳ የሚረዱ የማስመሰያ ሞዴሎችን ለመገንባት ብዙ መረጃዎችን እና ቁሳቁሶችን ይሰጠናል።
translations.reference: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
translations.hypothesis: This provides us with a wealth of data and materials that we can use to build conceptual models to help us understand processes in our minds.

translations.source: AI የሳይንሳዊ ልቦለድ ጠንካራ ምልከታ ቢኖረውም፣ AI በማሽን ውስጥ ስለ ባህሪይ፣ መማር እና ጉብዝና ማስለመድ የሚያጠና የኮምፒውተር ሳይንስ በጣም አስፈላጊ ክፍል ነው።
translations.reference: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
translations.hypothesis: While AI possesses a powerful ability to mimic human intelligence, the field of computer science, particularly in areas like machine learning, algorithms, and data analysis, is crucial for developing and improving AI systems.

translations.source: በ AI ውስጥ የሚደረግ ምርምር ብልህ ባህሪን የሚጠይቁ ስራዎችን በራስ-ሰር ለማከናወን ማሽኖችን መስራትን ያካትታል።
translations.reference: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
translations.hypothesis: Research in AI focuses on developing machines that can automatically perform tasks requiring intelligence, such as problem-solving and decision-making.

translations.source: ምሳሌዎች ቁጥጥርን ፣ እቅድ ማውጣት እና የጊዜ ሰሌዳ ማውጣት ፣ ለደንበኞች ምርመራዎች እና ጥያቄዎች መልስ የመስጠት ችሎታ ፣ እንዲሁም የእጅ ጽሑፍ መለየትን ፣ የድምጽ እና የፊት ያካትታሉ።
translations.reference: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
translations.hypothesis: Examples include: controlling and managing projects, developing and implementing plans, adhering to deadlines, effectively responding to customer inquiries and questions, and demonstrating strong written and verbal communication skills, as well as proficiency in both written and spoken Amharic.

translations.source: እንደነዚህ ያሉት ነገሮች የተለዩ ስርዓቶች ሆነዋል ፣ ይህም ለእውነተኛ የሕይወት ችግሮች መፍትሄ መስጠት ላይ ያተኮረ ነው።
translations.reference: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
translations.hypothesis: These different systems were designed to address specific problems, with a focus on providing practical solutions to real-life challenges.

translations.source: የሰው ሠራሽ ብልህነት ሥርዓት አሁን በኢኮኖሚክስ፣ ሕክምና ፣ ምህንድስና እና የውትድርና ዘርፎች ላይ በአብዛኛው ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል፤ በብዙ የቤት ኮምፒውተሮች እና የቪዲዮ ጨዋታ መተግበሪያዎች ላይም ተወህዶ ተሠርቷል።
translations.reference: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
translations.hypothesis: Artificial intelligence systems are currently widely used in fields such as economics, medicine, engineering, and business. They are also being integrated into many home computers and video game applications.

translations.source: የመስክ ጉዞዎች የማንኛውም ክፍል ዋና አካል ናቸው። ብዙ ጊዜ አስተማሪዋ ተማሪዎቿን በአውቶቡስ መሄድ ወደ ማይቻልባቸው ቦታዎች መውሰድ ትመርጣለች።
translations.reference: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
translations.hypothesis: Field trips are a crucial part of any educational program. Teachers often take their students on field trips to places that are difficult or impossible to visit in the classroom.

translations.source: ቴክኖሎጂ ከምናባዊ የመስክ ጉዞ መፍትሄውን ይሰጣል። ተማሪዎች የሙዝየሞችን ቅርሶች በመመልከት ፣ የውሃ አካባቢያቸውን በመጎብኘት ወይም በክፍላቸው ሲቀመጡ የሚያምር ስነ-ጥበቦችን ማድነቅ ይችላሉ።
translations.reference: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
translations.hypothesis: The technology provides a virtual field trip experience. Students can explore ancient artifacts, visit underwater environments, or create stunning artwork while learning about different cultures.

translations.source: የመስክ ጉዞን በቨርቹዋል መጋራት እንዲሁ በጉዞ ላይ ለማንፀባረቅ እና ለወደፊቱ ትምህርቶች ልምዶችን ለማካፈል ጥሩ መንገድ ነው።
translations.reference: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
translations.hypothesis: Sharing the field trip virtually is also a great way to make it accessible to everyone and to share the learning experiences for future students.

translations.source: ለምሳሌ፣ በሰሜን ካሮላይና ውስጥ ከሚገኙት የቤኔት ት/ቤት ተማሪዎች በየአመቱ ወደ ግዛቱ ዋና ከተማ ስለሚያደርጉት ጉዞ የድረ-ገጽ ዲዛይን ያዘጋጃሉ፣ በየዓመቱ ድረ-ገጹ እንደገና ይስተካከላል፣ ነገር ግን ነባር ስሪቶች እንደ ማጣቀሻ ስለሚያገለግሉ በመስመር ላይ ይቆያሉ።
translations.reference: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
translations.hypothesis: For example, students from Bennet Elementary School in North Carolina plan and design the website for their annual trip to the state capital. While the website is updated each year to reflect the latest information, the core content remains online as a reference for future trips.

translations.source: ብሎጎች እንዲሁ የተማሪዎችን አፃፃፍ ለማሻሻል ሊረዱ ይችላሉ። ተማሪዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ የብሎግ ልምዳቸውን በተዛባ ሰዋሰው እና አጻጻፍ ቢጀምሩም ፣ የታዳሚዎች መኖር በአጠቃላይ ያንን ይለውጣል።
translations.reference: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
translations.hypothesis: Blogs can also be used to improve students' writing skills. While students may initially start blogging in a casual and informal way, the presence of an audience can significantly change their approach.

translations.source: ተማሪዎች ብዙውን ጊዜ በጣም ወሳኝ ታዳሚዎች ስለሆኑ የብሎግ ጸሐፊው ትችቶችን ለማስወገድ ጽሑፎችን ለማሻሻል መጣር ይጀምራል።
translations.reference: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
translations.hypothesis: Blog writers often start by focusing on improving their writing to address the concerns and feedback of their readers, who are typically very important.

translations.source: እንዲሁም ብሎግ ማድረግ “ተማሪዎች በዙሪያቸው ስላለው ዓለም የበለጠ እውቀት እንዲኖራቸው ያስገድዳቸዋል።” የታዳሚዎችን ፍላጎት የመመገብ አስፈላጊነት ተማሪዎች ጎበዝ እና ሳቢ እንዲሆኑ ያነሳሳቸዋል (Toto, 2004)።
translations.reference: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
translations.hypothesis: Furthermore, blogging "encourages students to become more knowledgeable about the world around them." The importance of engaging with readers' interests motivates students to become more observant and insightful (Toto, 2004).

translations.source: ብሎግ መጻፍ ትብብርን የሚያነቃቃ እና ተማሪዎች ከተለመደው የትምህርት ቀን ባሻገር ትምህርታቸውን በደንብ እንዲያሳድጉ የሚያበረታታ መሳሪያ ነው።
translations.reference: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
translations.hypothesis: Blogging is a tool that can foster collaboration and encourage students to learn beyond the traditional classroom setting.

translations.source: የብሎጎች ተገቢ አጠቃቀም "ተማሪዎችን ተንታኝና እና ጠንካራ ተቺዎች እንዲሆኑ ያጠናክራቸዋል፤ ለበይነመረብ የትምህርት ቁሳቁሶች በትጋት ምላሽ በመስጠት ተማሪዎች በሌሎች ጽሑፎች ከሌሎች አንጻር ያላቸውን አቋም መግለፅ እንዲሁም በተወሰኑ ጉዳዮች የራሳቸውን አመለካካት መግለፅ ይችላሉ (ኦራቬክ 2002)።
translations.reference: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
translations.hypothesis: "The appropriate use of blogs can help students become more engaged and critical thinkers; they can also use blogs to express their own opinions on various topics, as well as to respond to and critique other online learning materials (Orewe, 2002)."

translations.source: ኦታዋ የካናዳ ማራኪ ፣ የሁለት ቋንቋ ተናጋሪ ካፒታል ስትሆን፣ የካናዳ ያለፈውን እና የአሁኑን የሚያሳዩ በርካታ የጥበብ ማዕከለ-ስዕላት እና ሙዚየሞች ይገኙባታል።
translations.reference: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
translations.hypothesis: Ottawa, the capital of Canada and a bilingual city, boasts numerous art galleries and museums that showcase both Canada's past and present.

translations.source: በደቡብ በኩል የኒያጋራ ፎልስ የሚገኝ ሲሆን በስተ ሰሜን ደግሞ የሙስኮካ እና ከዚያ ወዲያ ያልተነካ የተፈጥሮ ውበት ይገኛል።
translations.reference: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
translations.hypothesis: Located in the south, it features Niagara Falls, while to the north, you'll find the natural beauty of Muskoka.

translations.source: እነዚህ ሁሉ ነገሮች እና ሌሎችም ኦንታሪዮን በአስተማማኝ ሁኔታ ካናዳዊ ተብሎ በውጪ ሰዎች እንደ የሚታሰበው ያስቀምጣታል።
translations.reference: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
translations.hypothesis: All of these factors, along with others, contribute to the perception that Ontario is a desirable place to live for Canadians from other parts of the country.

translations.source: በሰሜን በኩል ሰፋ ያሉ ሰፋፊ ቦታዎች እምብዛም ከመሆናቸውም በላይ አንዳንዶቹ የማይኖሩባቸው ምድረ በዳ ናቸው።
translations.reference: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
translations.hypothesis: While the northern region boasts expansive plains, some of these areas are actually barren and unproductive.

translations.source: ብዙዎችን ለሚያስደንቅ የሕዝብ ብዛት ንፅፅር የካናዳ ዜጎች ከሚኖሩት የበዙ በአሜሪካ የሚኖሩ አፍሪካዊ አሜሪካኖች አሉ።
translations.reference: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
translations.hypothesis: The sheer number of African Americans living in Canada is surprising to many, especially considering that the United States has a much larger population of African Americans.

translations.source: የምስራቅ አፍሪካ ደሴቶች ከአፍሪካ ምሥራቃዊ የባሕር ዳርቻ በሕንድ ውቅያኖስ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
translations.reference: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
translations.hypothesis: The islands of East Africa are located off the eastern coast of Africa, in the Indian Ocean.

translations.source: ዱር እንስሳትን በተመለከተ ማዳጋስካር እስካሁን ካሉት በጣም ትልቁ እና በራሱ አንድ አህጉር ነው።
translations.reference: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
translations.hypothesis: As for giraffes, Madagascar is currently home to the largest and only population of these animals in the wild.

translations.source: አብዛኛዎቹ ትንንሽ ደሴቶች እራሳቸውን የቻሉ ሃገራት ናቸው ወይም ከፈረንሳይ ጋር የተያያዙ ናቸው እናም የቅንጦት የባሕር ዳርቻ ሪዞርቶች በመባል ይታወቃሉ።
translations.reference: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
translations.hypothesis: Most of the smaller islands are independent countries or are associated with France, and are known as luxury coastal resorts.

translations.source: አረቦቹ እስልምናንም ወደ ምድሪቱ አመጡ እናም በኮሞሮ እና በማዮቴ ውስጥ በጣም ተሰራጭቷል።
translations.reference: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
translations.hypothesis: The Arab traders also introduced Islam to the region, and it became widespread in countries like Comoros and Mayotte.

translations.source: ፖርቱጋላዊው ተመራማሪ ቫስኮ ዳ ጋማ የኬፕ መስመርን ከአውሮፓ እስከ ህንድ ስላገኘው የአውሮፓ ተጽዕኖ እና ቅኝ ግዛት በ 15 ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ተጀመረ።
translations.reference: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
translations.hypothesis: The Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama's discovery of a sea route from Europe to India in the 15th century marked the beginning of European influence and colonization in the region.

translations.source: በሰሜን በኩል ክልሉ በሳህል እና በደቡብ እና ምዕራብ በአትላንቲክ ውቅያኖስ ይዋሰናል።
translations.reference: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
translations.hypothesis: The region is located in the north, bordered by the Sahara Desert, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: ሴቶች፡ የትኛውም የሴቶች ተጓዦች ትክክለኛ የጋብቻ ሁኔታ ምንም ይሁን ምን ማግባታቸውን ቢናገሩ ይመከራል።
translations.reference: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
